ti: ΝΙΚΗ για ανάρτηση Μητσοτάκη: Φτάνει με τις φτιασιδωμένες κουτοπονηριές
s: NIKH criticized Prime Minister Mitsotakis's economic policy, particularly his proposal to seek EU permission to return part of increased VAT revenues as support rather than reducing VAT or excise taxes, and proposed permanent reductions in excise tax and VAT instead of temporary subsidies.

q.o: Αρκετά με τις φτιασιδωμένες κουτοπονηριές. Πρώτα το κράτος εισπράττει περισσότερα επειδή ο πολίτης πληρώνει ακριβότερα και ύστερα η κυβέρνηση τού επιστρέφει ένα μικρό μέρος και ζητά χειροκρότημα.
q.t: Enough with the contrived tricks. First the state collects more because the citizen pays more expensively and then the government returns a small part to them and asks for applause.

q.o: Η ΝΙΚΗ έχει προτείνει μείωση ΕΦΚ και μείωση ΦΠΑ. Μόνιμη ελάφρυνση, όχι επιδοματικά παυσίπονα.
q.t: NIKH has proposed a reduction in excise tax and a reduction in VAT. Permanent relief, not subsidy painkillers.

q.o: Επιτέλους, σταματήστε να φορολογείτε το πρόβλημα για να επιδοτείτε μετά τα θύματά του.
q.t: Finally, stop taxing the problem in order to subsidize its victims afterwards.

ti: Η ΝΙΚΗ για την κοίμηση του Γέροντα Ιουστίνου, ηγουμένου της Ι.Μ. Φρέατος του Ιακώβ
s: The Democratic Patriotic Movement – Victory (NIKH) issued a statement mourning the death of Elder Ioustinos, abbot of the Monastery of Jacob's Well in the Holy Land, and called on the Greek government to contribute to preserving the Greek Orthodox pilgrimage site, referencing a 2024 parliamentary question about attacks against the monastery.

q.o: Η κοίμηση του Γέροντα Ιουστίνου, ηγουμένου της Ιεράς Μονής Φρέατος του Ιακώβ στους Αγίους Τόπους, γεμίζει την ψυχή μας με το ισχυρό ορθόδοξο συναίσθημα της χαρμολύπης
q.t: The death of Elder Ioustinos, abbot of the Holy Monastery of Jacob's Well in the Holy Land, fills our soul with the strong Orthodox feeling of joyful sorrow

q.o: Κατά τα χρόνια της ηγουμενίας του, η Ιερά Μονή Φρέατος του Ιακώβ δέχτηκε εκατοντάδες επιθέσεις φανατικών σιωνιστών και ο ίδιος υπέστη δεκάδες προσωπικές απόπειρες δολοφονίας
q.t: During the years of his abbacy, the Holy Monastery of Jacob's Well received hundreds of attacks by fanatical Zionists and he himself suffered dozens of personal assassination attempts

q.o: ζητούμε επιτακτικά από την ελληνική κυβέρνηση να συμβάλει, όχι απλώς κατά δύναμιν, αλλά υπέρ δύναμιν, στην ομαλή συνέχιση της λειτουργίας του Ελληνορθόδοξου ιερού προσκυνήματος
q.t: we urgently ask the Greek government to contribute, not simply according to its capacity, but beyond its capacity, to the smooth continuation of the operation of the Greek Orthodox holy pilgrimage site

q.o: Διαβεβαιώνουμε δε το σεπτό Πατριαρχείο Ιεροσολύμων και την Αγιοταφική Αδελφότητα ότι η ΝΙΚΗ θα σταθεί αρωγός στον αγιασμένο αγώνα τους
q.t: We assure the venerable Patriarchate of Jerusalem and the Brotherhood of the Holy Sepulchre that NIKH will stand as a helper in their sacred struggle

ti: Δ. Νατσιός στο Action 24: Η λέξη “υποχώρηση” είναι πολύ βαριά για τα εθνικά θέματα -Τον λαό τον κυβερνάς με ταπείνωση και όχι ταπεινώνοντάς τον
s: Dimitris Natsios, president of NIKH, gave a television interview criticizing government policy on fuel taxation and refineries' profits, condemning what he called government retreat on the Kasos incident with Turkey, rejecting potential alliances with Samaras, Latinopoulou, and Karystianou, and attacking Alexis Tsipras's visit to Mount Athos and his new party name.

q.o: Έχω συγκριτικούς πίνακες από τα δύο μεγάλα διυλιστήρια της χώρας. Το πρώτο εξάμηνο του 2025 είχαν κέρδη 291 εκατομμύρια, ενώ το πρώτο εξάμηνο του 2026 έφτασαν τα 1,082 δισεκατομμύρια -αύξηση 300%. Όταν έχουν τέτοια τρομακτική αύξηση στα καθαρά κέρδη, δεν είναι αισχροκέρδεια αυτό; Δεν μπορεί η κυβέρνηση να επιβάλει δικαιοσύνη;
q.t: I have comparative tables from the two major refineries of the country. In the first half of 2025 they had profits of 291 million, while in the first half of 2026 they reached 1.082 billion - an increase of 300%. When they have such a tremendous increase in net profits, isn't this profiteering? Can't the government impose justice?

q.o: Η λέξη 'υποχώρηση' είναι πάρα πολύ βαριά για τα εθνικά θέματα. Όταν μιλάμε εμείς για κατευνασμό μέσα στη Βουλή, αυτό ακριβώς εννοούμε. Στην Κάσο το Πολεμικό Ναυτικό αποχώρησε. Αν ήμουν εγώ, θα έλεγα 'δεν φεύγετε'. Και πυρ θα άνοιγα αν οι Τούρκοι παραβίαζαν τα χωρικά μας ύδατα.
q.t: The word 'retreat' is very heavy for national issues. When we speak of appeasement in Parliament, this is exactly what we mean. At Kasos the Navy withdrew. If it were me, I would say 'you are not leaving'. And I would open fire if the Turks violated our territorial waters.

q.o: δεν συνεργαζόμαστε με ανθρώπους που υπέγραψαν μνημόνια. Άρα με τον κ. Σαμαρά ούτε συζήτηση. Η κυρία Λατινοπούλου δεν ταιριάζει στο στιλ μας.
q.t: we do not cooperate with people who signed memoranda. Therefore with Mr. Samaras not even a discussion. Mrs. Latinopoulou does not fit our style.

q.o: Τον λαό μας αυτή την εποχή τον κυβερνάς με ταπείνωση και όχι ταπεινώνοντάς τον.
q.t: You govern our people in this era with humility and not by humiliating them.

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: MeRA25 demands immediate compensation for citizens, farmers, and municipalities affected by flooding in Crete, criticizing the government for slow response to previous disasters and calling for urgent state support without bureaucratic delays.

q.o: Το τριήμερο κύμα κακοκαιρίας που έπληξε την Κρήτη ήταν αρκετό για να καταρρεύσει ο μύθος της ανάπτυξης, των σύγχρονων υποδομών και των μεγάλων επενδύσεων στο νησί.
q.t: The three-day wave of bad weather that hit Crete was enough to collapse the myth of development, modern infrastructure and large investments on the island.

q.o: Η αποκατάσταση δεν είναι κυβερνητική χάρη. Είναι υποχρέωση της πολιτείας απέναντι στους ανθρώπους που δεν μπόρεσε να προστατεύσει, όπως είχε αποστολή.
q.t: Restoration is not a government favor. It is the state's obligation to the people it failed to protect, as was its mission.

q.o: Όχι λόγια. Εργα και λύσεις εδώ και τώρα!
q.t: No words. Works and solutions here and now!

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: Yanis Varoufakis issued a statement on the anniversary of German reunification criticizing Germany's militarization, increased arms exports to Israel (which rose from 32 million to 326 million euros since October 2023), police repression of pro-Palestinian protesters including German Jews, and the economic stagnation that he argues has fueled the rise of the AfD party.

q.o: Το γερμανικό κράτος μετατρέπεται σε οπλοστάσιο της Ευρώπης. Πρώην εργοστάσια της Volkswagen παράγουν πλέον άρματα μάχης Leopard — ο Μιλιταριστικός Κεϋνσιανισμός έχει καταστεί η μοναδική στρατηγική ανάπτυξης της Γερμανίας.
q.t: The German state is being transformed into the arsenal of Europe. Former Volkswagen factories now produce Leopard battle tanks — Militaristic Keynesianism has become Germany's sole development strategy.

q.o: Γερμανικά όπλα ρέουν στο Ισραήλ — η Γερμανία είναι ο δεύτερος μεγαλύτερος προμηθευτής όπλων του Ισραήλ, μετά τις Ηνωμένες Πολιτείες, με τις εξαγωγές όπλων να έχουν δεκαπλασιαστεί από τον Οκτώβριο του 2023, από 32 εκατομμύρια ευρώ σε 326 εκατομμύρια ευρώ.
q.t: German weapons flow to Israel — Germany is the second largest arms supplier to Israel, after the United States, with arms exports having increased tenfold since October 2023, from 32 million euros to 326 million euros.

q.o: Η άνοδος του AfD δεν είναι ούτε τυχαία ούτε αποτέλεσμα πολιτισμικών αλλαγών. Προέκυψε ως απόρροια της οικονομικής στασιμότητας και της συστημικής παρακμής που προκάλεσε η απερίσκεπτη, ταξική λιτότητα που επέβαλε η κυρίαρχη τάξη της Γερμανίας στην γερμανική εργατική τάξη.
q.t: The rise of the AfD is neither accidental nor the result of cultural changes. It emerged as a consequence of economic stagnation and systemic decline caused by the reckless, class-based austerity imposed by Germany's ruling class on the German working class.

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: MeRA25 issued a statement condemning the Greek government's use of taxpayer and EU funds for a video campaign promoting what the party calls racist migration policies, demanding safe refugee access to Europe, fast asylum processing, equal rights, and opposing refugee transfers to poor countries.

q.o: Η κυβέρνηση Μητσοτάκη πετά πλέον κάθε πρόσχημα ανθρωπισμού σε σχέση με το μεταναστευτικό.
q.t: The Mitsotakis government now throws away every pretense of humanism in relation to migration.

q.o: Με χρήση κρατικών, αλλά και ευρωπαϊκών πόρων, οι πολίτες γίνονται κάθε μέρα αποδέκτες μίας προπαγάνδας που κανονικοποιεί και εξευγενίζει τις πολιτικές της «Ευρώπης Φρούριο» και τις μαζικές απελάσεις ανθρώπων που επιχειρούν να ξεφύγουν από τον πόλεμο και την ανέχεια.
q.t: Using state and European resources, citizens become daily recipients of propaganda that normalizes and sanitizes the policies of 'Fortress Europe' and the mass deportations of people trying to escape war and poverty.

q.o: Το ΜέΡΑ25 Ενωτική Αριστερά παραμένει στο πλευρό όσων διώκονται στις πατρίδες τους και καταφεύγουν για προστασία στην Ευρώπη.
q.t: MeRA25 United Left remains on the side of those persecuted in their homelands who seek protection in Europe.

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: MeRA25 announces support for a mobilisation by Kypseli residents on Saturday 3 October at 18:00 in Kypseli Square, demanding accountability and safety measures regarding damage to over 200 apartments caused by metro construction works.

q.o: Εκατοντάδες οικογένειες στην Κυψέλη ζουν εδώ και μήνες με τον φόβο για την ασφάλεια των σπιτιών τους. Ρωγμές σε τοίχους και πατώματα, καθιζήσεις και εγκατάλειψη κατοικιών συνθέτουν μια εικόνα που διαρκώς επιδεινώνεται.
q.t: Hundreds of families in Kypseli have been living for months with fear for the safety of their homes. Cracks in walls and floors, subsidence and abandonment of dwellings compose a picture that is constantly worsening.

q.o: Πάνω από 200 διαμερίσματα έχουν υποστεί τεράστιες ζημιές εξαιτίας του μετροπόντικα που περνά κάτω από το έδαφος.
q.t: More than 200 apartments have suffered enormous damage because of the metro tunnel passing under the ground.

q.o: Στηρίζουμε την κινητοποίηση των κατοίκων, αύριο, Σάββατο 3 Οκτωβρίου, στις 18:00, στην Πλατεία Κυψέλης.
q.t: We support the mobilisation of residents, tomorrow, Saturday 3 October, at 18:00, in Kypseli Square.

q.o: Τα δημόσια έργα οφείλουν να υπηρετούν τους πολίτες και όχι να θέτουν σε κίνδυνο την ασφάλειά τους στον βωμό των κερδών των εργολάβων.
q.t: Public works must serve the citizens and not endanger their safety on the altar of contractors' profits.

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: MeRA25 Crete issued a statement criticizing Health Minister Adonis Georgiadis ahead of his visit to Crete, detailing severe understaffing and deteriorating conditions in public hospitals across the island, and calling for immediate permanent hirings and full public funding while supporting healthcare workers' mobilizations.

q.o: Ο υπουργός να φέρει λύσεις και όχι προσβολές για τους εργαζόμενους στη Δημόσια Υγεία.
q.t: The minister should bring solutions and not insults for the workers in Public Health.

q.o: Οι άνθρωποι που κρατούν όρθιο το ΕΣΥ χρειάζονται λύσεις και όχι προσβολές.
q.t: The people who keep the National Health System standing need solutions and not insults.

q.o: Κύριε Γεωργιάδη, αυτή η μιζέρια έχει φαρδιά πλατιά την υπογραφή σας…
q.t: Mr. Georgiadis, this misery has your signature all over it...

q.o: Απαιτούμε άμεσες μόνιμες προσλήψεις, κάλυψη των πραγματικών αναγκών όλων των νοσοκομείων, ουσιαστική δημόσια χρηματοδότηση, ασφαλείς υποδομές και πλήρη εργασιακά δικαιώματα.
q.t: We demand immediate permanent hirings, coverage of the real needs of all hospitals, substantial public funding, safe infrastructure and full labor rights.

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: MeRA25 criticizes the Mitsotakis government's announcement of a 15-cent diesel subsidy for fifteen days and other measures as insufficient responses to high inflation, proposing instead zero VAT on basic goods, price caps, automatic wage indexation, collective bargaining restoration, debt relief for small businesses, and abolition of the Energy Exchange.

q.o: Δεν είχαμε αμφιβολίες ότι ένα από τα πιο δομικά χαρακτηριστικά της κυβέρνησης είναι το θράσος της.
q.t: We had no doubts that one of the most structural characteristics of the government is its audacity.

q.o: To μοντέλο της κυβέρνησης Μητσοτάκη είναι οι φορολογούμενοι να πληρώνουν την επιδότηση της ακρίβειας, οι εργαζόμενοι και οι μικρομεσαίοι που πνίγονται στα χρέη να χρωστάνε για περισσότερο καιρό, η αισχροκέρδεια να νομιμοποιείται
q.t: The Mitsotakis government's model is for taxpayers to pay for the subsidy of high prices, for workers and small-medium businesses drowning in debt to owe for longer, for profiteering to be legitimized

q.o: Κανένα από τα μέτρα που εξήγγειλε ο Μητσοτάκης δεν χτυπάνε την πηγή της ακρίβειας και φυσικά δεν συνιστούν στήριξη για τους εργαζόμενους και τις εργαζόμενες.
q.t: None of the measures announced by Mitsotakis strike at the source of high prices and of course do not constitute support for workers.

ti: Στο πληγωμένο Οροπέδιο Λασιθίου την Δευτέρα κλιμάκιο του ΣΥΡΙΖΑ ΠΣ με επικεφαλής τον Γραμματέα Οργανωτικού Γιάννη Μπουλέκο – Αυτοψία και συναντήσεις με τους πληγέντες
s: SYRIZA-PS delegation led by Organizational Secretary Giannis Boulekos will visit flood-affected Lasithi Plateau on Monday to conduct inspections, meet with affected residents, local authorities and producers, and demand fair compensation and infrastructure restoration.

ti: Ο ΣΥΡΙΖΑ-Π.Σ. μπορεί να είναι εγγυητής της προγραμματικής συμφωνίας που πρέπει να γίνει, για να φύγει αυτή η κυβέρνηση της Δεξιάς
s: SYRIZA-PS parliamentary group president Rena Doúrou stated the party can guarantee a programmatic agreement to remove the right-wing government and criticized the government's handling of metro construction damage in Kypseli and flood damage in Lasithi.

q.o: Εμείς, ο ΣΥΡΙΖΑ-Π.Σ, μπορούμε να είμαστε εγγυητές μιας προγραμματικής συμφωνίας που πρέπει να γίνει, για να φύγει αυτή η κυβέρνηση της Δεξιάς που επτά χρόνια χειμάζει την ελληνική κοινωνία
q.t: We, SYRIZA-PS, can be guarantors of a programmatic agreement that must be made, so that this right-wing government that has been battering Greek society for seven years can leave

q.o: ο ΣΥΡΙΖΑ-ΠΣ είναι ξεκάθαρος, επί των θέσεων, επί των προγραμματικών συγκλίσεων στον δημόσιο διάλογο, χωρίς κουίντες, χωρίς παρασκήνια, χωρίς τηλέφωνα που σηκώνονται και πέφτουν
q.t: SYRIZA-PS is clear, on positions, on programmatic convergences in public dialogue, without quid pro quos, without backstage dealings, without phones being picked up and hung up

q.o: Ο ΣΥΡΙΖΑ υπήρχε και πριν τον Τσίπρα και πριν την Δούρου και ο ΣΥΡΙΖΑ θα υπάρχει και μετά τον Τσίπρα και μετά την Δούρου
q.t: SYRIZA existed before Tsipras and before Doúrou and SYRIZA will exist after Tsipras and after Doúrou

q.o: Η προτεραιότητα της κυβέρνησης δεν είναι η πλειοψηφία των πολιτών που δοκιμάζεται από την αλαζονεία και την αναλγησία τους, προτεραιότητά τους είναι τα οικονομικά συμφέροντα των ολιγαρχών που τη στηρίζουν εδώ και επτά χρόνια
q.t: The government's priority is not the majority of citizens who are tested by their arrogance and insensitivity, their priority is the economic interests of the oligarchs who have been supporting it for seven years

ti: «Η Αριστερά δεν χρειάζεται άλλον ένα Μεσσία…»
s: SYRIZA Organisational Secretary Giannis Boulekos outlined the party's economic programme including a 13th pension and salary, VAT and fuel tax cuts, public control of strategic sectors, and housing protection, while rejecting personalist politics and calling for a programmatic left-progressive alliance.

q.o: Η Αριστερά δεν χρειάζεται άλλον έναν Μεσσία. Χρειάζεται πρόγραμμα, κοινωνικές ρίζες και συλλογικότητα.
q.t: The Left does not need another Messiah. It needs a programme, social roots and collectivity.

q.o: Ο ΣΥΡΙΖΑ-ΠΣ καταθέτει διαφορετικές προτεραιότητες: 13η σύνταξη και 13ο μισθό, ουσιαστική μείωση της έμμεσης φορολογίας, παρέμβαση στο κόστος των καυσίμων, δημόσιο έλεγχο σε στρατηγικούς τομείς της οικονομίας, προστασία της πρώτης κατοικίας, αντιμετώπιση του ιδιωτικού χρέους και ένα μεγάλο πρόγραμμα κοινωνικής κατοικίας.
q.t: SYRIZA-PS puts forward different priorities: 13th pension and 13th salary, substantial reduction of indirect taxation, intervention in fuel costs, public control in strategic sectors of the economy, protection of primary residence, tackling private debt and a major social housing programme.

q.o: Δεν συμμερίζομαι την αντίληψη ότι το δίλημμα των επόμενων εκλογών μπορεί να είναι «ή εμείς ή κανείς».
q.t: I do not share the view that the dilemma of the next elections can be 'either us or no one'.

q.o: Ο ΣΥΡΙΖΑ λοιπόν δεν περιμένει κανέναν στην αποβάθρα. Το καράβι θα αναχωρήσει στην ώρα του, με προορισμό την κάλπη, με όσους θέλουν και μπορούν.
q.t: So SYRIZA is not waiting for anyone at the dock. The ship will depart in its own time, with destination the ballot box, with those who want and can.

ti: «Λιγότεροι πανηγυρισμοί, περισσότερη πραγματικότητα κ. Μητσοτάκη»
s: SYRIZA-PS criticizes Prime Minister Mitsotakis for celebrating economic achievements while citizens face high costs, proposing alternative policies including fuel tax reduction, abolition of the Hercules scheme, and EFKA as a national investor.

q.o: Λιγότεροι πανηγυρισμοί, περισσότερη πραγματικότητα κ. Μητσοτάκη
q.t: Less celebrations, more reality Mr. Mitsotakis

q.o: Αυτό που εξακολουθεί να αρνείται είναι αυτό που ο ΣΥΡΙΖΑ-ΠΣ έχει προτείνει καθαρά: μείωση του ΕΦΚ στα καύσιμα και ουσιαστική παρέμβαση στα υπερβολικά περιθώρια κέρδους στη διύλιση.
q.t: What he continues to refuse is what SYRIZA-PS has clearly proposed: reduction of excise tax on fuels and substantial intervention in excessive profit margins in refining.

q.o: Η δική μας κατεύθυνση είναι καθαρή: κατάργηση του «Ηρακλή», ουσιαστικές και βιώσιμες ρυθμίσεις και ΕΦΚΑ εθνικός επενδυτής.
q.t: Our direction is clear: abolition of 'Hercules', substantial and sustainable arrangements and EFKA as national investor.

q.o: Εμείς, ο ΣΥΡΙΖΑ-Π.Σ, μπορούμε να είμαστε εγγυητές μιας προγραμματικής συμφωνίας που πρέπει να γίνει, για να φύγει…
q.t: We, SYRIZA-PS, can be guarantors of a programmatic agreement that must be made, in order to leave...

ti: Ρένα Δούρου: Οι κάτοικοι της Κυψέλης ζητούν να είναι ασφαλείς στα σπίτια τους – Η κυβέρνηση κρύβεται
s: SYRIZA-PS delegation led by parliamentary group president Rena Dourou participated in a protest by Kypseli residents over building damage from Metro construction works, demanding relocation, compensation, and government accountability.

q.o: Πριν λίγες μέρες μπήκαμε στα σπίτια αυτών των ανθρώπων, είδαμε τις ρωγμές, είδαμε την αγωνία τους. Σήμερα είμαστε ξανά εδώ, μαζί τους. Οι κάτοικοι της Κυψέλης δεν ζητούν χάρη. Ζητούν να είναι ασφαλείς μέσα στα ίδια τους τα σπίτια και απέναντι τους βρίσκουν μια κυβέρνηση που κρύβεται πίσω από καθυστερήσεις και μισές αλήθειες.
q.t: A few days ago we entered these people's homes, we saw the cracks, we saw their anguish. Today we are here again, with them. The residents of Kypseli are not asking for a favor. They are asking to be safe inside their own homes and facing them they find a government that hides behind delays and half-truths.

q.o: Τέμπη, υποκλοπές, ΟΠΕΚΕΠΕ, το ίδιο μοτίβο, όπου υπάρχει ευθύνη, επιχειρείται συγκάλυψη.
q.t: Tempi, wiretapping, OPEKEPE, the same pattern, where there is responsibility, a cover-up is attempted.

ti: Παύλος Πολάκης στην Εφ.Συν.: Πώς η κυβέρνηση Μητσοτάκη πριμοδοτούσε τα ιδιωτικά ιατρεία… ευζωίας
s: SYRIZA health spokesperson Pavlos Polakis accused the Mitsotakis government of promoting private wellness clinics through legislative changes from 2022-2023 and alleged financial irregularities involving Athens Medical Association president Georgios Patoulis and private healthcare companies.

q.o: Τέτοιο πράγμα πριν δεν υπήρχε. Και το λέω μετά πλήρους λόγου γνώσεως. Τέτοια ξεφτίλα, τέτοια διάχυση αυτής της παραϊατρικής πριν το 2019 δεν υπήρχε.
q.t: Such a thing did not exist before. And I say this with full knowledge. Such disgrace, such diffusion of this para-medical practice did not exist before 2019.

q.o: Πηγαίνει ο υπουργός Υγείας και διαφημίζει μια ιδιωτική επένδυση, τη Νότια Medcare στη Γλυφάδα, ως κλινική ευζωίας και μακροζωίας. Τεράστια επένδυση. Από τα Ηνωμένα Αραβικά Εμιράτα.
q.t: The Minister of Health goes and advertises a private investment, Notia Medcare in Glyfada, as a wellness and longevity clinic. Huge investment. From the United Arab Emirates.

q.o: Από 300 μέχρι 500 ευρώ το τετραγωνικό. Οχι 1.700 ευρώ το τετραγωνικό.
q.t: From 300 to 500 euros per square meter. Not 1,700 euros per square meter.

q.o: Εμείς είχαμε κάνει το σκατό μας παξιμάδι. Με 220 εκατομμύρια μπορέσαμε να βάλουμε 19 αξονικούς, 20 μαγνητικούς κ.ά.
q.t: We had worked our asses off. With 220 million we managed to install 19 CT scanners, 20 MRI machines, etc.

ti: Στα Τέμπη έγινε έγκλημα και στο Πολυτεχνείο η χούντα σκότωσε
ac: Coalition of the Radical Left – Progressive Alliance
s: SYRIZA-PS condemned journalist Stamatis Zacharos for denying the existence of Errieta Molcho among Tempi train crash victims and for repeating junta-era claims that no one died at the Polytechnic uprising, pledging to continue fighting for justice and against far-right hate rhetoric.

q.o: Ο ΣΥΡΙΖΑ-ΠΣ δεν κρύβει και δεν ωραιοποιεί την αλήθεια. Μάχεται για την ανάδειξή της.
q.t: SYRIZA-PS does not hide or beautify the truth. It fights for its revelation.

q.o: Καταδικάζουμε αυτές τις αναφορές και δηλώνουμε ξεκάθαρα ότι θα συνεχίσουμε τον αγώνα για Δικαιοσύνη και εκδίωξη της Ακροδεξιάς ρητορικής μίσους από τον δημόσιο χώρο.
q.t: We condemn these references and declare clearly that we will continue the struggle for Justice and the expulsion of far-right hate rhetoric from the public space.

ti: «Τα 2,2 δισ. τελικά δεν ήταν ανυπέρβλητο ταβάνι, να συζητηθούν οι προτάσεις μας, όπως η 13η σύνταξη – Ο ΕΦΚΑ ως εθνικός επενδυτής για ιδιωτικό χρέος και κοινωνική κατοικία»
s: SYRIZA-PS Secretary Nikos Pappas presented the party's 5 billion euro policy package at the Olympia Forum, including proposals for a 13th pension, using EFKA as a national investor for private debt and social housing, and criticized the government's fiscal ceiling claims.

q.o: Η ίδια η κυβέρνηση είπε ότι τελικά δεν ήταν ανυπέρβλητο ταβάνι τα 2,2 δισ.
q.t: The government itself said that ultimately the 2.2 billion was not an insurmountable ceiling.

q.o: Ποια είναι η θέση αυτών των κομμάτων για τη 13η σύνταξη; Μήπως πρέπει να το ξανασκεφτούν και να έρθουν μαζί μας σε ένα πρόγραμμα;
q.t: What is the position of these parties on the 13th pension? Perhaps they should reconsider and join us in a program?

q.o: Η Ελλάδα, για να μπει σε νέο παραγωγικό μοντέλο, χρειάζεται εθνικό επενδυτή που να μπορεί να σκέφτεται το όλον
q.t: Greece, to enter a new productive model, needs a national investor that can think of the whole.

ti: Alice Weidel: Staatsquote muss dringend sinken - Alternative für Deutschland
s: Alice Weidel criticized the German government's projected state spending ratio of 52 percent for 2026 as an all-time high and called for a leaner state focused on core tasks with lower taxes and spending.

q.o: Wenn der Staat über die Hälfte der Wirtschaftsleistung des Landes verschlingt, sollten alle Alarmglocken läuten. Schließlich muss das Geld für die Staatsausgaben ja irgendwo herkommen, weshalb die Steuer- und Abgabenbelastung unter Merz und Klingbeil immer weiter steigt.
q.t: When the state devours more than half of the country's economic output, all alarm bells should ring. After all, the money for state spending has to come from somewhere, which is why the tax and levy burden under Merz and Klingbeil keeps rising.

q.o: Was wir für Deutschland stattdessen brauchen und seitens der Alternative für Deutschland seit langem fordern, ist einen schlanker Staat, der sich auf seine Kernaufgaben konzentriert.
q.t: What we need for Germany instead, and what the Alternative for Germany has long demanded, is a leaner state that concentrates on its core tasks.

ti: Alice Weidel: Steuerverschwendung und Förderirrsinn endlich stoppen - Alternative für Deutschland
s: Alice Weidel, federal spokesperson for Alternative for Germany, criticized government tax waste and subsidy programs following the publication of the Taxpayers' Association's new Schwarzbuch on October 1, 2026, arguing that state subsidies have distorted market competition and that special debt funds are being misused.

q.o: Für all jene, die in Deutschland arbeiten gehen und Jahr für Jahr zig Tausend Euro Steuern zahlen, ist es ein Schlag ins Gesicht, wenn sie das Schwarzbuch des Steuerzahlerbunds lesen.
q.t: For all those who go to work in Germany and pay tens of thousands of euros in taxes year after year, it is a slap in the face when they read the Taxpayers' Association's Schwarzbuch.

q.o: Wir als AfD kritisieren schon lange, dass der Staat jede Menge Projekte fördert, die am Markt nicht überlebensfähig wären.
q.t: We as AfD have long criticized that the state subsidizes a lot of projects that would not be viable in the market.

q.o: Statt technologieoffen, strategisch und weitsichtig die besten Produkte zu entwickeln und zu produzieren, haben sich viele Firmen auf das konzentriert, was gerade die höchste Förderung versprach.
q.t: Instead of developing and producing the best products in a technology-neutral, strategic and far-sighted manner, many companies have concentrated on what promised the highest subsidies.

ti: Stefan Möller: Ministerpräsidenten ändern lieber die Regeln statt den Willen des Volkes zu akzeptieren - Alternative für Deutschland
s: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Stefan Möller criticized the German Interior Ministers' Conference for changing its decision-making rule from unanimity to a 13-of-16 majority, claiming this change is intended to prevent AfD from blocking decisions if it governs in Saxony-Anhalt.

q.o: Das Abrücken vom Einstimmigkeitsprinzip verdeutlicht die immer offener zu Tage tretende Bereitschaft, nach Wahlniederlagen einfach die Regeln zu ändern. Echte Demokraten würden die Niederlage anerkennen. Dieser respektlose Umgang mit dem Votum der Wähler zeigt, von wem die wahre Gefahr für die Demokratie in diesem Land ausgeht.
q.t: The departure from the unanimity principle illustrates the increasingly open willingness to simply change the rules after electoral defeats. True democrats would acknowledge the defeat. This disrespectful treatment of the voters' verdict shows where the real danger to democracy in this country comes from.

ti: Merz throws himself into the Kiev with the money of German taxpayers — Weidel - eadaily.com
s: Alice Weidel criticized CDU leader Friedrich Merz for supporting financial aid to Ukraine using German taxpayer money.

ti: Weidel: Merz abandoned the Germans on the day of the national holiday and went to Kiev - eadaily.com
s: Alice Weidel criticized CDU leader Friedrich Merz for traveling to Kiev on Germany's national holiday instead of remaining with Germans.

ti: German Deputy from Pro-Russian Party to Bring Representatives of "Alternative for Germany" to Belarus - Наша Ніва
ac: Sahra Wagenknecht Alliance – Reason and Justice
s: A deputy from the Sahra Wagenknecht Alliance is organizing a visit bringing representatives of Alternative for Germany to Belarus.

ti: Die Koalition streitet über die falschen Fragen
s: Die Linke chair Ines Schwerdtner criticizes the federal coalition government's austerity course, calling for a social plan instead of further cuts and demanding a genuine policy reversal rather than a compromise between CDU and SPD.

q.o: Die Bundesregierung hat sich in einen Kürzungskurs verrannt, der den sozialen Zusammenhalt gefährdet.
q.t: The federal government has locked itself into an austerity course that endangers social cohesion.

q.o: Statt weiterer Kürzungsreformen braucht dieses Land einen Sozialplan, der den Alltag bezahlbar macht, soziale Sicherheit schafft und den Zusammenhalt stärkt.
q.t: Instead of further austerity reforms, this country needs a social plan that makes everyday life affordable, creates social security, and strengthens cohesion.

q.o: Deshalb braucht es keinen faulen Kompromiss zwischen CDU und SPD, sondern einen echten Kurswechsel.
q.t: Therefore, what is needed is not a rotten compromise between CDU and SPD, but a genuine change of course.

ti: Übergewinne besteuern statt Tankrabatt von Steuerzahlern bezahlen lassen
s: Die Linke party chair Ines Schwerdtner criticizes the federal government's renewed fuel discount as taxpayer-funded and ineffective, demanding instead that excess profits of oil companies be taxed to relieve citizens and make the Deutschlandticket cheaper.

q.o: Die Bundesregierung hat nichts gelernt: Der Tankrabatt wird direkt aus den Taschen der Steuerzahler bezahlt und löst keines der Probleme in dieser Ölpreiskrise.
q.t: The federal government has learned nothing: The fuel discount is paid directly from the pockets of taxpayers and solves none of the problems in this oil price crisis.

q.o: Stattdessen müssen endlich die Milliarden an Übergewinnen der Mineralölkonzerne dafür genutzt werden, um die Menschen im Land wirklich zu entlasten.
q.t: Instead, the billions in excess profits of the oil companies must finally be used to truly relieve the people in the country.

q.o: Die Bundesregierung zeigt einmal mehr, dass sie in Krisen nicht handlungsfähig ist und alles dafür tut, Profite statt Menschen zu schützen.
q.t: The federal government shows once again that it is incapable of acting in crises and does everything to protect profits instead of people.

ti: VW: Die Beschäftigten müssen mehr Gewicht bekommen
s: Die Linke chair Luigi Pantisano criticized VW's termination of ten collective agreements, demanding that employees receive greater decision-making power, that public subsidies be tied to binding investment and job guarantees, and that no plant be closed without employee co-determination.

q.o: VW darf den Beschäftigten nicht die Jobsicherheit wegnehmen.
q.t: VW must not take away job security from the employees.

q.o: Jetzt die Tarifverträge zu kündigen läuft auf eine Aufkündigung der Sozialpartnerschaft hinaus.
q.t: Terminating the collective agreements now amounts to terminating the social partnership.

q.o: Es darf kein Werk ohne Zukunftsplan und Mitbestimmung der Beschäftigten geben.
q.t: There must be no plant without a future plan and employee co-determination.

q.o: Fördermittel, Bürgschaften, günstige öffentliche Kredite und Industriestrom müssen an einen verbindlichen Investitions- und Transformationsplan sowie an langfristige Job-, Standort- und Tarifgarantien geknüpft werden.
q.t: Subsidies, guarantees, favorable public loans and industrial electricity must be tied to a binding investment and transformation plan as well as to long-term job, location and collective bargaining guarantees.

ti: Future of French far-right star in balance after antisemitism claims - The Japan Times
s: A prominent National Rally figure faces uncertainty following allegations of antisemitism.

ti: FERMETURE DE MATERNITES : L’AVEUGLEMENT DU GOUVERNEMENT CONTRE LES PARTURIENTES
s: France Unbowed issued a statement on October 2, 2026 condemning a government report that establishes criteria for closing small maternity wards, arguing that 40% of maternity facilities have already closed since 2000 and demanding maintenance of local hospitals with maternity services and increased funding.

q.o: Alors que déjà 40% des maternités ont été fermées depuis l'an 2000, jusqu'où vont-ils aller ?
q.t: While already 40% of maternity wards have been closed since 2000, how far will they go?

q.o: Car naturellement, des fermetures, nous n'en voulons plus !
q.t: Because naturally, we don't want any more closures!

q.o: La France insoumise soutien le maintien des petits hôpitaux avec leurs maternités de proximité et l'augmentation des moyens humains et financiers pour assurer la pérennité des équipes dans les maternités
q.t: France Unbowed supports maintaining small hospitals with their local maternity wards and increasing human and financial resources to ensure the sustainability of maternity teams

ti: Alerte : l’antifasciste Gino ne doit pas être livré à l’Allemagne
s: France Unbowed's parliamentary group demands the French government oppose the extradition of antifascist activist Gino to Germany, warning he risks subsequent transfer to Hungary where activists have been imprisoned, and pledges citizen protection initiatives.

q.o: Extrader Gino, c'est le livrer à une vengeance politique contre l'antifascisme.
q.t: To extradite Gino is to deliver him to a political vendetta against antifascism.

q.o: A l'heure de la montée en puissance de l'internationale d'extrême droite, le combat contre le fascisme et le néonazisme est un honneur.
q.t: At a time of the rising power of the far-right international, the fight against fascism and neo-Nazism is an honor.

q.o: Nous demandons au gouvernement d'Emmanuel Macron de s'opposer à l'exécution de cette décision et de réengager un dialogue diplomatique.
q.t: We demand that Emmanuel Macron's government oppose the execution of this decision and re-engage diplomatic dialogue.

q.o: Nous soutiendrons les initiatives de protection citoyenne du militant Gino.
q.t: We will support citizen protection initiatives for activist Gino.

ti: France Youth Riots Manipulated by Far-Left Mélenchon Party, Paris Police Report Finds - breitbart.com
s: A Paris police report allegedly finds that France Unbowed manipulated youth riots in France, according to a Breitbart article.

ti: “You’re in the dock”: Sarah Knafo challenges Bruno Le Maire on his record at Bercy – Interview - entrevue.fr
s: Sarah Knafo of Reconquest challenged former Economy Minister Bruno Le Maire on his record at the Ministry of Economy and Finance.

ti: French hard-left union condemns EDF CEO for meeting far-right leaders - Yahoo
s: A French hard-left union condemned the CEO of EDF for meeting with far-right leaders, which would include representatives from Reconquest.

ti: Nuñez, Geffray, resign! They are the ones wreaking havoc. - International Viewpoint
s: A statement calls for the resignation of Nuñez and Geffray, accusing them of causing havoc.

ti: Mardi, soyons aux cÃ´tÃ©s des lycÃ©ens et des lycÃ©ennes, en grÃ¨ve et dans la rueÂ !
s: The NPA-Révolutionnaires calls for workers and the public to join high school students in a national strike and street demonstrations on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, to protest police repression, social injustice, and the government's 2027 budget cuts.

q.o: Mardi 6 octobre, il faut qu'on soit dans la rue aux côtés des jeunes mobilisés.
q.t: Tuesday, October 6, we must be in the streets alongside the mobilized youth.

q.o: Envoyons un message clair au gouvernement : nous mettons les lycéens et les lycéennes, les étudiants et les étudiantes sous la protection du monde du travail.
q.t: Let's send a clear message to the government: we place high school students and university students under the protection of the working world.

q.o: Ceux qui cassent les services publics, la Sécu, nos retraites, ils sont au gouvernement ! Ce sont eux les casseurs.
q.t: Those who are breaking public services, Social Security, our pensions, they are in the government! They are the ones breaking things.

ti: [DOSSIER] Les prix augmentent, les salaires doivent suivre â paru dans RÃ©volutionnaires nÂ° 64
s: The New Anticapitalist Party – Revolutionaries published a dossier in their magazine Révolutionnaires issue 64 demanding wage increases to match rising prices, featuring articles on wages eroded by price increases and workers' struggles.

q.o: Si même nous les smicards on n'y a pas droit ? C'est vraiment du foutage de gueule.
q.t: If even us minimum wage workers don't have the right to it? It's really taking the piss.

ti: Ãtat espagnolÂ : de quoi Maricarmen est-elle le nomÂ ?
s: NPA Révolutionnaires reports on mass protests in Spain following the violent eviction of an 87-year-old tenant by police, criticizing both right-wing regional president Ayuso and the Socialist-led Sánchez government for enabling vulture funds and repressing demonstrations.

q.o: Nous n'acceptons plus de vivre sous ces lois qui détruisent nos vies. Ni celles d'Ayuso, ni celles de Sánchez […] Nous ne sommes pas tristes, nous sommes en colère et nous n'arrêterons pas jusqu'à que ça change !
q.t: We no longer accept living under these laws that destroy our lives. Neither those of Ayuso, nor those of Sánchez […] We are not sad, we are angry and we will not stop until it changes!

ti: Soutien aux lycÃ©ens face Ã la rÃ©pressionÂ : la violence, câest celle du gouvernement et de ses policiers, câest celle de lâordre social contre les exploitÃ©s et leurs enfantsÂ !
s: The New Anticapitalist Party – Revolutionaries issued a statement supporting high school student mobilizations across France, condemning government repression including police violence and arrests, and calling for participation in a protest on October 6, 2026.

q.o: Le NPA-Révolutionnaires et le NPA Jeunes-Révolutionnaires soutiennent totalement la mobilisation de la jeunesse qui a gagné des centaines de lycées partout dans le pays et touche maintenant aussi les facultés.
q.t: The NPA-Revolutionaries and NPA Youth-Revolutionaries fully support the youth mobilization that has reached hundreds of high schools throughout the country and is now also affecting universities.

q.o: Le NPA-R condamne cette répression : libération de tous les inculpés, abandon de toute poursuite, non aux fermetures administratives !
q.t: The NPA-R condemns this repression: release of all those charged, dropping of all prosecutions, no to administrative closures!

q.o: Les lycéens ont ouvert la brèche : c'est le moment d'organiser la riposte contre la guerre menée aux travailleurs et à leurs enfants par le gouvernement et le patronat.
q.t: High school students have opened the breach: it is time to organize the response against the war waged on workers and their children by the government and employers.

ti: Dans lâEure, le 3 octobre, mobilisation internationale contre les capitalistes de lâagrochimie
s: The New Anticapitalist Party – Revolutionaries calls for participation in an international demonstration on October 3 against the Syngenta agrochemical plant in Saint-Pierre-de-la-Garenne (Eure), organized by Confédération paysanne, Soulèvements de la Terre, and other groups, demanding expropriation and reconversion of such facilities.

q.o: Il est temps d'exproprier ce type d'usines et de reconvertir leur production en produits sanitaires utiles à la population.
q.t: It is time to expropriate this type of factory and reconvert their production into sanitary products useful to the population.

q.o: Pour les actionnaires de Syngenta, peu importe la couleur du drapeau, ce qui compte c'est la couleur des profits même au détriment de la nature ou de la santé humaine.
q.t: For Syngenta shareholders, the color of the flag doesn't matter, what counts is the color of profits even at the expense of nature or human health.

ti: Loi intÃ©graleÂ : et maintenantÂ ?
s: The New Anticapitalist Party – Revolutionaries criticizes the government's proposed comprehensive law against sexual violence following the Lyhanna case, arguing that the promised budget of 1.5 billion euros is insufficient compared to the 3 billion requested by associations, and that the law focuses excessively on repression rather than prevention.

q.o: Cette loi sera peut-être une avancée sur le plan de la reconnaissance des VSS. Mais il faut se souvenir que les violences sexuelles sont des violences sociales, contre lesquelles on ne lutte pas avec les moyens du système qui les engendre.
q.t: This law may perhaps be a step forward in terms of recognizing sexual and gender-based violence. But we must remember that sexual violence is social violence, against which we cannot fight with the means of the system that generates it.

q.o: Les associations chiffrent à 3 milliards le montant de départ qui serait nécessaire pour commencer à mettre en place les mesures décrites dans la loi. Pour le moment, le gouvernement promet une somme plancher de 1,5 milliard dans le budget… L'équivalent de la somme engagé en 2026.
q.t: Associations estimate that 3 billion would be the starting amount necessary to begin implementing the measures described in the law. For now, the government promises a floor amount of 1.5 billion in the budget... The equivalent of the amount committed in 2026.

ti: Schwarz-Grün haben ungeniert Steuergelder für Partei-Interessen umgeleitet
s: FPÖ General Secretary Christian Hafenecker criticized a Court of Audit report revealing that the ÖVP-Green government allegedly diverted over five million euros in taxpayer money to party-affiliated organizations and persons between 2020 and 2024, demanding consequences and promising to end such practices under a future FPÖ government.

q.o: Das ist ein unfassbarer Skandal und offenbart den tiefen Sumpf der Freunderlwirtschaft, in dem die Systemparteien baden. ÖVP und Grüne haben hier offensichtlich Steuergeld mit beiden Händen in die Taschen ihrer Günstlinge geschaufelt
q.t: This is an unbelievable scandal and reveals the deep swamp of cronyism in which the system parties are bathing. ÖVP and Greens have obviously shoveled tax money with both hands into the pockets of their cronies

q.o: 130.000 Euro für ein paar Tage 'Beratung' – hier entsteht der Eindruck, dass sich die ÖVP offensichtlich die pinke Opposition gekauft hat
q.t: 130,000 euros for a few days of 'consulting' – this creates the impression that the ÖVP has obviously bought the pink opposition

q.o: Dieser Bericht ist die endgültige Bankrotterklärung für Schwarz-Grün und ihre pinken Helfershelfer. Es darf jetzt nicht einfach wieder zur Tagesordnung übergegangen werden, hier muss es ernsthafte und spürbare Konsequenzen geben!
q.t: This report is the final declaration of bankruptcy for Black-Green and their pink accomplices. We cannot simply return to business as usual now, there must be serious and tangible consequences!

q.o: Dieses System der Selbstbedienung wird mit einer freiheitlichen Bundesregierung sofort der Vergangenheit angehören!
q.t: This system of self-service will immediately become a thing of the past with a Freedom Party federal government!

ti: SPÖ-nahe Journalisten-NGO warnt vor ORF-Volksbegehren
s: FPÖ General Secretary Christian Hafenecker promoted the party's ORF referendum initiative calling for abolition of mandatory broadcasting fees, criticizing SPÖ-linked NGO 'Reporter ohne Grenzen' and its president Fritz Hausjell for opposing the measure.

q.o: Wenn ein Mitglied des Bundes sozialdemokratischer Akademiker, das dem ‚Expertenrat' von SPÖ-Chef und Vizekanzler Andreas Babler im letzten Nationalratswahlkampf angehört hat, sich angesichts unseres ORF-Volksbegehrens und der mit diesem erhobenen Forderung nach einer Abschaffung der ORF-Zwangsgebühr um die ‚Unabhängigkeit' des ORF sorgt, geht es ihm nur um den Erhalt des öffentlich-rechtlichen Rundfunks als Propaganda-Lautsprecher der Regierung und des Systems.
q.t: When a member of the Federation of Social Democratic Academics, who belonged to the 'expert council' of SPÖ leader and Vice Chancellor Andreas Babler in the last National Council election campaign, worries about the 'independence' of the ORF in light of our ORF referendum and its demand for abolition of the mandatory ORF fee, he is only concerned with preserving public broadcasting as a propaganda loudspeaker for the government and the system.

q.o: Saubere Information, keine Luxusgagen und Privilegien, keine Zwangsgebühr, das ist der ORF, wie ihn sich auch die Österreicher wünschen!
q.t: Clean information, no luxury salaries and privileges, no mandatory fee, that is the ORF as Austrians want it!

ti: Nächster Inflations-Anstieg ist in Zahlen gegossenes Regierungsversagen
s: Nächster Inflations-Anstieg ist in Zahlen gegossenes Regierungsversagen. ti: Doppelte Entlastung: Paketsteuer zurücknehmen – Regierung zurücktreten
s: FPÖ General Secretary Michael Schnedlitz demanded the withdrawal of a package tax law and called for the resignation of the ÖVP-SPÖ-NEOS coalition government, criticizing new tax burdens on citizens.

q.o: Während die teuerste Regierung aller Zeiten das Geld mit beiden Händen aus dem Fenster wirft, schnallt sie den Gürtel bei der Bevölkerung immer enger. Das hat nun ein Maß erreicht, bei dem die rote Linie längst überschritten ist
q.t: While the most expensive government of all time throws money out the window with both hands, it tightens the belt ever more on the population. This has now reached a level where the red line has long been crossed

q.o: Doppelte Entlastung heißt für uns: Paketsteuer zurücknehmen und Regierung zurücktreten. Österreich braucht eine Politik, die ihre Ausgaben überprüft, klare Prioritäten setzt und die Bevölkerung nicht mit immer neuen Abgaben belastet
q.t: Double relief means for us: withdraw the package tax and government resign. Austria needs a policy that reviews its spending, sets clear priorities and does not burden the population with ever new levies

ti: Genossenschaftswohnungen müssen leistbar bleiben
s: The FPÖ opposes planned rent increases in cooperative housing affecting 270,000 tenants, criticizing government coalition parties (ÖVP, SPÖ, and especially NEOS) for threatening affordable housing and announcing a parliamentary inquiry directed at Housing Minister Andreas Babler.

q.o: Der gemeinnützige Wohnbau muss weiterhin ein Ort der Sicherheit für seine unzähligen Bewohner bleiben. Dramatische Mietensteigerungen – mit denen insbesondere die Neos anscheinend liebäugeln – sind besonders hier kategorisch abzulehnen
q.t: Non-profit housing must continue to be a place of security for its countless residents. Dramatic rent increases – which the NEOS in particular apparently are flirting with – must be categorically rejected here

q.o: Wir Freiheitlichen bekennen uns klar zum System der Wohnungsgemeinnützigkeit. Anscheinend betreiben allerdings ÖVP, SPÖ und besonders die Neos deren faktische Abschaffung: Denn nichts anderes wäre eine Mietenexplosion in 270.000 genossenschaftlichen Mietwohnungen
q.t: We Freedom Party members clearly commit ourselves to the system of non-profit housing. However, it appears that the ÖVP, SPÖ and especially the NEOS are pursuing its de facto abolition: Because a rent explosion in 270,000 cooperative rental apartments would be nothing else

q.o: Wir Freiheitlichen werden insbesondere SPÖ-Wohnminister Andreas Babler nicht aus seiner Verantwortung entlassen
q.t: We Freedom Party members will not release SPÖ Housing Minister Andreas Babler from his responsibility in particular

ti: Dienstzeit-Desaster bei Polizei bleibt trotz "Einlenken" Karners bestehen
s: FPÖ deputy security spokesperson Reinhold Maier criticized ÖVP Interior Minister Gerhard Karner's new police duty-time model as a cost-cutting measure that burdens officers and reduces street patrols, demanding the model be immediately stopped and the minister resign.

q.o: Was ÖVP-Innenminister Karner hier als großes ‚Einlenken' verkauft, ist nichts anderes als ein kläglicher Versuch, sein gescheitertes Sparpaket PR-mäßig zu retten und die Exekutivbeamten für dumm zu verkaufen. Dieses Täuschungsmanöver ändert nichts an der Tatsache, dass es sich um einen Anschlag auf die Motivation unserer Beamten und die Sicherheit im Land handelt. Karner hat auf ganzer Linie versagt, sollte die Konsequenzen daraus ziehen und noch heute seinen Hut nehmen!
q.t: What ÖVP Interior Minister Karner is selling here as a great 'concession' is nothing other than a pathetic attempt to salvage his failed austerity package in PR terms and to take the executive officers for fools. This deception maneuver changes nothing about the fact that this is an attack on the motivation of our officers and the security in the country. Karner has failed on all fronts, should draw the consequences and resign today!

q.o: Zentrale ‚Giftzähne' dieser Reform bleiben bestehen. Genau diese Punkte führen aber zu massiven Einkommensverlusten für die Beamten und, was noch viel schlimmer ist, zu einer drastischen Reduzierung der Streifen auf unseren Straßen. Das ist ein direkter Anschlag auf die Sicherheit der österreichischen Bevölkerung, nur um das Budget zu sanieren!
q.t: Central 'poison fangs' of this reform remain in place. But precisely these points lead to massive income losses for the officers and, what is much worse, to a drastic reduction of patrols on our streets. This is a direct attack on the security of the Austrian population, just to balance the budget!

q.o: Dieses gesamte Dienstzeitmodell gehört sofort gestoppt und eingestampft. Es ist ein Murks von Anfang bis Ende und ein Schlag ins Gesicht für jeden einzelnen Polizisten, der täglich für unsere Sicherheit den Kopf hinhält. Wir Freiheitlichen stehen an der Seite unserer Exekutive. Anstatt unsere Beamten mit solchen Spar-Experimenten zu demotivieren, braucht es eine echte Personaloffensive, faire Gehälter und einen Innenminister, der für die Sicherheit brennt, anstatt sie kaputtzusparen!
q.t: This entire duty-time model must be immediately stopped and scrapped. It is a botch from start to finish and a slap in the face for every single police officer who puts their neck on the line daily for our security. We Freedom Party members stand on the side of our executive. Instead of demotivating our officers with such austerity experiments, we need a real personnel offensive, fair salaries and an interior minister who is passionate about security, instead of cutting it to pieces!

ti: Blurring the line between alleged extremism and legitimate viewpoints threatens to narrow public debate - Forum voor Democratie
s: Forum voor Democratie issued a public statement warning that conflating alleged extremism with legitimate viewpoints threatens to restrict public debate.

ti: Prime Minister Jetten says he wants to “punch opponents in the face”; FVD MP Gideon Van Meijeren tables parliamentary questions - Forum voor Democratie
s: FVD MP Gideon Van Meijeren tabled parliamentary questions in response to Prime Minister Jetten's statement about wanting to "punch opponents in the face."

ti: Lawmakers to weigh ban on animal slaughter without prior stunning - NL Times
s: Dutch lawmakers are set to consider legislation that would ban the slaughter of animals without prior stunning.

ti: Reactie JA21 op de begrotingsdeal over links
s: JA21 criticizes the minority cabinet's budget deal for choosing cooperation with left-wing parties and expresses disappointment that VVD allows this, while reaffirming their priorities of lower taxes, more security, and reduced asylum and migration.

q.o: Wat er nu ligt, is voor JA21 onvoldoende.
q.t: What is now on the table is insufficient for JA21.

q.o: Wij zijn niet opgericht om vanaf de zijlijn te roepen, maar om concrete resultaten te bereiken.
q.t: We were not founded to shout from the sidelines, but to achieve concrete results.

q.o: Maar ondanks onze constructieve houding kiest het kabinet nu vooral voor samenwerking over links. En de VVD laat dat gebeuren. Dat vinden wij teleurstellend.
q.t: But despite our constructive attitude, the cabinet now mainly chooses cooperation with the left. And the VVD lets that happen. We find that disappointing.

ti: De tar plats i riksdagens utskott för Vänsterpartiet
s: The Left Party announced committee assignments for its parliamentary members for the upcoming term, with Nadja Awad as chair of the social insurance committee, Hawar Asaiesh as chair of the education committee, and Anfal Mahdi as vice chair of the civil committee.

q.o: Det finns väldigt mycket kunskap i gruppen och ett stort engagemang, vi har en bra känsla inför den här mandatperioden
q.t: There is a lot of knowledge in the group and great commitment, we have a good feeling about this term

q.o: I min roll som ansvarig för socialförsäkringsfrågor kommer jag att fokusera på att ingen människa ska behöva bli fattig för att man blir sjuk eller arbetslös, det är det Sverige lovar sina medborgare och det ska vi hålla. Den urholkning av våra skyddssystem som skett de senaste decennierna måste få ett stopp
q.t: In my role as responsible for social insurance issues, I will focus on ensuring that no person should have to become poor because they become sick or unemployed, that is what Sweden promises its citizens and we must keep that. The erosion of our protection systems that has occurred in recent decades must be stopped

q.o: Under min tid som skolpolitiker i Västerås har jag sett de förödande konsekvenserna av marknadsskolan. Nu ser jag fram emot att förändra systemet för en jämlik skola för alla barn- och unga
q.t: During my time as education politician in Västerås, I have seen the devastating consequences of the market school. Now I look forward to changing the system for an equal school for all children and young people

q.o: Den kommande mandatperioden kommer att vara avgörande för om Sverige ska lyckas nå klimatmålen. Många viktiga beslut väntar också i arbetet med att skydda och restaurera värdefull natur. Jag ser fram emot att ta mig an dessa saker som ansvarig för klimat- och miljöfrågor
q.t: The coming term will be decisive for whether Sweden will succeed in reaching the climate goals. Many important decisions also await in the work to protect and restore valuable nature. I look forward to taking on these things as responsible for climate and environmental issues

ti: Vänsterpartiet kräver omedelbart stopp för tonårsutvisningarna
s: The Left Party submitted a parliamentary committee initiative on 30 September 2026 to immediately stop deportations of teenagers who grew up in Sweden but are expelled when they turn 18, proposing changes to immigration law including raising the core family age to 21 and reinstating special compassionate grounds for residence permits.

q.o: Vi gick till val på att stoppa tonårsutvisningarna och nu ska vi göra det en gång för alla
q.t: We went to the election on stopping the teenage deportations and now we will do it once and for all

q.o: Det måste gå snabbt. Vi har inte tid att vänta in den allmänna motionstiden eller en ny regering. Framför allt har inte dessa ungdomar den här tiden. Förra mandatperioden stoppades våra förslag eftersom vi inte hade majoritet. Nu har vi det
q.t: It must go quickly. We don't have time to wait for the general motion period or a new government. Above all, these young people don't have this time. Last term our proposals were stopped because we didn't have a majority. Now we do

ti: Govt, Häkkänen survive no-confidence motions - Daily Finland
s: The Finnish government and Minister Häkkänen survived no-confidence motions in parliament.

ti: Carburante: nuovi sconti per settore agricolo e pesca
s: Minister Francesco Lollobrigida announced new fuel discounts of approximately 20% for the agricultural and fishing sectors through an agreement with Eni, adding to existing government measures including tax credits and excise cuts.

q.o: Voglio ringraziare Eni per aver compreso fino in fondo la necessità di sostenere il nostro settore produttivo primario, per quanto possibile, con una tariffa di accesso al carburante che permetta di continuare a svolgere il prezioso compito di custodi dell'ambiente e della sicurezza alimentare italiana.
q.t: I want to thank Eni for having fully understood the need to support our primary productive sector, as much as possible, with a fuel access rate that allows them to continue performing the precious task of guardians of the environment and Italian food security.

q.o: La riduzione dei prezzi, garantita grazie alla scelta dell'azienda, permette alle imprese agricole e della pesca di ottenere uno sconto di circa il 20% sulle tariffe attuali.
q.t: The price reduction, guaranteed thanks to the company's choice, allows agricultural and fishing enterprises to obtain a discount of approximately 20% on current rates.

q.o: L'azione del presidente Meloni si conferma capace di utilizzare al meglio le risorse pubbliche e di coinvolgere a protezione del sistema produttivo il settore privato e, nella totale loro autonomia gestionale e decisionale, le grandi aziende partecipate.
q.t: President Meloni's action confirms itself capable of making the best use of public resources and involving the private sector and, in their total managerial and decision-making autonomy, large state-owned companies in protecting the productive system.

ti: Migranti: sì ad hub in Paesi terzi, Ue adotta linea italiana
s: Brothers of Italy representatives claim vindication as the EU Council approves new return regulations including hubs in third countries, stating this validates Italy's Albania centers approach and proves the left wrong about their legality.

q.o: Con il via libera definitivo del Consiglio dell'Ue alle nuove norme per i rimpatri gli Stati avranno a disposizione strumenti più efficaci per rendere effettivo il rientro degli immigrati irregolari che non hanno diritto a restare nell'Ue, in particolar modo quelli che rappresentano un rischio per la sicurezza.
q.t: With the final approval by the EU Council of the new rules for returns, states will have more effective tools to make the return of irregular immigrants who have no right to remain in the EU effective, especially those who represent a security risk.

q.o: La sinistra che sosteneva che i centri in Albania fossero contrari al diritto Ue, quindi, ha preso l'ennesima cantonata: erano talmente 'illegittimi' che ora è la stessa Ue che propone di realizzarli.
q.t: The left that claimed the centers in Albania were contrary to EU law has therefore made yet another blunder: they were so 'illegitimate' that now the EU itself proposes to create them.

q.o: L'Italia ha dimostrato che si può bloccare l'immigrazione illegale e che subire i flussi migratori gestiti da trafficanti senza scrupoli non è un destino ineluttabile: con Giorgia Meloni abbiamo indicato la rotta in Europa.
q.t: Italy has demonstrated that illegal immigration can be blocked and that suffering migratory flows managed by unscrupulous traffickers is not an inescapable fate: with Giorgia Meloni we have set the course in Europe.

q.o: L'Europa ha deciso di seguire il percorso coraggioso iniziato dal governo Meloni, adottandone la traiettoria e la visione strategica.
q.t: Europe has decided to follow the courageous path initiated by the Meloni government, adopting its trajectory and strategic vision.

ti: Sanità: 800 nuove prestazioni, governo aggiorna livelli essenziali
s: Brothers of Italy senators praised the Meloni government's publication of updated Essential Levels of Assistance (LEA) adding approximately 800 new healthcare services to Italy's National Health Service, crediting Health Minister Schillaci for completing a long-awaited reform covering prevention, oncology, rare diseases, and chronic conditions.

q.o: Con la pubblicazione in Gazzetta Ufficiale dei nuovi Lea, il Servizio sanitario nazionale compie un decisivo passo avanti. L'inserimento di circa 800 nuove prestazioni, servizi e terapie, insieme al superamento di quelle ormai obsolete, consente di adeguare l'offerta sanitaria ai progressi della medicina e alle nuove esigenze dei cittadini.
q.t: With the publication in the Official Gazette of the new LEAs, the National Health Service takes a decisive step forward. The inclusion of approximately 800 new services, treatments and therapies, together with the elimination of those now obsolete, allows the healthcare offering to be adapted to medical progress and the new needs of citizens.

q.o: Dopo anni di sostanziale immobilismo, il governo Meloni, grazie anche al prezioso lavoro del ministro Schillaci, porta a compimento un aggiornamento atteso da tempo.
q.t: After years of substantial immobility, the Meloni government, thanks also to the valuable work of Minister Schillaci, completes a long-awaited update.

q.o: L'aggiornamento dei Livelli essenziali di assistenza rappresenta un passo importante per rendere il Servizio sanitario nazionale più moderno e vicino ai bisogni dei cittadini.
q.t: The update of the Essential Levels of Assistance represents an important step to make the National Health Service more modern and closer to the needs of citizens.

ti: Rai: riforma rende servizio pubblico moderno e plurale
s: Brothers of Italy members of the RAI oversight commission welcomed committee approval of RAI reform legislation that restructures governance to give Parliament 4 of 7 board seats, employees 1 seat, and the Ministry of Economy only 2 seats, claiming this reverses the 2015 Renzi law's executive control and aligns with European Media Freedom Act requirements.

q.o: Accogliamo con soddisfazione l'approvazione in Commissione della riforma della Rai. Si tratta di un passaggio storico che finalmente sana un vulnus aperto oltre dieci anni fa con la legge Renzi e che il centrosinistra quando era al governo non ha mai voluto riformare.
q.t: We welcome with satisfaction the committee approval of the RAI reform. This is a historic step that finally heals a wound opened over ten years ago with the Renzi law and that the center-left when in government never wanted to reform.

q.o: Con le nuove norme, non sarà più l'esecutivo a decidere l'Amministratore Delegato in solitaria, bensì il Consiglio di amministrazione nella sua piena ed esclusiva autonomia statutaria.
q.t: With the new rules, it will no longer be the executive deciding the CEO alone, but rather the Board of Directors in its full and exclusive statutory autonomy.

q.o: Il Parlamento esprimerà 4 consiglieri su 7, 1 consigliere sarà indicato direttamente dai dipendenti dell'azienda, mentre il Ministero dell'Economia e delle Finanze, nella sua veste tecnica di azionista pubblico, ne designerà soltanto 2.
q.t: Parliament will appoint 4 out of 7 board members, 1 board member will be indicated directly by company employees, while the Ministry of Economy and Finance, in its technical role as public shareholder, will designate only 2.

ti: Pubblica amministrazione: decreto rafforza efficienza e qualità dei servizi
s: Brothers of Italy senators announce final approval of a public administration decree that extends municipal reporting deadlines, creates a 187.5 million euro fund for disability and poverty support, reserves up to 20% of public sector positions for flexible contract workers, restores vacation pay indemnities, and authorizes 500 additional State Police hires.

q.o: Con l'approvazione definitiva del decreto Pa il Governo Meloni e la maggioranza mantengono un impegno preso con i territori.
q.t: With the final approval of the PA decree, the Meloni Government and the majority keep a commitment made to the territories.

q.o: Il nuovo fondo da 187,5 milioni presso il Ministero del Lavoro sosterrà almeno 5.000 persone con disabilità e 25.000 in grave deprivazione materiale.
q.t: The new fund of 187.5 million at the Ministry of Labor will support at least 5,000 people with disabilities and 25,000 in severe material deprivation.

q.o: Nei concorsi indetti entro il 2027, le amministrazioni potranno riservare fino al 20 per cento dei posti a chi ha lavorato per loro almeno tre anni negli ultimi cinque con contratti flessibili.
q.t: In competitions announced by 2027, administrations will be able to reserve up to 20 percent of positions for those who have worked for them at least three years in the last five with flexible contracts.

ti: Università: riforma consiglio nazionale migliora rappresentanza componenti
s: Brothers of Italy Senator Ella Bucalo announced the approval of a reform to the National University Council (CUN) that updates its composition and representation, including a Brothers of Italy amendment specifying election procedures for academic representatives and increasing student representation from 13.7% to 18.4%.

q.o: Con l'approvazione della riforma del Consiglio Universitario Nazionale si aggiorna un organismo centrale per il sistema universitario italiano, adeguandone composizione, rappresentanza e funzioni all'evoluzione dell'università degli ultimi anni.
q.t: With the approval of the reform of the National University Council, a central body for the Italian university system is updated, adapting its composition, representation and functions to the evolution of universities in recent years.

q.o: In questo quadro si inserisce l'emendamento di Fratelli d'Italia a mia firma, approvato, con il quale abbiamo precisato che, per ciascuna delle 14 aree disciplinari, viene eletto un professore ordinario e un secondo rappresentante scelto tra professori associati e ricercatori universitari, compresi quelli a tempo determinato.
q.t: In this framework, the Brothers of Italy amendment signed by me, which was approved, specifies that for each of the 14 disciplinary areas, a full professor is elected and a second representative chosen from associate professors and university researchers, including those on fixed-term contracts.

q.o: Un'attenzione particolare è stata dedicata anche alla componente studentesca: i rappresentanti passano da otto a sette, ma il loro peso all'interno del Cun cresce dal 13,7% al 18,4%.
q.t: Particular attention has also been paid to the student component: representatives go from eight to seven, but their weight within the CUN increases from 13.7% to 18.4%.

ti: Droga: stretta su furti fentanyl e allerta per cannabis potenziata
s: Undersecretary to the Prime Minister Alfredo Mantovano announced a new Health Ministry circular published in the Official Gazette establishing security rules for fentanyl custody in healthcare facilities after 39 thefts occurred from the start of 2025 to August, and warned about increased THC potency in cannabis rising from 1.5-2% to an average of 30%.

q.o: Per questo è stata pubblicata sulla Gazzetta ufficiale una circolare del Ministero della Salute che supera la frammentazione della gestione del fenomeno e muta la prospettiva: fissa una serie di regole per la sicurezza, la custodia e la tracciabilità
q.t: For this reason a circular from the Ministry of Health has been published in the Official Gazette that overcomes the fragmentation of managing the phenomenon and changes the perspective: it establishes a series of rules for security, custody and traceability

q.o: Continua a essere sottovalutata la pericolosità delle droghe cosiddette leggere, senza comprendere che in passato il Thc, il principio attivo della cannabis, era presente a una percentuale media dell'1,5-2 per cento. Oggi è arrivato alla media del 30
q.t: The danger of so-called light drugs continues to be underestimated, without understanding that in the past THC, the active ingredient of cannabis, was present at an average percentage of 1.5-2 percent. Today it has reached an average of 30

q.o: Dalla relazione annuale del Dipartimento Antidroga della Presidenza del Consiglio risulta che nella fascia di età 15-19 anni, 37 ragazzi su 100 dichiarano di aver assunto sostanze stupefacenti almeno una volta nella loro vita, e 25 di averlo fatto nell'ultimo anno
q.t: From the annual report of the Anti-Drug Department of the Presidency of the Council it emerges that in the 15-19 age group, 37 out of 100 young people declare having taken drugs at least once in their life, and 25 having done so in the last year

ti: Covid: con Arcuri clamorose falle e sperpero denaro pubblico
s: Brothers of Italy deputy Francesco Filini criticized former Covid commissioner Domenico Arcuri's management during a Covid commission hearing, highlighting successor General Figliuolo's testimony about discontinuing large contracts, intermediaries, and advance payments that characterized Arcuri's tenure, including 1.25 billion euros spent on 800 million masks.

q.o: Le più clamorose falle della gestione della pandemia di Covid da parte della struttura commissariale di Domenico Arcuri sono emerse oggi, in tutta la loro gravità, durante l'audizione in commissione Covid del generale Francesco Paolo Figliuolo, successore di Arcuri alla guida della struttura commissariale.
q.t: The most glaring failures in the management of the Covid pandemic by Domenico Arcuri's commissarial structure emerged today, in all their gravity, during the Covid commission hearing of General Francesco Paolo Figliuolo, Arcuri's successor as head of the commissarial structure.

q.o: Perché Arcuri non seguì questa elementare prassi considerando che maneggiava rilevanti cifre di soldi pubblici?
q.t: Why did Arcuri not follow this elementary practice considering that he was handling significant amounts of public money?

ti: La Settimana Leghista #39 - Lega per Salvini Premier
s: The League newsletter announces parliamentary approval of their resolution to increase military presence in cities to 10,000 units, proposes a European Parliament resolution to list the Muslim Brotherhood as a terrorist organization, announces six new repatriation centers, defends a mayor who suspended citizenship for a Moroccan woman over language requirements, and sets October 24-25 in Milan for an extraordinary party congress.

q.o: Diecimila. Dopo mesi di insulti, di minacce, di polemiche, ce l'abbiamo finalmente fatta. Con la sinistra bla bla, con la Lega si fa.
q.t: Ten thousand. After months of insults, threats, controversies, we finally did it. With the left blah blah, with the League it gets done.

q.o: In Italia nessuna applicazione dell'eurofollia delle 'case green'. C'è da chiedersi su quale pianeta vivano i burocrati di Bruxelles e se abbiano la minima idea delle difficoltà che devono affrontare famiglie e imprese.
q.t: In Italy no application of the euro-madness of 'green homes'. One has to wonder on what planet the Brussels bureaucrats live and whether they have the slightest idea of the difficulties that families and businesses must face.

q.o: Nessuna intenzione di imporre alle famiglie italiane una nuova stangata europea da decine di migliaia di euro. La casa degli italiani non si tocca.
q.t: No intention of imposing on Italian families a new European blow of tens of thousands of euros. Italian homes are not to be touched.

q.o: L'allarme rosso è stato lanciato dalle intelligence di mezza Europa: a rischio c'è la tenuta delle nostre istituzioni democratiche.
q.t: Red alert has been launched by the intelligence services of half of Europe: at risk is the stability of our democratic institutions.
q.sp: Anna Maria Cisint, Susanna Ceccardi, Silvia Sardone

q.o: Bene l'avvio dell'iter per sei nuovi CPR sul territorio nazionale annunciato dal ministro Piantedosi. Per la Lega, i CPR sono uno strumento imprescindibile per contrastare l'immigrazione clandestina e rendere effettive le espulsioni.
q.t: Good news on the start of the process for six new repatriation centers on national territory announced by Minister Piantedosi. For the League, repatriation centers are an indispensable tool to combat illegal immigration and make expulsions effective.

q.o: Mi stupisce chi in questi giorni parla di razzismo. L'ottimo sindaco di Cadoneghe ha semplicemente fatto rispettare la legge.
q.t: I am surprised by those who these days speak of racism. The excellent mayor of Cadoneghe simply enforced the law.

q.o: Oggi raggiungiamo un traguardo storico e concreto: portare subito da 6.800 a 10.000 unità il contingente impegnato nell'operazione Strade Sicure.
q.t: Today we reach a historic and concrete milestone: immediately bringing the contingent engaged in Operation Safe Streets from 6,800 to 10,000 units.

s: PCP Secretary-General Paulo Raimundo announced a series of parliamentary bills and resolutions at the party's parliamentary conference focused on children's and parents' rights, including proposals for a public crèche network, universal child benefit restoration, and workplace protections for working parents.

q.o: pela primeira vez e pela mão do PCP umas jornadas parlamentares foram inteiramente dedicadas aos direitos dos pais e das crianças
q.t: for the first time and by the hand of the PCP, parliamentary conference days were entirely dedicated to the rights of parents and children

q.o: Avançaremos, mais uma vez, com o projecto de lei de criação da rede pública de creches, que visa a criação de 100 mil vagas nos próximos quatro anos
q.t: We will advance, once again, with the bill to create a public crèche network, which aims to create 100,000 places over the next four years

q.o: o PCP apresentará um projecto de lei que visa a comparticipação a 100% na aquisição de óculos, lentes, aparelhos ortodônticos ou de material ortopédico para as crianças e jovens até aos 18 anos
q.t: the PCP will present a bill that aims for 100% co-payment in the acquisition of glasses, lenses, orthodontic appliances or orthopedic material for children and young people up to 18 years old

q.o: não vamos desistir como vamos insistir pela gratuitidade dos livros de fichas e das refeições escolares
q.t: we will not give up and we will insist on free workbooks and school meals
