ti: Alternative Budget 2027
s: People Before Profit launched their Alternative Budget 2027 on 2 October 2026, proposing to tax multi-millionaires to create an affordable Ireland and criticizing the Fianna Fáil and Fine Gael government's Budget 2026 for removing cost-of-living supports and increasing student fees.

q.o: Recently it was found that the supermajority of people in the Ireland (95%) would have been better off under our Alternative Budget than the Government's or parties like Sinn Féin, Labour or Social Democrats.
q.t: Recently it was found that the supermajority of people in the Ireland (95%) would have been better off under our Alternative Budget than the Government's or parties like Sinn Féin, Labour or Social Democrats.

ti: People Before Profit launch Alternative Budget 2027 - "For an Affordable Ireland - Tax the Multi-Millionaires"
s: People Before Profit launched their Alternative Budget 2027 at Buswells Hotel proposing to raise €45 billion through wealth taxes on multi-millionaires, higher corporation tax, and a financial transactions tax to fund public sector pay increases, housing, free childcare and education, and climate measures.

q.o: Today we launch our alternative Budget 2027 proposals 'For an Affordable Ireland - Tax the Multi-millionaires'.
q.t: Today we launch our alternative Budget 2027 proposals 'For an Affordable Ireland - Tax the Multi-millionaires'.

q.o: We now have 11 billionaires in Ireland who have more wealth than 3,500,000 people combined.
q.t: We now have 11 billionaires in Ireland who have more wealth than 3,500,000 people combined.

q.o: Budget 2026 was a disaster for workers and families, and people with disabilities were left €1,400 worse off.
q.t: Budget 2026 was a disaster for workers and families, and people with disabilities were left €1,400 worse off.

q.o: We propose radical plans to widen the tax base through a multi-millionaires tax and by introducing a financial translations tax. We also propose to introduce higher income tax rates for very high earners, and increase the effective corporation tax rate to 20%.
q.t: We propose radical plans to widen the tax base through a multi-millionaires tax and by introducing a financial translations tax. We also propose to introduce higher income tax rates for very high earners, and increase the effective corporation tax rate to 20%.

q.o: These measures alone would raise an additional €45 billion, which is more than enough to pay public sector workers a 10% increase, end poverty for people with disabilities, abolish third-level and childcare fees, and triple spending on public housing.
q.t: These measures alone would raise an additional €45 billion, which is more than enough to pay public sector workers a 10% increase, end poverty for people with disabilities, abolish third-level and childcare fees, and triple spending on public housing.

q.o: The surging popularity of Die Linke in Germany, the DSA in the United States and Mélenchon in France shows a growing appetite for radical and socialist change across the world. That appetite exists here too and our proposals are a response to that.
q.t: The surging popularity of Die Linke in Germany, the DSA in the United States and Mélenchon in France shows a growing appetite for radical and socialist change across the world. That appetite exists here too and our proposals are a response to that.

q.o: Ordinary people are under enormous financial strain and need support. We are proposing a range of measures to tackle the cost of living crisis, including a €500 electricity credit for every household funded by an electricity consumption levy on data centres.
q.t: Ordinary people are under enormous financial strain and need support. We are proposing a range of measures to tackle the cost of living crisis, including a €500 electricity credit for every household funded by an electricity consumption levy on data centres.

q.o: Despite the unfolding catastrophe, the government refuses to take the anti-capitalist measures necessary to reduce emissions and reduce energy and transport costs for people.
q.t: Despite the unfolding catastrophe, the government refuses to take the anti-capitalist measures necessary to reduce emissions and reduce energy and transport costs for people.

q.o: Our budget also includes a proposal for the acquisition of 500 additional electric buses and for the hiring of the bus workers needed to get these buses on the road.
q.t: Our budget also includes a proposal for the acquisition of 500 additional electric buses and for the hiring of the bus workers needed to get these buses on the road.

ti: Think Left Conference This Weekend in Derry
s: People Before Profit is hosting its annual Think Left Conference from October 2-5, 2026 in St Columb's Hall, Derry, featuring international speakers, discussions on workers' campaigns, Palestine solidarity, political unionism, Stormont's future, and socialist feminist perspectives on Irish unity.

q.o: This year's Think Left Conference comes at a crucial moment. The conference will deal directly with the big questions we face locally and internationally.
q.t: This year's Think Left Conference comes at a crucial moment. The conference will deal directly with the big questions we face locally and internationally.

q.o: Socialist MLA Gerry Carroll will discuss Stormont's future in the midst of resolute opposition from Garvaghy Road residents to a sectarian Orange Order march, racist pogroms, cuts to public services, MLA pay scandals and budget crisis.
q.t: Socialist MLA Gerry Carroll will discuss Stormont's future in the midst of resolute opposition from Garvaghy Road residents to a sectarian Orange Order march, racist pogroms, cuts to public services, MLA pay scandals and budget crisis.

ti: Councillor Takes High Court Legal Challenge as Council Executive Refuse to Implement 15-to-1 Vote to Halt Rent Increases
s: People Before Profit Councillor Jess Spear has launched a High Court judicial review against South Dublin County Council after its chief executive refused to implement a 15-to-1 council vote to halt rent increases of up to 53% for social housing tenants.

q.o: The law is very clear on this. The Chief Executive has to follow council policy, and he has to abide by Section 140 motions. Civil servants, no matter how senior, are not a law unto themselves. Ploughing ahead with a rent hike against the express wishes of the elected members looks like a clear and reckless violation of the Local Government Act.
q.t: The law is very clear on this. The Chief Executive has to follow council policy, and he has to abide by Section 140 motions. Civil servants, no matter how senior, are not a law unto themselves. Ploughing ahead with a rent hike against the express wishes of the elected members looks like a clear and reckless violation of the Local Government Act.

q.o: What is happening in South Dublin should alarm anyone who cares about local democracy. Councillors voted not once but twice on this, and an unelected official has decided to override them. If a Chief Executive can simply ignore a Section 140 motion, then what local democracy do we have left at all?
q.t: What is happening in South Dublin should alarm anyone who cares about local democracy. Councillors voted not once but twice on this, and an unelected official has decided to override them. If a Chief Executive can simply ignore a Section 140 motion, then what local democracy do we have left at all?

q.o: This is about finding a better way to fund local services, one that doesn't impoverish lone parents, pensioners and working families.
q.t: This is about finding a better way to fund local services, one that doesn't impoverish lone parents, pensioners and working families.

ti: Erhöhung der Krankenkassenprämien: Die Bevölkerung darf nicht die Zeche zahlen!
s: The Swiss Party of Labour condemns the announced five percent increase in health insurance premiums for 2027 and demands fundamental healthcare policy reform including a public health service, income-based financing, and a national health plan.

q.o: Diese erneute Erhöhung der Krankenkassenprämien ist die unvermeidliche Folge eines Systems, das von Grund auf intransparent und unsozial ist und es einer Vielzahl privater Interessen ermöglicht, sich auf Kosten der Versicherten und einer am Gemeinwohl orientierten Gesundheitspolitik die Taschen zu füllen
q.t: This renewed increase in health insurance premiums is the inevitable consequence of a system that is fundamentally non-transparent and anti-social and allows a multitude of private interests to line their pockets at the expense of the insured and a health policy oriented toward the common good

q.o: Es ist absolut notwendig, die Strategie zu ändern und einen öffentlichen Gesundheitsdienst aufzubauen, der nicht von privaten Akteuren kontrolliert wird und nicht in einem kapitalistischen Wettbewerb steht, dessen oberstes Ziel die Profitmaximierung ist
q.t: It is absolutely necessary to change the strategy and build a public health service that is not controlled by private actors and does not stand in capitalist competition whose supreme goal is profit maximization

q.o: Deshalb müssen wir die Grundversorgung und die aktive Prävention ausbauen sowie einen nationalen Gesundheitsplan und eine einkommensabhängige Finanzierung schaffen
q.t: Therefore we must expand basic care and active prevention as well as create a national health plan and income-based financing

ti: Stoppt die Repression in der Türkei
s: The Swiss Party of Labour condemns repression against socialists, LGBTQ+ community, and activists in Turkey following police raids, and expresses solidarity with its sister party SYKP and its co-chair Mertcan Titiz who was arrested during a house search and later released.

q.o: Die Partei der Arbeit der Schweiz (PdAS) verurteilt das repressive Vorgehen gegen Sozialist:innen, die LGBTQ+-Gemeinschaft und Aktivist:innen in der Türkei.
q.t: The Swiss Party of Labour (PdAS) condemns the repressive actions against socialists, the LGBTQ+ community and activists in Turkey.

q.o: Die PdAS stimmt der SYKP zu, dass willkürliche Inhaftierungen, Unterdrückung und Gewalt gegen Revolutionär:innen, Sozialist:innen und demokratische Oppositionskräfte sofort ein Ende finden müssen.
q.t: The PdAS agrees with SYKP that arbitrary detentions, suppression and violence against revolutionaries, socialists and democratic opposition forces must end immediately.

ti: «Der Kampf für soziale Gerechtigkeit geht weiter»
s: The Swiss Party of Labour announced the death of Norberto Crivelli, former party president (2009-2013) and Central Committee member, expressing condolences and commemorating his lifelong activism for workers' rights and against capitalism.

q.o: Der Kampf für soziale Gerechtigkeit geht weiter
q.t: The struggle for social justice continues

q.o: Norberto hat sein gesamtes Leben dem Kampf für die Rechte der Unterdrückten und Ausgebeuteten gewidmet und – auch hinter den Kulissen – unermüdlich gegen das Ungeheuer des Kapitalismus angekämpft.
q.t: Norberto dedicated his entire life to the struggle for the rights of the oppressed and exploited and – also behind the scenes – tirelessly fought against the monster of capitalism.

q.o: Norberto war die Seele der Partei im Tessin, stets präsent, und es gelang ihm, die kommunistische Identität auch in den schwierigsten Momenten hochzuhalten.
q.t: Norberto was the soul of the party in Ticino, always present, and he succeeded in upholding the communist identity even in the most difficult moments.

ti: Δ. Νατσιός: Ποιον “μακεδονικό πολιτισμό”, κυρία φον ντερ Λάιεν, και ποια “μακεδονική γλώσσα”;
s: NIKH president Dimitris Natsios issued a statement criticizing Ursula von der Leyen's references to "Macedonian culture" and "Macedonian language," reaffirming the party's position for immediate abolition of the Prespa Agreement without asterisks.

q.o: Τσίπρας και Μητσοτάκης έσπειραν ανέμους και σήμερα η Ελλάδα θερίζει θύελλες. Ο πρώτος υπέγραψε την προδοτική Συμφωνία των Πρεσπών, παραχωρώντας «μακεδονική» γλώσσα και ταυτότητα. Ο δεύτερος την κατήγγειλε ως αντιπολίτευση, αλλά ως Πρωθυπουργός την εφαρμόζει και στηρίζει σταθερά την ευρωπαϊκή προοπτική των Σκοπίων.
q.t: Tsipras and Mitsotakis sowed winds and today Greece reaps storms. The first signed the treacherous Prespa Agreement, conceding 'Macedonian' language and identity. The second denounced it as opposition, but as Prime Minister implements it and firmly supports the European perspective of Skopje.

q.o: Ποιον "μακεδονικό πολιτισμό", κυρία φον ντερ Λάιεν; Και ποια "μακεδονική γλώσσα";
q.t: What 'Macedonian culture', Mrs. von der Leyen? And what 'Macedonian language'?

q.o: Η θέση της ΝΙΚΗΣ είναι ξεκάθαρη, όπως κατατέθηκε στην πρόταση νόμου για κατάργηση της Συμφωνίας των Πρεσπών άμεσα και χωρίς αστερίσκους. Η Μακεδονία δεν χαρίζεται. Η Ιστορία της δεν εκχωρείται. Τελεία.
q.t: NIKH's position is clear, as submitted in the bill for abolition of the Prespa Agreement immediately and without asterisks. Macedonia is not given away. Its History is not ceded. Period.

ti: Στεγαστική κρίση στην τρίτη ηλικία: Οι «άριστοι» οδηγούν παππούδες και γιαγιάδες στην εξαθλίωση
s: Democratic Patriotic Movement – Victory criticizes the Mitsotakis government over housing crisis affecting elderly Greeks, citing data showing 31.8% of those over 65 face housing cost burdens exceeding 40% of income, and demands protection for low-income pensioners and an end to pension cuts.

q.o: Για την κυβέρνηση Μητσοτάκη, που ωθεί νέους και οικογένειες στην απόγνωση και τη φυγή, οι ηλικιωμένοι μάλλον μοιάζουν… περιττοί!
q.t: For the Mitsotakis government, which pushes young people and families to despair and flight, the elderly seem... superfluous!

q.o: Η ΝΙΚΗ δεν αντιμετωπίζει την τρίτη ηλικία ως οικονομικό βάρος.
q.t: NIKH does not treat the elderly as an economic burden.

q.o: Είναι εθνικό μας καθήκον να προστατεύσουμε την τρίτη ηλικία.
q.t: It is our national duty to protect the elderly.

ti: Η ΝΙΚΗ τίμησε τη μνήμη των Ελλήνων Ποντίων που εκτελέστηκαν από τα «Δικαστήρια Ανεξαρτησίας» της Αμάσειας
s: NIKI Thessaloniki laid a wreath at the statue of Nikos Kapetanidis to honor the memory of Pontic Greeks executed by the Kemalist regime's "Independence Courts" of Amasya in 1921.

q.o: Εγώ δεν ήθελα την ανεξαρτησία του Πόντου, ήθελα την απευθείας ένωσή του με την Ελλάδα.
q.t: I did not want the independence of Pontus, I wanted its direct union with Greece.

q.o: Διατηρούμε ζωντανή την ιστορική μνήμη και αποτίουμε τον οφειλόμενο φόρο τιμής στους μάρτυρες του Ποντιακού Ελληνισμού, οι οποίοι θυσιάστηκαν για την πίστη και την Πατρίδα.
q.t: We keep historical memory alive and pay the owed tribute to the martyrs of Pontic Hellenism, who sacrificed themselves for faith and Fatherland.

ti: Να ληφθούν έκτακτα μέτρα ανακούφισης και να αξιοποιηθούν οι παρεκκλίσεις για τον αφθώδη πυρετό στη Λέσβο
s: SYRIZA MEP Kostas Arvanitis submitted a written question to the European Commission requesting emergency relief measures and utilization of regulatory derogations to protect livestock farming on Lesvos following a prolonged foot-and-mouth disease outbreak.

q.o: Την ανάγκη αξιοποίησης όλων των διαθέσιμων δυνατοτήτων που προβλέπει η ευρωπαϊκή νομοθεσία για την προστασία της κτηνοτροφίας στη Λέσβο, μετά την παρατεταμένη επιζωοτία αφθώδους πυρετού, αναδεικνύει με νέα ερώτησή του προς την Ευρωπαϊκή Επιτροπή ο ευρωβουλευτής του ΣΥΡΙΖΑ και Αντιπρόεδρος της LEFT, Κώστας Αρβανίτης.
q.t: The need to utilize all available possibilities provided by European legislation for the protection of livestock farming on Lesvos, following the prolonged foot-and-mouth disease outbreak, is highlighted by SYRIZA MEP and Vice-President of the LEFT, Kostas Arvanitis, with a new question to the European Commission.

q.o: Σε μια κατάσταση που απειλεί όχι μόνο το ζωικό κεφάλαιο αλλά και την ίδια την παραγωγική συνέχεια του νησιού, είναι κρίσιμο να αξιοποιηθούν πλήρως οι δυνατότητες που προβλέπει το ευρωπαϊκό κανονιστικό πλαίσιο.
q.t: In a situation that threatens not only the livestock but also the productive continuity of the island itself, it is critical to fully utilize the possibilities provided by the European regulatory framework.

ti: Ν. Παππάς για προσχέδιο προϋπολογισμού: «300.000 συνταξιούχοι δουλεύουν επειδή η κυβέρνηση αρνείται να επαναφέρει τη 13η σύνταξη»
s: SYRIZA-PS Secretary Nikos Pappas criticized the government's draft budget for refusing to restore the 13th pension despite surpluses, stating that 300,000 pensioners are forced to work to make ends meet.

q.o: 300.000 συνταξιούχοι εργάζονται για να βγει ο μήνας. Και σε αυτό το προσχέδιο προϋπολογισμού η κυβέρνηση αρνείται να επαναφέρει τη 13η σύνταξη, παρά τα μεγάλα πλεονάσματα και τις ευελιξίες.
q.t: 300,000 pensioners are working to make ends meet. And in this draft budget the government refuses to restore the 13th pension, despite the large surpluses and flexibilities.

ti: Die HEIMAT Grundsatzprogramm: Einstimmig beschlossen
s: Die HEIMAT party unanimously adopted a new foundational programme at an extraordinary federal party congress on 3-4 October 2026 in northern Saxony, the first such programme in nearly 16 years, which includes positions on ethnocultural national identity, remigration, EU and NATO withdrawal, and energy policy, alongside a memorial ceremony for former party chairman Udo Voigt.

q.o: Das neue Grundsatzprogramm wurde einstimmig im wahrsten Sinne des Wortes angenommen – es gab weder eine einzige Gegenstimme noch eine einzige Enthaltung!
q.t: The new foundational programme was adopted unanimously in the truest sense of the word – there was not a single vote against nor a single abstention!

q.o: Das deutsche Volk wird klar als gewachsene ethnokulturelle Gemeinschaft aus Herkunft, Sprache, Kultur und Schicksal definiert. Wir bekennen uns zu einem humanistischen Nationalismus: Jedes Volk hat das Recht, es selbst zu bleiben.
q.t: The German people are clearly defined as an evolved ethnocultural community of origin, language, culture and destiny. We profess a humanistic nationalism: Every people has the right to remain itself.

q.o: Die Partei DIE HEIMAT fordert unmissverständlich den Austritt Deutschlands aus der Europäischen Union (EU).
q.t: The party DIE HEIMAT unequivocally demands Germany's withdrawal from the European Union (EU).

q.o: Sozial geht nur national!
q.t: Social is only possible nationally!

q.t: Through defections of several former AfD members to the party Die HEIMAT in Werra-Meißner-Kreis, the authentic national opposition party is now represented with two delegates in the district council as well as with two mandates in the city assembly of Wanfried.

q.o: Die HEIMAT reicht jedem Patrioten die Hand, der sich konstruktiv für unser Volk einsetzen möchte.
q.t: Die HEIMAT extends a hand to every patriot who wants to work constructively for our people.

ti: Que fait France Télévision des données de ses spectateurs ?
s: France Unbowed parliamentary group demands immediate hearing of France Télévision CEO Delphine Ernotte before the National Assembly's cultural affairs committee and requests a CNIL investigation into France Télévision's near-transfer of viewer data to Israeli company Terrific.

q.o: Afin de faire toute la lumière sur cette affaire qui pourrait être le précurseur d'une véritable opération d'ingérence, le groupe de la France insoumise demande l'audition immédiate de Delphine Ernotte, PDG de France Télévision et des salaries qui ont eu à traiter de ce sujet, devant la commission des affaires culturelles de l'Assemblée nationale et l'ouverture d'une enquête par la CNIL
q.t: In order to shed full light on this affair which could be the precursor to a genuine interference operation, the France Unbowed group demands the immediate hearing of Delphine Ernotte, CEO of France Télévision and the employees who dealt with this subject, before the National Assembly's cultural affairs committee and the opening of an investigation by the CNIL

q.o: Après les ingérences israéliennes contre ses candidats aux élections municipales, la France insoumise agira avec vigilance et détermination contre toutes les tentatives de manipulation du débat démocratique et presse le gouvernement d'agir afin de garantir l'intégrité des élections à venir.
q.t: After Israeli interference against its candidates in municipal elections, France Unbowed will act with vigilance and determination against all attempts to manipulate democratic debate and urges the government to act to guarantee the integrity of upcoming elections.

ti: Bundeskanzler Stocker muss Chaos-Koalition sofort beenden
s: FPÖ General Secretary Michael Schnedlitz demands immediate new elections and an end to the ÖVP-SPÖ coalition government, criticizing SPÖ internal chaos and Chancellor Stocker for maintaining the coalition.

q.o: Was sich in diesem roten Marxisten-Stadel abspielt, ist ein unwürdiges Schauspiel am Rücken der österreichischen Steuerzahler. Die SPÖ missbraucht unsere Republik als Reha-Klinik für gescheiterte linke Träumer und Sesselkleber.
q.t: What is happening in this red Marxist barn is an undignified spectacle at the expense of Austrian taxpayers. The SPÖ is abusing our Republic as a rehab clinic for failed left-wing dreamers and seat-clingers.

q.o: ÖVP-Kanzler Christian Stocker darf diesem Kasperltheater nicht länger tatenlos zuschauen, nur weil ihm sein eigener Kanzlersessel anscheinend wichtiger ist als das Wohl unserer Heimat.
q.t: ÖVP Chancellor Christian Stocker must not continue to watch this puppet theater idly, just because his own chancellor's seat is apparently more important to him than the welfare of our homeland.

q.o: Die Österreicher haben genug von diesem Postengeschacher und diesen ständigen Koalitions-Streitereien. Diese Regierung ist ein Totalschaden. Es braucht jetzt den rot-weiß-roten Befreiungsschlag durch rasche Neuwahlen und einen freiheitlichen Volkskanzler, der endlich wieder für die eigene Bevölkerung arbeitet!
q.t: Austrians have had enough of this position-trading and these constant coalition disputes. This government is a total loss. What is needed now is the red-white-red liberation strike through rapid new elections and a Freedom Party people's chancellor who finally works for our own population again!

ti: Lagerhaus-Kahlschlag: Fisch beginnt am Kopf zu stinken
s: FPÖ agricultural spokesperson Peter Schmiedlechner criticized the planned closure of two Raiffeisen Lagerhaus locations and dismissal of over 100 of 460 employees, demanding accountability from management and ÖVP officials and calling for a comprehensive social plan if jobs cannot be saved.

q.o: Jetzt müssen nicht nur Management, Vorstand und Aufsichtsrat Rede und Antwort stehen. In diesem Fall kann man nicht einfach so zur Tagesordnung übergehen. Denn: Es geht nicht nur um Zahlen auf dem Papier, sondern um Arbeitsplätze, Existenzen, Familien und um über Jahrzehnte gewachsene regionale Strukturen
q.t: Now not only management, board and supervisory board must answer questions. In this case one cannot simply move on to business as usual. Because: It's not just about numbers on paper, but about jobs, livelihoods, families and regional structures that have grown over decades

q.o: Regionalität darf kein ÖVP-Wahlkampf-Slogan sein. Wer Regionalität predigt, muss auch für Regionalität kämpfen, wenn es ernst wird
q.t: Regionality must not be an ÖVP campaign slogan. Whoever preaches regionality must also fight for regionality when things get serious

q.o: Aufsichtsrat kommt von Aufsicht. Ein solcher Posten ist kein Schmuckstück für die Visitenkarte und kein Versorgungsposten für Funktionäre. Wer Verantwortung übernimmt, muss kontrollieren, hinterfragen und notfalls einschreiten
q.t: Supervisory board comes from supervision. Such a position is not a decoration for the business card and not a sinecure for functionaries. Whoever assumes responsibility must control, question and if necessary intervene

ti: News
s: The Freedom Party of Austria issued multiple parliamentary interventions and public statements criticizing the ÖVP government's agricultural policies, including demands for ministerial resignations over drought relief measures, opposition to EU Mercosur and renaturalization policies, and accusations that the government prioritizes foreign aid over domestic farmers.

q.o: ÖVP muss um Standorte und Jobs kämpfen, statt zur Tagesordnung überzugehen.
q.t: The ÖVP must fight for locations and jobs instead of moving on to the next item on the agenda.

q.o: Preisexplosion bei Pellets entlarvt den Klima-Wahn
q.t: Price explosion in pellets exposes the climate madness

q.o: FPÖ fordert sofortigen Rücktritt von Totschnig und Strasser
q.t: FPÖ demands immediate resignation of Totschnig and Strasser

q.o: Grüne blockieren FPÖ-Sondersitzung zur Dürre-Krise. Für das Ausland gibt es Millionen, doch unsere Landwirte lässt man eiskalt im Stich. Nur die FPÖ…
q.t: Greens block FPÖ special session on drought crisis. There are millions for foreign countries, but our farmers are left out in the cold. Only the FPÖ…

ti: Neuwahlen jetzt!
s: FPÖ General Secretary Michael Schnedlitz demands immediate new elections and the end of the ÖVP-SPÖ-NEOS coalition government, citing SPÖ internal crisis and alleged inability to govern, calling for Herbert Kickl as 'Volkskanzler'.

q.o: Sollte Babler gehen, dann muss auch diese gesamte Verlierer-Koalition endgültig zusammenpacken
q.t: If Babler goes, then this entire loser coalition must finally pack up

q.o: In ihrer aktuellen Verfassung ist die SPÖ schlichtweg nicht regierungsfähig
q.t: In its current state, the SPÖ is simply not capable of governing

q.o: Dieses schwarz-rot-pinke Gesamtkonstrukt ist pures Gift für Österreich!
q.t: This black-red-pink overall construct is pure poison for Austria!

q.o: Es braucht jetzt sofortige Neuwahlen und einen Volkskanzler Herbert Kickl, der Österreich und seine Bürger wieder an die erste Stelle setzt
q.t: What is needed now are immediate new elections and a people's chancellor Herbert Kickl, who puts Austria and its citizens first again

ti: SPÖ als Regierungspartei völlig untragbar
s: FPÖ General Secretary Michael Schnedlitz called for immediate new elections, declaring the SPÖ unfit to govern due to internal crisis and demanding that Herbert Kickl as 'Volkskanzler' replace the current coalition government.

q.o: Die SPÖ stürzt selbst in die absolute Bedeutungslosigkeit. Diese Truppe, die aktuell nur noch mit sich selbst beschäftigt ist, hat zurzeit schlichtweg keine Kapazitäten, um zu regieren. So ist die SPÖ mittlerweile mehr eine rote Selbsthilfegruppe als eine politische Partei
q.t: The SPÖ is plunging itself into absolute irrelevance. This group, which is currently only occupied with itself, simply has no capacity to govern at the moment. The SPÖ has now become more of a red self-help group than a political party

q.o: Mit einer Selbsthilfegruppe ist zurzeit einfach kein Staat zu machen. Österreich braucht keine Politiker, die aktuell nur um Posten schachern, sondern eine Führung, die für die eigene Bevölkerung arbeitet. Es braucht sofortige Neuwahlen und einen Volkskanzler Herbert Kickl, um den rot-schwarz-pinken Scherbenhaufen endlich wegzuräumen!
q.t: You cannot run a state with a self-help group at the moment. Austria does not need politicians who are currently only haggling over positions, but leadership that works for its own population. Immediate new elections are needed and a People's Chancellor Herbert Kickl to finally clear away the red-black-pink pile of rubble!

ti: SPÖ im freien Fall: Nach gebrochenen Wahlversprechen flüchten jetzt die Kandidaten
s: FPÖ General Secretary Michael Schnedlitz criticizes the SPÖ for internal chaos and broken promises to pensioners, demanding immediate new elections and claiming the SPÖ is unfit to govern.

q.o: Umfallen hat bei der SPÖ System: Versprechen an Senioren gebrochen
q.t: Backing down is systematic with the SPÖ: promises to seniors broken

q.o: Die SPÖ unter Babler hat den Senioren versprochen, die Pensionen nicht zu kürzen – und jetzt wurden sie schon mehrfach zur Kasse gebeten.
q.t: The SPÖ under Babler promised seniors not to cut pensions – and now they have been asked to pay up multiple times.

q.o: Es ist traurig mitansehen zu müssen, wie sich eine ehemals staatstragende Partei von einem Teilzeit-Österreicher vor sich hertreiben lässt.
q.t: It is sad to have to watch how a formerly state-supporting party lets itself be driven by a part-time Austrian.

q.o: Die SPÖ muss ihre Chaostage beenden. Eine Partei in diesem Zustand, die nur mit sich selbst beschäftigt ist, kann nicht Teil der österreichischen Bundesregierung sein.
q.t: The SPÖ must end its days of chaos. A party in this state, which is only occupied with itself, cannot be part of the Austrian federal government.

q.o: Politik an der Seite der Menschen zahlt sich immer aus – das zeigt die FPÖ mit Herbert Kickl an der Spitze
q.t: Politics on the side of the people always pays off – the FPÖ with Herbert Kickl at the top shows this

ti: DENK - Facebook
s: DENK's motion was adopted requiring the cabinet to develop targeted measures against violence, intimidation and discriminatory hate crimes in cooperation with Islamic institutions and houses of worship.

q.o: Naar aanleiding van de aangenomen DENK-motie moet het kabinet moet nu, samen met islamitische instellingen en gebedshuizen, komen met gerichte maatregelen tegen geweld, intimidatie en discriminatoire haatdaden.
q.t: Following the adopted DENK motion, the cabinet must now, together with Islamic institutions and houses of worship, come up with targeted measures against violence, intimidation and discriminatory hate crimes.

ti: Antimafia: Scarpinato depistante su mafia-appalti, indegno di stare in Parlamento
s: Brothers of Italy parliamentary group leaders formally requested the Five Star Movement to remove Senator Roberto Scarpinato from the Anti-Mafia Commission after a Caltanissetta judge's ruling described his conduct as misleading regarding mafia-related public contracts investigations.

q.o: Nel provvedimento il giudice ritiene 'doveroso segnalare l'attività depistante' del Sen. Roberto Scarpinato alla vigilia della Sua audizione in Commissione Antimafia.
q.t: In the ruling the judge considers it 'necessary to report the misleading activity' of Senator Roberto Scarpinato on the eve of his hearing in the Anti-Mafia Commission.

q.o: Per questo Vi chiediamo di sostituire il Sen. Scarpinato nella Commissione con un altro esponente del vostro Gruppo.
q.t: For this reason we ask you to replace Senator Scarpinato in the Commission with another member of your Group.

q.o: Chi depista su Borsellino è indegno di stare in Parlamento e ancora peggio in antimafia
q.t: Whoever misleads on Borsellino is unworthy of being in Parliament and even worse in anti-mafia

ti: Terra dei Fuochi: 200 milioni per bonifica, risposta senza precedenti
s: Brothers of Italy announces 200 million euros allocated for environmental remediation of the Terra dei Fuochi area in Campania, with Commissioner Giuseppe Vadalà assigned implementation competencies.

q.o: Duecento milioni di euro per la Terra dei Fuochi. È una notizia straordinaria per la Campania e, soprattutto, una risposta concreta alle comunità che per troppi anni hanno atteso risanamento, bonifiche e tutela della propria salute.
q.t: Two hundred million euros for the Terra dei Fuochi. It is extraordinary news for Campania and, above all, a concrete response to communities that for too many years have awaited remediation, cleanups and protection of their health.

q.o: Si tratta del più alto stanziamento mai destinato alla bonifica della Terra dei Fuochi.
q.t: This is the highest allocation ever allocated to the remediation of the Terra dei Fuochi.

q.o: La decisione di attribuire al Commissario Giuseppe Vadalà le competenze per l'attuazione degli interventi consente di rafforzare una governance unitaria e di accelerare le procedure, indirizzando le risorse verso le situazioni che presentano maggiori priorità e urgenze.
q.t: The decision to assign Commissioner Giuseppe Vadalà the competencies for implementing the interventions allows for strengthening unified governance and accelerating procedures, directing resources toward situations that present the greatest priorities and urgencies.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: The Portuguese Communist Party issued a statement supporting Lula da Silva's candidacy in Brazil's presidential runoff election scheduled for October 25, 2026, while condemning US Trump Administration interference in the Brazilian electoral process.

q.o: O que está em jogo nas eleições brasileiras é a defesa da democracia e da soberania do Brasil, do prosseguimento e aprofundamento de um caminho em prol de liberdade, de direitos, de desenvolvimento, que Lula da Silva e as forças democráticas e progressistas brasileiras protagonizam, ou a imposição de um projecto reaccionário, golpista, fascizante, subserviente ao imperialismo norte-americano e apoiado por este, que é protagonizado por Flávio Bolsonaro e os interesses profundamente antidemocráticos e antipatrióticos que este representa.
q.t: What is at stake in the Brazilian elections is the defense of democracy and Brazil's sovereignty, the continuation and deepening of a path in favor of freedom, rights, development, which Lula da Silva and the Brazilian democratic and progressive forces champion, or the imposition of a reactionary, coup-plotting, fascist project, subservient to and supported by North American imperialism, which is championed by Flávio Bolsonaro and the profoundly antidemocratic and antipatriotic interests he represents.

q.o: O PCP denuncia e condena as abertas e inaceitáveis pressões e ingerência da Administração Trump dos EUA, que procura criar as condições para submeter o Brasil aos seus interesses, dominar os seus imensos recursos, colocá-lo ao serviço dos seus intentos de dominação neocolonial da América Latina e das Caraíbas, que ameaçam e agridem a paz, a soberania e os direitos dos povos desta região.
q.t: The PCP denounces and condemns the open and unacceptable pressures and interference of the US Trump Administration, which seeks to create conditions to submit Brazil to its interests, dominate its immense resources, place it at the service of its intentions of neocolonial domination of Latin America and the Caribbean, which threaten and attack the peace, sovereignty and rights of the peoples of this region.

ti: Knesset Elections: The Struggle for Arab Representation in the Face of Disqualification Decisions and the Israeli Right - جريدة القدس
s: Article discusses challenges to Arab representation in Knesset elections amid disqualification decisions and opposition from the Israeli right.

s: Yiannis Flevaris stated that Greek Solution will elect a member of parliament in the Dodecanese region in the upcoming elections.

q.t: In the upcoming elections, the Greek solution will elect a member of parliament in the Dodecanese

ti: Νατσιός: «Αν η Ελλάδα δεχθεί επίθεση, η Ευρώπη θα πολεμήσει στο πλευρό της;»
s: NIKH President Dimitris Natsios submitted a parliamentary question to Foreign Minister Georgios Gerapetritis asking the government to raise at the October 2026 European Council the issue of practical application of EU mutual defense clause (Article 42§7) in case of armed attack against a member state, in the context of Greek-Turkish tensions and the Crete-Cyprus electricity interconnection.

q.o: Αν η Ελλάδα δεχθεί επίθεση, η Ευρώπη θα πολεμήσει στο πλευρό της;
q.t: If Greece is attacked, will Europe fight at its side?

q.o: ποια ευρωπαϊκή συνδρομή μπορεί να αναμένει στην πράξη ένα κράτος-μέλος όταν η απειλή περάσει από τις προειδοποιήσεις και τις διπλωματικές εντάσεις στην ένοπλη επίθεση;
q.t: what European assistance can a member state expect in practice when the threat passes from warnings and diplomatic tensions to armed attack?

ti: Η Χαλκίδα στέλνει μήνυμα «ΝΙΚΗΣ» – Εγκαινιάστηκε το νέο Γραφείο του Κινήματος
s: Democratic Patriotic Movement – Victory inaugurated a new office in Chalkida on 27 September 2026, with party president Dimitris Natsios and parliamentary members present, establishing a permanent organizational presence in Evia.

q.o: στόχος είναι το Γραφείο της Χαλκίδας να αποτελέσει σημείο αναφοράς για τη δράση και την επικοινωνία του Κινήματος με τους πολίτες
q.t: the goal is for the Chalkida Office to become a reference point for the Movement's action and communication with citizens

q.o: ορισμένες από αυτές τις προσεγγίσεις εντάσσονται σε αυτό που η ΝΙΚΗ αποκαλεί «woke ατζέντα»
q.t: some of these approaches fall within what NIKI calls the 'woke agenda'

ti: Υπάρχει και μια ανασκόπηση που δεν γράφεται στο Μαξίμου, αυτή των νοικοκυριών όταν ανοίγουν το πορτοφόλι τους
s: Democratic Patriotic Movement – Victory criticizes Prime Minister Mitsotakis's government review, proposing instead strong reductions in fuel excise tax and VAT, permanent financial support per child until adulthood, and questioning the effectiveness of dialogue with Turkey amid continued sovereignty challenges.

q.o: Η ΝΙΚΗ έχει προτείνει ισχυρή μείωση του ΕΦΚ στα καύσιμα και μείωση του ΦΠΑ. Όχι να εισπράττει το κράτος με τον έναν τρόπο και να επιστρέφει ένα μέρος με τον άλλον. Να αφήσει εξαρχής περισσότερα χρήματα στην τσέπη του πολίτη.
q.t: NIKI has proposed a strong reduction in fuel excise tax and a reduction in VAT. Not for the state to collect in one way and return a portion in another. To leave more money in the citizen's pocket from the outset.

q.o: Η ΝΙΚΗ έχει προτείνει σταθερή οικονομική στήριξη ανά παιδί μέχρι την ενηλικίωση, ουσιαστική στεγαστική και εργασιακή στήριξη των νέων ζευγαριών και ισχυρή ενίσχυση τρίτεκνων και πολύτεκνων οικογενειών.
q.t: NIKI has proposed permanent financial support per child until adulthood, substantial housing and employment support for young couples, and strong support for families with three or more children.

q.o: Όταν ο ίδιος διαπιστώνει ότι αυτές οι ενέργειες συνεχίζονται, ποια συγκεκριμένη αλλαγή προκαλεί η ελληνική στρατηγική;
q.t: When he himself observes that these actions continue, what specific change does the Greek strategy bring about?

ti: O Κασιδιάρης επέστρεψε και προκαλεί τρόμο στα δεξιά: Το ποσοστό που αγγίζει το νέο του κόμμα - SDNA
s: Ilias Kasidiaris has returned to politics with a new party that is reportedly achieving significant polling numbers and causing concern among right-wing parties.

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: MeRA25 United Left issued a statement on 27 September 2026 commemorating the 85th anniversary of the founding of the National Liberation Front (EAM) in 1941, drawing parallels between historical resistance to fascism and contemporary struggles against oligarchy and for popular sovereignty.

q.o: Στις 27 Σεπτεμβρίου 1941, μέσα στο σκοτάδι της ναζιστικής Κατοχής, ιδρύθηκε το Εθνικό Απελευθερωτικό Μέτωπο. Ογδόντα πέντε χρόνια μετά, τιμούμε τις γυναίκες και τους άνδρες που οργανώθηκαν, αγωνίστηκαν και θυσιάστηκαν για την απελευθέρωση της χώρας από τον φασισμό και τον ναζισμό.
q.t: On 27 September 1941, in the darkness of the Nazi Occupation, the National Liberation Front was founded. Eighty-five years later, we honor the women and men who organized, fought and sacrificed themselves for the liberation of the country from fascism and Nazism.

q.o: Σήμερα η Ελλάδα δεν βρίσκεται υπό στρατιωτική κατοχή. Παραμένει όμως εγκλωβισμένη σε ένα καθεστώς οικονομικής αποικίας, με τη δημόσια περιουσία, τα εργασιακά δικαιώματα και βασικά εργαλεία οικονομικής πολιτικής υποθηκευμένα, ενώ η ντόπια και ξένη ολιγαρχία περιορίζει τη δυνατότητα του λαού να αποφασίζει για το μέλλον του.
q.t: Today Greece is not under military occupation. However, it remains trapped in a regime of economic colonization, with public property, labor rights and basic tools of economic policy mortgaged, while the domestic and foreign oligarchy limits the ability of the people to decide their future.

q.o: 85 χρόνια μετά, κρατάμε ζωντανή τη μνήμη της Εθνικής Αντίστασης και συνεχίζουμε τον αγώνα ενάντια στον φασισμό και την ολιγαρχία, για επανάκτηση της δημοκρατίας, της ειρήνης, της κοινωνικής δικαιοσύνης και της πραγματικής λαϊκής κυριαρχίας.
q.t: 85 years later, we keep alive the memory of the National Resistance and continue the struggle against fascism and oligarchy, for the recovery of democracy, peace, social justice and true popular sovereignty.

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: MeRA25 issued a statement mourning the death of Panagiotis Lillis, a revolutionary left activist, theorist and intellectual who died on September 24, 2026 after a long battle with cancer.

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: MeRA25 condemned Greek Prime Minister Mitsotakis for meeting with Netanyahu at the UN General Assembly and called for ending all military and diplomatic agreements with Israel, which the party describes as a "terrorist state" conducting genocide in Gaza.

q.o: Την ίδια ώρα που εκατοντάδες διπλωμάτες από όλες τις χώρες του κόσμου άδειαζαν την αίθουσα της γενικής συνέλευσης του ΟΗΕ, αρνούμενοι να νομιμοποιήσουν με την παρουσία τους την ομιλία του αρχιτέκτονα της γενοκτονίας στη Γάζα, Νετανιάχου, ο Έλληνας πρωθυπουργός Κυριάκος Μητσοτάκης επέλεξε να λειτουργήσει ξανά ως πλυντήριο της γενοκτονίας, φωτογραφιζόμενος να χαριεντίζεται μαζί του.
q.t: At the same time that hundreds of diplomats from all countries of the world were emptying the hall of the UN General Assembly, refusing to legitimize with their presence the speech of the architect of the genocide in Gaza, Netanyahu, the Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis chose to function again as a whitewasher of genocide, being photographed joking with him.

q.o: Καμία συνεργασία με το κράτος-τρομοκράτη του Ισραήλ. Άμεση διακοπή όλων των στρατιωτικών και διπλωματικών συμφωνιών που στηρίζουν τη σφαγή στη Γάζα και τον Λίβανο.
q.t: No cooperation with the terrorist state of Israel. Immediate cessation of all military and diplomatic agreements that support the slaughter in Gaza and Lebanon.

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: MeRA25 criticised the government over safety issues in Kypseli neighbourhood caused by Line 4 metro construction, demanding full transparency of studies, independent structural inspections, and compensation for affected residents after subsidence exceeded permissible limits by four times.

q.o: Η ασφάλεια των πολιτών δεν είναι εμπιστευτική πληροφορία.
q.t: The safety of citizens is not confidential information.

q.o: ο υφυπουργός Υποδομών Νίκος Ταχιάος παραδέχθηκε ότι ο Μετροπόντικας σταμάτησε όταν καταγράφηκαν καθιζήσεις σε όρια τετραπλάσια του επιτρεπτού, καθώς και ότι υπήρξαν αστοχίες στις απογραφές κτιρίων.
q.t: Deputy Minister of Infrastructure Nikos Tachiaos admitted that the Metro tunnel boring machine stopped when subsidence was recorded at four times the permissible limits, and that there were failures in building surveys.

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: Yanis Varoufakis, Secretary of MeRA25, appeared on the OPEN television program "Kathares Kouventes" (Clean Talk) and made a statement about credit rating agencies upgrading Greece while citizens are downgraded.

q.o: Όσο αναβαθμίζουν οι Οίκοι τόσο υποβαθμιζόμαστε εμείς
q.t: The more the [credit rating] agencies upgrade, the more we are downgraded

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: MeRA25 issued a statement on the vindication of Popi Melliou by the European Court of Human Rights thirteen years after she was subjected to police arbitrariness and humiliating treatment in 2013, condemning ongoing police violence and state cover-up in Greece.

q.o: Η περίπτωση της Πόπης Μέλλιου έρχεται να προστεθεί σε μια σειρά καταδικών του ελληνικού κράτους για υποθέσεις αστυνομικής βίας και αυθαιρεσίας, το οποίο συγκαλύπτει, αν δε υποκινεί τέτοιου είδους συμπεριφορές.
q.t: The case of Popi Melliou comes to be added to a series of condemnations of the Greek state for cases of police violence and arbitrariness, which it covers up, if not incites such behaviors.

q.o: Η αλληλεγγύη στον καθένα και την καθεμιά που υφίσταται αστυνομική βία είναι καθήκον για όλες και όλους μας.
q.t: Solidarity with each and every person who suffers police violence is a duty for all of us.

ti: Stefan Möller: Ministerpräsidenten stemmen sich mit undemokratischen Mitteln gegen den eigenen Machtverlust - Alternative für Deutschland
s: AfD deputy federal spokesman Stefan Möller criticized the decision by German state premiers to prevent Saxony-Anhalt from assuming the rotating chair of the Conference of Minister-Presidents, which would have allowed AfD's Ulrich Siegmund, as future minister-president after AfD's election victory, to chair the body.

q.o: Der demokratische Rechtsstaat akzeptiert Wahlergebnisse und hält sich an die allgemeinen Regeln, die er aufstellt. Die in Bund und Ländern regierenden Parteien scheinen damit massive Probleme zu haben, wenn es um den eigenen Machtverlust geht.
q.t: The democratic constitutional state accepts election results and adheres to the general rules it establishes. The parties governing in the federal government and states seem to have massive problems with this when it comes to their own loss of power.

q.o: Dramatisch ist zudem, dass auch die Ministerpräsidenten der neuen Bundesländer bei diesem undemokratischen Spiel mitspielen, also lieber den MPK-Vorsitz eines ostdeutschen Bundeslands opfern als der AfD zu ihrem Recht zu verhelfen.
q.t: It is also dramatic that the minister-presidents of the new federal states are also participating in this undemocratic game, thus preferring to sacrifice the MPK chairmanship of an East German state rather than helping the AfD to its rights.

ti: Stefan Möller: Zum 75-jährigen Jubiläum des Bundesverfassungsgerichts - Alternative für Deutschland
s: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Stefan Möller criticizes the Federal Constitutional Court on its 75th anniversary, arguing that the largest opposition faction (AfD) is excluded from judicial appointments and calling for reforms to address what he describes as gaps in constitutional protections.

q.o: Das Bundesverfassungsgericht hat in den vergangenen 75 Jahren die Entwicklung unseres Landes maßgeblich positiv beeinflusst. Allerdings wird seit einigen Jahren auch Optimierungsbedarf erkennbar.
q.t: The Federal Constitutional Court has significantly positively influenced the development of our country over the past 75 years. However, for some years now, the need for optimization has also become apparent.

q.o: Auch die politische Besetzungspraxis sorgt dafür, dass ein Drittel der bei Wahlen relevanten politischen Überzeugungen und Lebensvorstellungen keine Repräsentanz im Bundesverfassungsgericht hat.
q.t: The political appointment practice also ensures that one-third of the political convictions and life concepts relevant in elections have no representation in the Federal Constitutional Court.

ti: Tankrabatt: Der Appell des Kartellamtes ist ein Ausdruck von Hilfslosigkeit
s: Die Linke party chair Ines Schwerdtner criticizes the cartel office's appeal to oil companies regarding fuel discount pass-through and calls for a proper price supervisory authority and profit margin cap to end price gouging at gas stations.

q.o: Der Appell des Kartellamtes an die Mineralölwirtschaft ist ein Ausdruck der Hilflosigkeit. Die Mineralölkonzerne in diesem Land können tun und machen, was sie wollen. Sie setzen die Preise weitgehend nach eigenem Gutdünken, während die Menschen die Rechnung zahlen.
q.t: The cartel office's appeal to the mineral oil industry is an expression of helplessness. The mineral oil corporations in this country can do whatever they want. They set prices largely at their own discretion, while people pay the bill.

q.o: Wir brauchen dringend eine richtige Preisaufsichtsbehörde, die Transparenz über die Preisbildung entlang der gesamten Lieferkette – von der Ölförderung bis zur Zapfsäule – gewährleistet. Auf dieser Grundlage ließe sich ein Gewinnmargendeckel einführen, der die Abzocke an den Tankstellen beendet.
q.t: We urgently need a proper price supervisory authority that ensures transparency about price formation along the entire supply chain – from oil extraction to the gas pump. On this basis, a profit margin cap could be introduced that ends the rip-off at gas stations.

ti: Parcoursup trie, nous l’abolirons : l’acces à l’enseignement supérieur doit être garanti pour toutes et tous
s: The France Unbowed parliamentary group announced it will defend the abolition of Parcoursup through legislative proposals and budget battles, proposing to open 150,000 additional places in higher education and guarantee every baccalaureate holder access to their chosen program.

q.o: Le groupe La France insoumise à l'Assemblée nationale, par ses propositions de loi et la bataille sur le budget, défendra l'abolition de Parcoursup, l'ouverture de 150 000 places supplémentaires dans l'enseignement supérieur, la hausse des moyens alloués aux établissements publics et la possibilité pour tout bachelier de s'inscrire dans la formation de son choix comme la constitution le prévoit.
q.t: The France Unbowed group in the National Assembly, through its legislative proposals and the budget battle, will defend the abolition of Parcoursup, the opening of 150,000 additional places in higher education, the increase of resources allocated to public institutions and the possibility for every baccalaureate holder to enroll in the program of their choice as the constitution provides.

q.o: En effet, en cette rentrée, 126 652 élèves, soit 1 élève sur 8 se retrouvent exclus de l'enseignement supérieur à cause de Parcoursup.
q.t: Indeed, this school year, 126,652 students, or 1 student in 8, find themselves excluded from higher education because of Parcoursup.

ti: Le gouvernement refuse de transposer la directive sur la présomption de salariat
s: France Unbowed accuses the French government of refusing to transpose an EU directive on presumption of employee status for platform workers, obtained by MEP Leïla Chaibi in October 2024, and promises to legislate on workers' rights if in power.

q.o: Le 23 octobre 2024, la députée européenne insoumise Leïla Chaibi arrache aux libéraux une directive européenne introduisant une présomption de salariat pour les travailleur·ses de plateforme.
q.t: On 23 October 2024, Unbowed MEP Leïla Chaibi wrested from the liberals a European directive introducing a presumption of employee status for platform workers.

q.o: Le gouvernement préfère faire payer à la France une amende à l'Union européenne plutôt que de mettre fin à son soutien inconditionnel aux plateformes numériques.
q.t: The government prefers to make France pay a fine to the European Union rather than end its unconditional support for digital platforms.

q.o: Avec Jean-Luc Mélenchon, nous légifèrerons pour défendre leurs droits.
q.t: With Jean-Luc Mélenchon, we will legislate to defend their rights.

s: The NPA-Revolutionaries criticized Jean-Luc Mélenchon for appealing to Total executives to freeze their profit margins, characterizing this as reassuring capitalists rather than defending workers' interests.

q.t: Total defends its capitalist interests, we defend the interests of the French people, there must be a way to find a solution that gets us out of this situation...

ti: Pour Macron aussi, lâennemi principal est dans son propre pays
s: The NPA-Revolutionaries published an article criticizing Macron's announcement of French military engagement in Saudi Arabia supporting the US war against Iran, denouncing his domestic austerity policies, and calling for a generalized social movement to fight against war, banks, and profits.

q.o: Jeudi 24 septembre, c'est un Macron dans l'impasse qui a livré une allocution qui ne contenait qu'une seule annonce : celle de l'engagement de moyens militaires français en Arabie saoudite dans une position d'appui subordonné à la guerre d'agression menée par les États-Unis contre l'Iran.
q.t: Thursday, September 24, it was a Macron at an impasse who delivered a speech that contained only one announcement: that of the commitment of French military means in Saudi Arabia in a subordinate support position to the war of aggression waged by the United States against Iran.

q.o: Pour l'heure, Macron ici, comme Merz en Allemagne, sont avant tout en guerre contre leur propre classe ouvrière.
q.t: For now, Macron here, like Merz in Germany, are above all at war against their own working class.

q.o: Pour bloquer le prix de l'essence, pour nos salaires en général, pour ne pas subir une nouvelle vague de licenciements, pour ne pas se faire embarquer dans une nouvelle guerre, il faudra un « mouvement social généralisé » qui devra consciemment s'en prendre aux trois piliers du système : la guerre, les banques et les profits.
q.t: To block the price of gasoline, for our wages in general, to avoid suffering a new wave of layoffs, to avoid being dragged into a new war, we will need a 'generalized social movement' that must consciously attack the three pillars of the system: war, banks, and profits.

ti: AZFÂ : 25 ans aprÃ¨s, les mÃ©moires restent vives
s: The NPA-Revolutionaries published a statement on the 25th anniversary of the AZF factory explosion in Toulouse, criticizing Total's exemption from responsibility and arguing that capitalist profit motives endanger lives.

q.o: Tant que les choix de production seront sous leur contrôle, nos vies seront menacées par leur soif de profits.
q.t: As long as production choices are under their control, our lives will be threatened by their thirst for profits.

ti: Ãlections rÃ©gionales en AllemagneÂ : le gouvernement fÃ©dÃ©ral en plein pÃ©trin
s: The NPA-Revolutionaries analyzed German regional elections in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern on September 20, 2026, where Die Linke won in Berlin with 26% and the AfD won in Mecklenburg with 37%, while their affiliated RSO ran an independent revolutionary campaign in Berlin's Tempelhof-Schöneberg district receiving 323 votes.

q.o: Pendant que de nombreuses organisations d'extrême gauche ont milité pour le succès de Die Linke, en s'y affiliant depuis son renouveau des dernières années, nos camarades du RSO (Organisation socialiste révolutionnaire) ont mené une campagne indépendante, ouvertement révolutionnaire, dans la circonscription de Tempelhof-Schöneberg à Berlin.
q.t: While numerous far-left organizations campaigned for Die Linke's success, affiliating themselves with it since its renewal in recent years, our comrades from the RSO (Revolutionary Socialist Organization) conducted an independent, openly revolutionary campaign in the Tempelhof-Schöneberg constituency in Berlin.

q.o: Une campagne réussie, à l'issue de laquelle 323 électeurs ont donné leur voix « pour un monde sans guerre, ni crises, ni exploitation » !
q.t: A successful campaign, at the end of which 323 voters gave their vote 'for a world without war, crises, or exploitation'!

s: The New Anticapitalist Party – Revolutionaries published a statement at their 2026 summer meetings criticizing French imperialism's impact on people and nature through gold mining in French Guiana.

ti: Un projet de budget pour nous serrer la ceinture Â­â Tous ensemble prÃ©parons la riposteÂ !
s: NPA-Révolutionnaires calls for strikes and demonstrations against the government's proposed budget cuts, supporting mobilizations scheduled for September 26-29 and October 17, 2026, and advocating for a general strike to demand wage increases funded by corporate profits.

q.o: Lecornu veut économiser 54 milliards d'euros sur le prochain budget. Mais pas en puisant dans les bénéfices des entreprises, alors que la France est le deuxième pays du monde en dividendes versés aux actionnaires – 61 milliards d'euros !
q.t: Lecornu wants to save 54 billion euros on the next budget. But not by drawing from corporate profits, even though France is the second country in the world in dividends paid to shareholders – 61 billion euros!

q.o: Nous devons défendre nous-mêmes nos intérêts et imposer nos revendications. Le seul moyen, ce sera en bloquant l'économie, et donc les profits, en nous mettant en grève et en manifestant jusqu'à ce qu'ils cèdent.
q.t: We must defend our own interests and impose our demands. The only way will be by blocking the economy, and thus the profits, by going on strike and demonstrating until they give in.

q.o: Il faut des mobilisations qui convergent en une lutte de tous les travailleurs, vers une grève générale, pas des luttes émiettées.
q.t: We need mobilizations that converge into a struggle of all workers, towards a general strike, not fragmented struggles.

ti: Schluss mit Betroffenheit und Kuscheljustiz
s: The Freedom Party of Austria announced it will propose its child protection package in the National Parliament, demanding drastic increases in penalties for child sexual abuse including life imprisonment and ending what it calls lenient justice policies.

q.o: Das Vergießen von Krokodilstränen durch ÖVP-Familienministerin Claudia Bauer ist ein einziges Armutszeugnis, wo doch ihre eigene Partei seit Jahren konsequent echten Kinderschutz blockiert
q.t: The shedding of crocodile tears by ÖVP Family Minister Claudia Bauer is a complete disgrace, when her own party has consistently blocked real child protection for years

q.o: Wir Freiheitliche werden im Nationalrat daher die sofortige Umsetzung unseres Kinderschutzpakets beantragen. Es braucht die volle Gesetzeshärte, massive Strafverschärfungen und ein Ende der verfehlten Täterschutzpolitik der Systemparteien
q.t: We Freedom Party members will therefore propose the immediate implementation of our child protection package in the National Parliament. We need the full severity of the law, massive increases in penalties and an end to the failed perpetrator protection policy of the system parties

q.o: Wie kann es sein, dass die Justiz bei einem Triebtäter, der sich an einer Vierjährigen vergangen und zudem abscheuliches Material gehortet haben soll, keine Tatbegehungsgefahr sieht? Das ist ein Schlag ins Gesicht aller Eltern, die sich um die Sicherheit ihrer Kinder sorgen!
q.t: How can it be that the justice system sees no danger of reoffending in the case of a sex offender who is alleged to have abused a four-year-old and also hoarded abhorrent material? This is a slap in the face to all parents who worry about the safety of their children!

ti: Sprit, Energie und dann alle Waren zum Leben
s: The Freedom Party of Austria demands abolition of the CO2 tax and halving of the mineral oil tax in response to fuel prices reaching 2.30 euros and rising energy costs, criticizing the government coalition's fuel price brake as a failure.

q.o: Die sogenannte Spritpreisbremse der Verliererkoalition war von Anfang an ein reiner Schmäh und ist nun krachend gescheitert. Man hat die Bevölkerung eiskalt im Stich gelassen und für dumm verkauft, während sich die Systemparteien in ihrer eigenen Realitätsverweigerung suhlen
q.t: The so-called fuel price brake of the loser coalition was a pure sham from the beginning and has now failed miserably. The population has been left out in the cold and sold for stupid, while the system parties wallow in their own denial of reality

q.o: CO2-Steuer abschaffen und Mineralölsteuer halbieren! Jeder weitere Monat des Zuwartens belastet Pendler, Familien und Betriebe und droht höhere Kosten für das nächste Jahr festzuschreiben!
q.t: Abolish the CO2 tax and halve the mineral oil tax! Every additional month of waiting burdens commuters, families and businesses and threatens to lock in higher costs for next year!

q.o: Die Regierung drängt die Bürger ideologisch getrieben aus ihren bestehenden Heizungen und in andere Heizformen. Doch wer viel Geld in eine Pelletsheizung investiert hat, muss jetzt feststellen: Auch hier schützt der Umstieg nicht vor einer Preisexplosion. Holzpellets sind binnen eines Jahres um 32 Prozent teurer geworden!
q.t: The government is ideologically driving citizens out of their existing heating systems and into other forms of heating. But those who have invested a lot of money in a pellet heating system must now realize: Even here, the switch does not protect against a price explosion. Wood pellets have become 32 percent more expensive within a year!

q.o: CO2-Zertifikate verursachen bei Gaskraftwerken je nach Zertifikatspreis geschätzte Zusatzkosten von 40 bis 60 Euro pro Megawattstunde Strom. Diese Belastung würde unmittelbar wegfallen und den Strompreis sofort günstiger machen.
q.t: CO2 certificates cause estimated additional costs of 40 to 60 euros per megawatt hour of electricity for gas power plants, depending on the certificate price. This burden would immediately disappear and make the electricity price cheaper immediately.

ti: NEOS-Minister kapituliert: Schule vor dem Total-Kollaps
s: FPÖ education spokesman Hermann Brückl criticized NEOS Education Minister Christoph Wiederkehr following a television interview, accusing him of capitulating to political Islam, failing on integration policy, and replacing classical education with ideological indoctrination.

q.o: Wiederkehrs Interview hat das ganze Ausmaß des Scheiterns offengelegt. Er hat zugegeben, bei den größten Problemen – vom politischen Islam über die Integrationskatastrophe bis zum Leistungsverfall – völlig plan- und hilflos zu sein
q.t: Wiederkehr's interview has revealed the full extent of the failure. He has admitted to being completely without a plan and helpless regarding the biggest problems – from political Islam to the integration catastrophe to the decline in performance

q.o: Wenn der Bildungsminister erklärt, dass eine staatliche Kontrolle des Islamunterrichts an verfassungsrechtlichen und völkerrechtlichen Hürden wie dem Konkordat scheitert und er auf Vorschläge der ÖVP wartet, dann ist das die faktische Unterwerfung unseres Rechtsstaats
q.t: When the Education Minister explains that state control of Islamic instruction fails due to constitutional and international legal hurdles like the Concordat and he waits for proposals from the ÖVP, then that is the de facto submission of our rule of law

q.o: Dass in Wiener Bezirken bis zu 74 Prozent der Schüler nicht Deutsch als Umgangssprache sprechen, als 'gesellschaftliche Realität' zu bezeichnen, ist an Zynismus nicht zu überbieten
q.t: To describe the fact that in Viennese districts up to 74 percent of students do not speak German as their everyday language as 'social reality' is cynicism that cannot be surpassed

q.o: Während zentrale Reformen wie die 'Mittlere Reife' seit einem Vierteljahrhundert verschleppt werden und der Minister planlose Schulversuche ohne klares Ziel startet, wird klassische Bildung wie Latein aus dem Unterricht verbannt. Dafür wird ein Umerziehungsfach wie 'Medien und Demokratie' eingeführt, das Schülern beibringen soll, 'russische Propaganda' zu erkennen, und das ausgerechnet in Kooperation mit den Systemmedien ORF und dem ultralinken Standard
q.t: While central reforms like the 'Mittlere Reife' have been delayed for a quarter century and the minister starts aimless school experiments without a clear goal, classical education like Latin is being banned from instruction. Instead, a re-education subject like 'Media and Democracy' is being introduced, which is supposed to teach students to recognize 'Russian propaganda', and that in cooperation with the system media ORF and the ultra-left Standard

ti: ÖVP und der politische Islam: Brandstifter spielt Feuerwehrmann
s: FPÖ General Secretary Michael Schnedlitz criticized the ÖVP for creating conditions that enabled political Islam and Islamization over 40 years in government, calling their recent announcements symbolic and demanding the ÖVP support an FPÖ proposal for a ban on political Islam.

q.o: Die mittlerweile sprichwörtliche und zunehmend auffällige gespielte Sorge der ÖVP vor dem politischen Islam und der Islamisierung – vom Kopftuchverbot über das Verbot der Muslimbruderschaft und weiterer Islamorganisationen bis hin zur heutigen Forderung der ÖVP-Ministerin nach einer stärkeren staatlichen Aufsicht über den konfessionellen Religionsunterricht – ist typisch für die ÖVP.
q.t: The now proverbial and increasingly conspicuous feigned concern of the ÖVP about political Islam and Islamization – from the headscarf ban to the ban on the Muslim Brotherhood and other Islamic organizations to today's demand by the ÖVP minister for stronger state supervision of denominational religious education – is typical for the ÖVP.

q.o: Seit 40 Jahren sitzt die ÖVP nun durchgehend in der Bundesregierung. In diesen vier Jahrzehnten hat sie die illegale Masseneinwanderung, die Entstehung von Parallel- und Gegengesellschaften und die fortschreitende Islamisierung mitzuverantworten.
q.t: The ÖVP has now been continuously in the federal government for 40 years. In these four decades, it shares responsibility for illegal mass immigration, the emergence of parallel and counter-societies, and advancing Islamization.

q.o: Ein freiheitlicher Antrag für ein Verbotsgesetz gegen den politischen Islam liegt längst auf dem Tisch – die ÖVP muss diesem nur zustimmen.
q.t: An FPÖ proposal for a ban law against political Islam has long been on the table – the ÖVP only needs to agree to it.

ti: Social-Media-Verbot für Jugendliche ist Zensur pur!
s: FPÖ media spokesperson Christian Hafenecker criticized the proposed social media ban for under-14s by the ÖVP-SPÖ-NEOS coalition as censorship disguised as child protection, arguing it aims to control youth access to critical information outside mainstream media.

q.o: Man hat panische Angst davor, dass sich junge Menschen abseits der Systemmedien informieren und eine eigene, kritische Meinung bilden. Das ist der wahre Grund für diesen Frontalangriff auf die Freiheit!
q.t: They have a panicked fear that young people will inform themselves outside the system media and form their own critical opinion. That is the true reason for this frontal attack on freedom!

q.o: Es geht nicht um Schutz, es geht um Kontrolle und Bevormundung. Man will eine Generation heranziehen, die nur noch die Einheitsmeinung der Regierung und ihrer Hofberichterstatter konsumiert!
q.t: It's not about protection, it's about control and paternalism. They want to raise a generation that only consumes the uniform opinion of the government and its court reporters!

q.o: Diese Zensur-Fantasien sind ein Anschlag auf die Grund- und Freiheitsrechte und die digitale Souveränität unserer Jugend. Wir Freiheitliche werden diesen mit aller Entschiedenheit bekämpfen.
q.t: These censorship fantasies are an attack on the fundamental and freedom rights and the digital sovereignty of our youth. We Freedom Party members will fight this with all determination.

ti: Spritpreis-Schmäh der Verlierer-Ampel: 12 Cent Almosen, aber 1 Euro Klima-Raub
s: FPÖ leader Herbert Kickl criticized the governing coalition's announced 12-cent fuel price brake as insufficient, warning that Austria's 2040 climate target could increase fuel prices by up to one euro per liter by 2035, and demanded abolition of the CO2 tax, halving of mineral oil tax, and stopping additional national climate burdens.

q.o: Eiskalt hat diese Verlierer-Ampel weggeschaut, wie die Diesel- und Benzinpreise durch die Decke gegangen sind und jetzt feiert sie sich für ihre Ankündigung einer Zwölf-Cent-Mini-Preisbremse ab. Das ist bei den aktuellen Treibstoffpreisen nicht einmal ein Tropfen auf den heißen Stein, das ist die nächste unterlassene Hilfeleistung gegenüber den Pendlern, Unternehmern und allen Autofahrern!
q.t: This loser coalition has coldly looked away as diesel and petrol prices have gone through the roof and now celebrates itself for announcing a twelve-cent mini price brake. With current fuel prices, this is not even a drop in the ocean, this is the next failure to provide assistance to commuters, entrepreneurs and all motorists!

q.o: Unsere freiheitlichen Entlastungsvorschläge liegen längst auf dem Tisch: CO2-Steuer abschaffen, Mineralölsteuer halbieren und zusätzliche nationale Belastungen durch das Klimaziel 2040 stoppen. Damit wäre den Menschen tatsächlich geholfen!
q.t: Our freedom-oriented relief proposals have long been on the table: abolish the CO2 tax, halve the mineral oil tax and stop additional national burdens from the 2040 climate target. That would actually help people!
