s: Brothers of Italy launched a nationwide signature-collection campaign called "Nessuna resti nascosta" (None Remain Hidden) supporting a parliamentary proposal to ban full veils in public places, punish arranged marriages, prohibit virginity certificates, impose stricter controls on places of worship, and counter what the party describes as Islamic fundamentalism.

q.o: Si chiama "Nessuna resti nascosta" la nuova campagna di Fratelli d'Italia per fermare la diffusione dell'integralismo islamico.
q.t: The new campaign by Brothers of Italy to stop the spread of Islamic fundamentalism is called "None Remain Hidden."

q.o: Dopo anni di immigrazione incontrollata voluta dalla sinistra e la formazione di pericolose "zone franche", Fratelli d'Italia vuole con questa campagna favorire l'emancipazione femminile e contrastare la minaccia del separatismo religioso
q.t: After years of uncontrolled immigration wanted by the left and the formation of dangerous "free zones," Brothers of Italy wants with this campaign to promote female emancipation and counter the threat of religious separatism

ti: Carceri: con inibitori mai più telefonini negli istituti, svolta storica
s: Brothers of Italy announces the successful testing of a cell phone signal jammer at Secondigliano prison, with plans to expand the technology to other prisons to prevent illegal communications by organized crime inmates.

q.o: Da oggi i telefonini in carcere saranno del tutto inutili. La sperimentazione dell'inibitore nel carcere di Secondigliano, conclusa pochi minuti fa, è riuscita alla perfezione.
q.t: From today, cell phones in prison will be completely useless. The testing of the jammer at Secondigliano prison, concluded a few minutes ago, was perfectly successful.

q.o: L'avevamo detto: renderemo impossibile la vita alla mafia e ai criminali che vogliono continuare a dare ordini dal carcere. Stiamo rispettando l'impegno preso con gli italiani.
q.t: We said it: we will make life impossible for the mafia and criminals who want to continue giving orders from prison. We are keeping the commitment made to Italians.

q.o: Con Secondigliano si apre una nuova fase nella risposta dello Stato alla camorra: più sicurezza, più controllo e strumenti più efficaci per impedire che il carcere possa essere utilizzato per mantenere e rafforzare i legami criminali con l'esterno
q.t: With Secondigliano a new phase opens in the State's response to the camorra: more security, more control and more effective tools to prevent prison from being used to maintain and strengthen criminal ties with the outside

ti: Nucleare: legge rafforza autonomia energetica, mantenuto impegno
s: Italian Parliament definitively approved nuclear energy legislation allowing Italy to produce nuclear power after nearly forty years, with Prime Minister Meloni stating it will strengthen energy autonomy and reduce dependence on foreign electricity imports.

q.o: Oggi il Parlamento ha approvato in via definitiva la legge sul nucleare.Dopo quasi quarant'anni, l'Italia torna ad avere un quadro di regole per produrre energia nucleare.
q.t: Today Parliament definitively approved the law on nuclear energy. After almost forty years, Italy once again has a regulatory framework to produce nuclear energy.

q.o: Oggi importiamo elettricità prodotta dalle centrali nucleari di nazioni vicine, ma non possiamo produrla noi. Questa legge serve a cambiare le cose.
q.t: Today we import electricity produced by nuclear power plants in neighboring countries, but we cannot produce it ourselves. This law serves to change things.

q.o: Era un impegno preso con gli italiani. Un altro impegno che abbiamo mantenuto.
q.t: It was a commitment made to Italians. Another commitment we have kept.

ti: Pnnr: raggiunti obiettivi ultima rata, successo del governo
s: Brothers of Italy parliamentary leaders congratulated the Meloni government for achieving all 156 objectives of the tenth and final tranche of the PNRR (National Recovery and Resilience Plan), completing all 576 planned targets.

q.o: Il conseguimento e la rendicontazione di tutti i 156 obiettivi legati alla decima e ultima rata del Pnrr rappresentano un risultato di grande rilievo per l'Italia e motivo di soddisfazione per il lavoro svolto dal Governo Meloni.
q.t: The achievement and reporting of all 156 objectives linked to the tenth and final tranche of the PNRR represent a result of great importance for Italy and a reason for satisfaction with the work done by the Meloni Government.

q.o: Il valore di questo risultato va oltre le scadenze rispettate, perché gli investimenti e i progetti realizzati potranno produrre effetti positivi anche negli anni a venire, migliorando i servizi, creando opportunità e rafforzando i territori.
q.t: The value of this result goes beyond the deadlines met, because the investments and projects carried out will be able to produce positive effects in the years to come, improving services, creating opportunities and strengthening the territories.

ti: Case popolari: stop agevolazioni per chi ha occupato abusivamente
s: Brothers of Italy Vice President of the Chamber Fabio Rampelli presented an amendment to the Public Administration Decree-Law prohibiting regularization or preferential treatment for those who illegally occupy properties, with senators De Priamo and Scurria endorsing the measure as restoring legality in public housing allocation.

q.o: Bene il nuovo emendamento presentato dal vicepresidente della Camera Fabio Rampelli al Decreto-legge Pubblica Amministrazione in cui si stabilisce un divieto chiaro: stop a qualsiasi forma di regolarizzazione o corsia preferenziale per chi occupa abusivamente immobili privati ovvero se il Comune o altro ente pubblico decide di acquistare un immobile precedentemente occupato abusivamente, l'acquisto impedisce la regolarizzazione a qualunque titolo dell'occupazione.
q.t: Good the new amendment presented by Vice President of the Chamber Fabio Rampelli to the Public Administration Decree-Law which establishes a clear prohibition: stop to any form of regularization or preferential treatment for those who illegally occupy private properties, or if the Municipality or other public entity decides to purchase a property previously illegally occupied, the purchase prevents regularization under any title of the occupation.

q.o: Chi ha occupato abusivamente un immobile a spese dei cittadini, non può pensare di rientrare, grazie a quel reato, in una corsia 'preferenziale' per avanzare nelle graduatorie pubbliche sulla residenza popolare.
q.t: Those who have illegally occupied a property at the expense of citizens cannot think of entering, thanks to that crime, into a 'preferential' lane to advance in public rankings for public housing.

ti: Pesca: via a credito imposta per carburanti, in arrivo 7 milioni
s: The Italian government adopted a decree establishing a tax credit for fuel costs in the fishing sector worth 7 million euros, announced by Agriculture Minister Francesco Lollobrigida as support for fishing enterprises.

q.o: Con l'adozione di questo decreto confermiamo, ancora una volta, l'attenzione costante e concreta del Governo Meloni e del Ministero dell'Agricoltura, della Sovranità alimentare e delle Foreste verso il mondo della pesca, settore strategico per l'economia e l'identità della nostra Nazione.
q.t: With the adoption of this decree we confirm, once again, the constant and concrete attention of the Meloni Government and the Ministry of Agriculture, Food Sovereignty and Forests towards the world of fishing, a strategic sector for the economy and identity of our Nation.

q.o: Si tratta di un'ulteriore misura fondamentale di sostegno per le nostre imprese ittiche, pensata per calmierare l'impatto del caro carburante e dare respiro a migliaia di lavoratori.
q.t: This is a further fundamental support measure for our fishing enterprises, designed to mitigate the impact of expensive fuel and give relief to thousands of workers.

ti: Carta dedicata a te: mille euro a oltre un milione di famiglie
s: The Meloni government announces the fourth consecutive year of the "Carta Dedicata a Te" program, providing 1,000 euros per family to over 1.1 million economically vulnerable Italian families, with 500 euros to be credited on November 4, 2026, and another 500 euros in April 2027.

q.o: Sarà disponibile oltre 1 miliardo di euro, 1.000 euro per famiglia. Una scelta concreta che rafforza il sostegno ai nuclei più fragili e che consentirà a oltre 1,1 milioni di famiglie di trovare accreditati i primi 500 euro sulla propria carta il prossimo 4 novembre e altri 500 euro ad aprile 2027.
q.t: Over 1 billion euros will be available, 1,000 euros per family. A concrete choice that strengthens support for the most fragile households and will allow over 1.1 million families to find the first 500 euros credited to their card on November 4 and another 500 euros in April 2027.

q.o: Il governo Meloni sin dal suo insediamento ha pensato alle famiglie. Non abbiamo mai smesso di seguire con attenzione quelle che erano le difficoltà degli italiani e non lasciamo indietro nessuno. Nessun assistenzialismo, ma sostegno vero per aiutare le famiglie ad acquistare beni di prima necessità
q.t: The Meloni government has thought about families since its installation. We have never stopped carefully following the difficulties of Italians and we leave no one behind. No welfare dependency, but real support to help families purchase basic necessities

ti: Socar to Cut Italy Fuel Prices, Pre-Empting Meloni Windfall Tax - bloomberg.com
s: Socar announced fuel price cuts in Italy in apparent response to a windfall tax proposal by the Meloni government.

ti: La Settimana Leghista #38 - Lega per Salvini Premier
s: League party held its annual Pontida rally and announced multiple policy initiatives including postponing Euro 5 diesel ban, approving nuclear energy legislation, banning burqa and niqab in schools, proposing measures against political Islam, advancing regional autonomy, and pushing for pension reform at age 64 and flat tax expansion.

q.o: È da 30 anni che celebrano il funerale della Lega, e invece siamo ancora qua. Più determinati che mai.
q.t: For 30 years they have been celebrating the funeral of the League, and yet we are still here. More determined than ever.

q.o: Ok dal Consiglio dei Ministri allo STOP al blocco degli Euro 5. Promessa mantenuta!
q.t: OK from the Council of Ministers to STOP the Euro 5 ban. Promise kept!

q.o: Burqa e niqab non hanno spazio nella scuola italiana
q.t: Burqa and niqab have no place in Italian schools

q.o: Il problema non è l'Islam come religione, il problema è l'utilizzo politico della religione islamica, che è il pericolo pubblico numero uno per il futuro dei nostri figli e per le libertà che ci siamo conquistati con decenni di battaglie
q.t: The problem is not Islam as a religion, the problem is the political use of the Islamic religion, which is public danger number one for the future of our children and for the freedoms we have won with decades of battles

q.o: Non vedo perché un lavoratore italiano debba essere condannato ad aspettare i 67 anni
q.t: I don't see why an Italian worker should be condemned to wait until 67 years old

q.o: Se in un momento difficile chiediamo un piccolo contributo a chi ha guadagnato tantissimo, non mi sembra una rivoluzione bolscevica
q.t: If in a difficult moment we ask for a small contribution from those who have earned a great deal, it doesn't seem like a Bolshevik revolution to me

ti: The League closes ranks in Pontida, Salvini: "It's exciting to see Sardinian flags too." - L'Unione Sarda English - L'Unione Sarda.it
s: The League held a rally in Pontida where party leader Matteo Salvini expressed enthusiasm about the presence of Sardinian flags among participants.

q.t: It's exciting to see Sardinian flags too

s: Forza Italia leader Antonio Tajani criticized League leader Matteo Salvini's windfall profit tax proposal, endorsing instead Eni's voluntary fuel price cap as the preferred approach to addressing energy costs.

q.t: This is the way forward, not windfall profits

s: Salvini stated that if he wins, he will not govern alone and there will be a role for Zaia in his administration.

q.o: Se vinco, non sarò l'unico al comando; ci sarà un ruolo per Zaia
q.t: If I win, I won't be the only one in charge; there will be a role for Zaia

ti: Il lento suicidio del centrosinistra. Una sinistra compromessa è la gioia della destra.
s: Power to the People! published an article by Yanis Varoufakis arguing that compromised centre-left parties enable the rise of the far-right and that the left should remain in opposition rather than govern with false promises.

q.o: In definitiva, la sinistra compromessa anestetizza la speranza, aprendo la strada ai reazionari della peggior specie. Meglio essere un'opposizione onesta a un governo di destra che un esponente della sinistra compromesso le cui politiche generano mostri.
q.t: Ultimately, the compromised left anesthetizes hope, paving the way for reactionaries of the worst kind. Better to be an honest opposition to a right-wing government than a compromised left exponent whose policies generate monsters.

q.o: È meglio essere all'opposizione, mantenendo viva la speranza, mentre la Destra dell'istitutivo imperversa al governo, piuttosto che una Sinistra compromessa conquisti il ​​potere con false promesse destinate a spegnere la speranza e a inaugurare forme postmoderne di fascismo.
q.t: It is better to be in opposition, keeping hope alive, while the institutional Right rages in government, rather than a compromised Left conquering power with false promises destined to extinguish hope and usher in postmodern forms of fascism.

ti: Has football lost its soul?
ac: Green Party of England and Wales
s: The Green Party published an opinion piece criticising football governance and proposing a £5bn package to fund grassroots sport alongside a mechanism for local authorities to buy shares in professional clubs with dividends reinvested locally.

q.o: the Greens have proposed a £5bn package to properly fund grassroots and community sport. This sits alongside the proposal for a new mechanism letting local authorities buy shares in the professional clubs based in their own area, with any dividends reinvested straight back into local pitches and coaching, not a shareholder's pocket.
football should belong to the people who make it what it is, not to whoever can afford to buy it

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: The Portuguese Communist Party announced it will present parliamentary initiatives to ensure state funding for 20-euro intermodal passes in metropolitan areas from January 1st, extend 20-euro passes to all intermunicipal communities covering all transport modes, provide free passes for those over 65, and invest in expanding public transport services including railway maintenance.

q.o: Mais e melhor oferta, mais intermodalidade, a par de novas reduções de preços, estas são as três vertentes da política consequente de promoção do uso do transporte público que o PCP defende
q.t: More and better service, more intermodality, alongside new price reductions, these are the three aspects of the consistent policy for promoting the use of public transport that the PCP defends

q.o: o PCP irá apresentar na Assembleia da República iniciativas que assegurem o financiamento a partir da Administração Central dos meios necessários para: – fixar nos 20 euros o valor do passe intermodal nas áreas metropolitanas já a partir de 1 de Janeiro
q.t: the PCP will present initiatives in the Assembly of the Republic that ensure funding from the Central Administration of the necessary means to: – fix the value of the intermodal pass in metropolitan areas at 20 euros starting from January 1st

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: Paula Santos of the Portuguese Communist Party criticized PSD, Chega, IL, and CDS for prioritizing corporate profits over workers' welfare, proposed measures including wage increases, price controls on essentials including a €20 cap on gas bottles, and condemned the closure of the Matosinhos refinery as an economic crime that increased national dependence.

q.o: É necessário também um controlo efetivo dos preços, nomeadamente dos alimentos, dos combustíveis, a fixação em 20 € do preço da botija do gás.
q.t: It is also necessary to have effective price control, namely on food and fuel, setting the price of gas bottles at €20.

q.o: O PCP alertou na altura para o desastre e para as consequências para o país que significaria o encerramento da refinaria de de Matosinhos.
q.t: The PCP warned at the time about the disaster and the consequences for the country that the closure of the Matosinhos refinery would mean.

q.o: E isto revela também, em particular por parte do PSD, do Chega, da Iniciativa Liberal e do CDS, que para estas forças políticas a vida dos trabalhadores e dos reformados não importa.
q.t: And this also reveals, particularly on the part of PSD, Chega, Liberal Initiative and CDS, that for these political forces the lives of workers and retirees do not matter.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: PCP deputy Alfredo Maia presented parliamentary proposals to eliminate double taxation on fuel, abolish tolls on the 25 de Abril and Vasco da Gama bridges through immediate concession buyback from Lusoponte, and criticized government measures as insufficient while denouncing complicity with major economic interests amid rising cost of living.

q.o: O custo de vida agudiza-se, e só não melhora porque as forças comprometidas com os grandes interesses não querem afrontá-los.
q.t: The cost of living is worsening, and it only fails to improve because the forces committed to major interests do not want to confront them.

q.o: O que se impõe, como o PCP propõe, entre outras medidas de fundo, é o aumento geral dos salários e das reformas e pensões.
q.t: What is required, as the PCP proposes, among other fundamental measures, is a general increase in wages and pensions.

q.o: Com este projeto, o PCP corrige uma injustiça, eliminando a dupla tributação sobre o Imposto sobre os produtos petrolíferos e energéticos e energéticos, que deixa de estar sujeito à taxa de IVA.
q.t: With this project, the PCP corrects an injustice, eliminating the double taxation on the Tax on petroleum and energy products, which will no longer be subject to the VAT rate.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: Paulo Raimundo intervened in the Assembly of the Republic on 23 September 2026 in a debate requested by the PCP parliamentary group on the start of the school year, criticizing the government for dismantling public education, increasing class sizes to 30 students, leaving 170,000 students without teachers, and pursuing privatization policies.

q.o: Quanto mais avança o Governo mais recua a escola.
q.t: The more the Government advances, the more the school retreats.

q.o: Os estudantes e as escolas não precisam de turmas com mais alunos, precisam é de mais turmas com menos alunos, precisam é de mais professores, mais auxiliares e mais técnicos.
q.t: Students and schools do not need classes with more students, they need more classes with fewer students, they need more teachers, more assistants and more technicians.

q.o: A opção do Governo de deixar andar para degradar, deixar degradar para privatizar, privatizar para fazer negócio, este caminho pode e serve uns poucos, disso não há dúvida, mas não serve certamente a alunos, professores, auxiliares, não serve a Educação em todos os graus de ensino e assim sendo, não serve o País.
q.t: The Government's option to let things deteriorate, let them deteriorate to privatize, privatize to do business, this path may serve a few, there is no doubt about that, but it certainly does not serve students, teachers, assistants, it does not serve Education at all levels of teaching and therefore, it does not serve the Country.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: Paulo Raimundo, Secretary-General of the Portuguese Communist Party, participated in a hearing with commerce sector workers regarding wages, rights, and working hours in Lisbon on 22 September 2026.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: The Portuguese Communist Party's Porto Regional Organisation issued a statement mourning the death of José Viale Moutinho, a party militant, journalist, writer, and former CDU electoral candidate who passed away on September 21, 2026.

q.o: A DORP do PCP manifesta o seu profundo pesar pelo falecimento, na última noite, de José Viale Moutinho.
q.t: The Porto Regional Organisation of the PCP expresses its deep sorrow at the passing, last night, of José Viale Moutinho.
q.sp: Portuguese Communist Party Porto Regional Organisation

q.o: Era militante do Partido Comunista Português e foi candidato da CDU em diversos actos eleitorais.
q.t: He was a militant of the Portuguese Communist Party and was a CDU candidate in various electoral acts.
q.sp: Portuguese Communist Party Porto Regional Organisation

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: The Portuguese Communist Party issued a statement mourning the death of musician Jorge Palma on 22 September 2026, praising his contributions to Portuguese music and culture and his participation in the Festa do Avante!

q.o: Jorge Palma foi uma figura maior da música e da cultura portuguesas feitas e vividas em liberdade.
q.t: Jorge Palma was a major figure in Portuguese music and culture made and lived in freedom.

q.o: As canções de Jorge Palma afirmavam também uma posição no plano político. Pela liberdade, pela democracia, por um Portugal construído pelo povo português, liberto da secular submissão aos poderes económicos, no fascismo ou nos anos das troikas, que desse sentido e construísse o caminho que Abril nos trouxe.
q.t: Jorge Palma's songs also affirmed a position on the political level. For freedom, for democracy, for a Portugal built by the Portuguese people, freed from centuries-old submission to economic powers, under fascism or in the years of the troikas, that would give meaning to and build the path that April brought us.

q.o: Da parte do PCP aqui deixamos a nossa determinação de dar continuidade ao que cantou em, 'a gente não vai parar, a gente vai continuar'.
q.t: On behalf of the PCP we leave here our determination to continue what he sang in, 'we are not going to stop, we are going to continue'.

ti: Partido Comunista Português
s: PCP Political Committee member Jorge Pires held a press conference criticizing the government's education policy, citing 170,000 students without teachers at the start of the 2026/2027 school year and calling for increased education funding, restoration of democratic management, and teacher career valorization.

q.o: Com o início das aulas do ensino secundário, está finalmente concluída a abertura do ano lectivo 2026/2027. Uma abertura marcada pela persistência e agravamento de velhos problemas a que se adicionam outros – mais de 170 mil alunos sem professores
q.t: With the start of secondary school classes, the opening of the 2026/2027 school year is finally complete. An opening marked by the persistence and worsening of old problems to which others are added – more than 170 thousand students without teachers

q.o: Governo e Ministro da Educação não podem fugir às suas responsabilidades políticas pelo que se passa hoje no sector da Educação
q.t: The Government and Minister of Education cannot escape their political responsibilities for what is happening today in the Education sector

q.o: A Escola Pública não precisa de soluções milagrosas, muito menos de rupturas com a Lei de Bases e a Constituição da República. O que precisa é que se acabe com o subfinanciamento da Educação; se restabeleça a gestão democrática; se criem melhores condições de trabalho para docentes e alunos; se valorize a carreira docente
q.t: Public Schools do not need miraculous solutions, much less ruptures with the Basic Law and the Constitution of the Republic. What is needed is to end the underfunding of Education; restore democratic management; create better working conditions for teachers and students; valorize the teaching career

ti: People Power Stops Orange Order at Garvaghy - PBP Representatives Join Overnight Blockade
s: People Before Profit representatives including MLA Gerry Carroll, TD Paul Murphy, and Dublin City Councillor Conor Reddy joined residents in an overnight blockade of Garvaghy Road to prevent an Orange Order march, with over a thousand people participating in solidarity.

q.o: We welcome the news that the Orangemen at Garvaghy have been ordered back to Drumcree Church. But nobody here is under any illusions.
q.t: We welcome the news that the Orangemen at Garvaghy have been ordered back to Drumcree Church. But nobody here is under any illusions.

q.o: This a community held hostage to a march that nobody wants, on a Sunday morning in the rain, while residents try to go about their lives. Keeping the people of the Garvaghy Road on edge for hours on end is simply a siege by another name. Portadown District should do the decent thing and go home now.
q.t: This a community held hostage to a march that nobody wants, on a Sunday morning in the rain, while residents try to go about their lives. Keeping the people of the Garvaghy Road on edge for hours on end is simply a siege by another name. Portadown District should do the decent thing and go home now.

q.o: Well over a thousand people from every corner of Ireland stood on this road through the night in solidarity with the residents of the Garvaghy Road. They waited in the cold and the rain because they understood what was at stake.
q.t: Well over a thousand people from every corner of Ireland stood on this road through the night in solidarity with the residents of the Garvaghy Road. They waited in the cold and the rain because they understood what was at stake.

q.o: There is no appetite in any working class community for a return to the sectarian division and violence of the past, whatever Jim Allister or Jamie Bryson would like. What happened over the past 24 hours at Garvaghy was a stand against sectarianism, violence and hatred, and a testament to the power of ordinary people organised together.
q.t: There is no appetite in any working class community for a return to the sectarian division and violence of the past, whatever Jim Allister or Jamie Bryson would like. What happened over the past 24 hours at Garvaghy was a stand against sectarianism, violence and hatred, and a testament to the power of ordinary people organised together.

ti: People Before Profit Support Garvaghy Road Residents in Portadown
s: People Before Profit members mobilised to Portadown in solidarity with Garvaghy Road residents opposing an Orange Order march as a High Court appeal was heard in Belfast, with party representatives condemning political unionism for stoking sectarian division.

q.o: Political unionism is in deep crisis, wracked by scandal and unable to offer anything to workers. In this crisis, they have chosen to stoke the fires of sectarian division by pushing the plan for this march forward. We will not let them drag us back to the dark days of sectarian violence and division. I will continue to support the residents and stand against any attempt to whip up hatred again.
q.t: Political unionism is in deep crisis, wracked by scandal and unable to offer anything to workers. In this crisis, they have chosen to stoke the fires of sectarian division by pushing the plan for this march forward. We will not let them drag us back to the dark days of sectarian violence and division. I will continue to support the residents and stand against any attempt to whip up hatred again.

q.o: Last week in Leinster House, myself and Richard Boyd Barrett met with residents on Garvaghy Road. We heard heartbreaking stories from the 1990s - a horrific, dark period where 21 members of the community were the victims of sectarian killings as the Orange Order fought to force an unwanted march down the Garvaghy Road. We made a commitment to stand with them and we will maintain that commitment as long as we have to.
q.t: Last week in Leinster House, myself and Richard Boyd Barrett met with residents on Garvaghy Road. We heard heartbreaking stories from the 1990s - a horrific, dark period where 21 members of the community were the victims of sectarian killings as the Orange Order fought to force an unwanted march down the Garvaghy Road. We made a commitment to stand with them and we will maintain that commitment as long as we have to.

q.o: The Garvaghy Road is seared into the memories of people across Ireland because of the horrific violence and sectarian killings that surrounded attempts to force these marches through the community, most horrifically the murder of the three Quinn children, who were burned to death in their home. For 28 years residents here have been able to live without these marches being forced through their community. Nobody should be dragged back to those days. We stand completely with the Garvaghy Road residents, against sectarianism and against any attempt to reopen these wounds.
q.t: The Garvaghy Road is seared into the memories of people across Ireland because of the horrific violence and sectarian killings that surrounded attempts to force these marches through the community, most horrifically the murder of the three Quinn children, who were burned to death in their home. For 28 years residents here have been able to live without these marches being forced through their community. Nobody should be dragged back to those days. We stand completely with the Garvaghy Road residents, against sectarianism and against any attempt to reopen these wounds.

ti: March for Clean Water: Stormont
s: People Before Profit is promoting a march at Stormont on 26 September 2026 demanding urgent action on toxic algae in Lough Neagh and calling for clean water to be prioritised over business interests.

q.o: Clean, safe water is a basic public good and a public health necessity, not something to be sacrificed for the interests of big business.
We need unprecedented action to clean up Lough Neagh, protect our drinking water and put the health of communities and the environment before profit.

ti: Garvaghy Decision a Shameful Capitulation to Unionist Pressure
s: People Before Profit politicians Gerry Carroll and Richard Boyd Barrett condemned the Parades Commission's decision to permit an Orange Order march along Garvaghy Road, calling it a capitulation to unionist pressure and urging both British and Irish governments to prevent the march.

q.o: This is a shameful decision. 28 years of peace on the Garvaghy Road was not a problem in need of fixing. Residents made their opposition to this march known in overwhelming numbers, and they have been ignored.
q.t: This is a shameful decision. 28 years of peace on the Garvaghy Road was not a problem in need of fixing. Residents made their opposition to this march known in overwhelming numbers, and they have been ignored.

q.o: Since the High Court ruling, the Orange Order and unionist politicians have waged a campaign of pressure against the Parades Commission. Days later, the Commission has delivered them what they always wanted. This sequence of events will not be lost on anyone.
q.t: Since the High Court ruling, the Orange Order and unionist politicians have waged a campaign of pressure against the Parades Commission. Days later, the Commission has delivered them what they always wanted. This sequence of events will not be lost on anyone.

q.o: I raised the matter in the Dáil on Wednesday and said the Orange Order should not be allowed to march down Garvaghy Road. I told the Government that it is creating real fear and anxiety about a return to an era when 20 people were murdered in the context of these marches.
q.t: I raised the matter in the Dáil on Wednesday and said the Orange Order should not be allowed to march down Garvaghy Road. I told the Government that it is creating real fear and anxiety about a return to an era when 20 people were murdered in the context of these marches.

q.o: Unionist elites do not speak for working class Protestants, and nobody in any community wants a return to the dead-end violence of the past. This determination should not become a licence for anyone to whip up sectarian tension or to target residents of the Garvaghy Road. People Before Profit stands with the Garvaghy Road community this weekend and beyond.

ti: TDs Vote Today on People Before Profit Motion for €500 Electricity Credits Funded by 20 Cent Levy on Data Centres
s: People Before Profit TDs brought a motion to the Dáil on 23 September 2026 calling for a 20 cent per kilowatt-hour levy on data centre electricity consumption to fund €500 household electricity credits, and for a ban on new data centres.

q.o: Households in Ireland pay the highest electricity prices in the EU. At about €0.40 per kilowatt hour, that's 38% higher than the EU average. However, data centres, which consume a quarter of our electricity, pay an average of about €0.20 per kWh, half the price paid by households.
q.t: Households in Ireland pay the highest electricity prices in the EU. At about €0.40 per kilowatt hour, that's 38% higher than the EU average. However, data centres, which consume a quarter of our electricity, pay an average of about €0.20 per kWh, half the price paid by households.

q.o: This €0.20 levy would raise €1.5 billion , more than enough to pay for a €500 annual electricity credit for every household and an additional €500 electricity credit for households with people with disabilities.
q.t: This €0.20 levy would raise €1.5 billion , more than enough to pay for a €500 annual electricity credit for every household and an additional €500 electricity credit for households with people with disabilities.

q.o: People do not want any more data centres taking our electricity, gas and water and creating environmental nuisance and damage. An immediate ban on new data centres is essential to stop the accumulation of more of this toxic waste of the 21st century.
q.t: People do not want any more data centres taking our electricity, gas and water and creating environmental nuisance and damage. An immediate ban on new data centres is essential to stop the accumulation of more of this toxic waste of the 21st century.

q.o: We know the Government told KPMG to remove any negative commentary , and to present an entirely positive and therefore an entirely dishonest report.
q.t: We know the Government told KPMG to remove any negative commentary , and to present an entirely positive and therefore an entirely dishonest report.

ti: Carroll Brings Toxic Lough Neagh Water into Assembly Chamber: "Would any MLA Take a Sip?"
s: People Before Profit MLA Gerry Carroll brought a jar of toxic algae-contaminated water from Lough Neagh into the Northern Ireland Assembly chamber to highlight the water crisis, challenged MLAs to drink it, blamed the Executive's Going for Growth strategy and factory farms for the pollution, accused the DUP of using Drumcree sectarian tensions as distraction, and announced party participation in a March for Clean Water at Stormont on 26 September 2026.

q.o: What I held up in the chamber today is Lough Neagh. It's green, it stinks, and it's toxic. And it is the source of at least 40% of our drinking water. People are expected to drink this, to bathe their children in it and to swim in it. I asked MLAs today whether any of them would take a sip. Not one of them would, and yet they expect the public to live with it.
q.t: What I held up in the chamber today is Lough Neagh. It's green, it stinks, and it's toxic. And it is the source of at least 40% of our drinking water. People are expected to drink this, to bathe their children in it and to swim in it. I asked MLAs today whether any of them would take a sip. Not one of them would, and yet they expect the public to live with it.

q.o: This disaster was created by the Going for Growth strategy the Executive parties and official opposition signed up to, by factory farms waved through on the lough shore, by underinvestment in sewage infrastructure and by a total failure to crack down on agri-polluters.
q.t: This disaster was created by the Going for Growth strategy the Executive parties and official opposition signed up to, by factory farms waved through on the lough shore, by underinvestment in sewage infrastructure and by a total failure to crack down on agri-polluters.

q.o: On Saturday, thousands will march for clean water at Stormont. Fishers, farmers, swimmers, trade unionists, from every community. Clean water isn't orange or green. It's a fundamental right.
q.t: On Saturday, thousands will march for clean water at Stormont. Fishers, farmers, swimmers, trade unionists, from every community. Clean water isn't orange or green. It's a fundamental right.

ti: Neutralitätsinitiative und Ernährungsinitiative abgelehnt
s: The Swiss Party of Labour (PdAS) expressed regret over the rejection of both the Neutrality Initiative and the Food Initiative in the September 27, 2026 referendum, stating it will continue campaigning for ecological agriculture, disarmament, and opposition to military alliances.

q.o: Die von der Initiative angestrebten Ziele waren sehr ambitioniert, aber die Realität zwingt uns zu diesen Massnahmen. Wir werden auch weiterhin für eine ökologische und sozial gerechte Umgestaltung der Landwirtschaft kämpfen, die unsere Ernährungssouveränität garantiert.
q.t: The goals pursued by the initiative were very ambitious, but reality compels us to take these measures. We will continue to fight for an ecological and socially just transformation of agriculture that guarantees our food sovereignty.

q.o: Das Nein zur Neutralitätsinitiative war für viele ein Nein zur Scheinheiligkeit der SVP und zu ihrem ungebremsten Militarismus. Glaubwürdige Friedenspolitik bedeutet neben der Ablehnung von Blockdenken und Militärbündnissen auch der Kampf für Abrüstung, gegen Kriegsmaterialexporte und für soziale Gerechtigkeit.
q.t: The No to the Neutrality Initiative was for many a No to the hypocrisy of the SVP and to its unbridled militarism. Credible peace policy means, in addition to rejecting bloc thinking and military alliances, also the fight for disarmament, against war material exports, and for social justice.

s: Democratic Patriotic Movement – Victory criticizes the government for protecting corporate energy profits and budget surpluses while failing to protect citizens from fuel price increases, demanding immediate reduction of special consumption tax and VAT on fuels to keep prices below €1.20 per liter.

q.o: Η κυβέρνηση έχει αποδείξει πως τα οικονομικά συμφέροντα των εταιρειών ενέργειας, των διυλιστηρίων, των μεγάλων ομίλων ενέργειας και τα υπέρογκα δημοσιονομικά έσοδα μαζί με τα υπερπλεονάσματα χρήζουν κρατικής προστασίας, ενώ οι καταναλωτές όχι.
q.t: The government has proven that the economic interests of energy companies, refineries, large energy groups and the excessive fiscal revenues together with the surpluses deserve state protection, while consumers do not.

q.o: Η ΝΙΚΗ επιμένει πως η μείωση του ΕΦΚ και του σχετιζόμενου ΦΠΑ στα καύσιμα είναι το πρώτο και άμεσο μέτρο που πρέπει να ληφθεί, προκειμένου οι τιμές να μην υπερβαίνουν τα 1,20€ / λίτρο.
q.t: NIKI insists that the reduction of the special consumption tax and the related VAT on fuels is the first and immediate measure that must be taken, so that prices do not exceed €1.20 per liter.

ti: La Macronie et l’extrême droite menacent le droit à l’IVG : le 28 septembre, journée mondiale de lutte pour le droit à l’avortement, mobilisons-nous pour le défendre !
s: France Unbowed calls for mobilization on September 28, 2026 (International Safe Abortion Day) to defend abortion rights, criticizing budget cuts by the Macron government and Rassemblement National, and promising to reopen closed abortion centers if elected in 2027.

q.o: Alors qu'une femme sur trois y aura recours dans sa vie et que les besoins augmentent (7 219 IVG de plus en 2025), Emmanuel Macron et Sébastien Lecornu en menacent chaque année l'accès en poursuivant les coupes budgétaires soutenues par le Rassemblement national.
q.t: While one woman in three will have recourse to it in her life and needs are increasing (7,219 more abortions in 2025), Emmanuel Macron and Sébastien Lecornu threaten access to it each year by continuing budget cuts supported by the Rassemblement National.

q.o: En 2027, avec Jean-Luc Mélenchon, nous rendrons ce droit fondamental effectif pour toutes. Nous rouvrirons les centres IVG fermés et formerons les professionnels de santé.
q.t: In 2027, with Jean-Luc Mélenchon, we will make this fundamental right effective for all. We will reopen the closed abortion centers and train health professionals.

ti: EU-Energiepolitik: Der Letzte macht das Licht aus
s: FPÖ MEP Georg Mayer criticizes EU Energy Commissioner Dan Jørgensen's energy-saving recommendations and calls for a fundamental reassessment of European energy policy, arguing that REPowerEU has failed to deliver energy security and that the Commission should reconsider its decisions excluding Russian energy sources.

q.o: Der Letzte macht das Licht aus – treffender könnte man die Energiepolitik dieser Europäischen Kommission kaum zusammenfassen. Vier Jahre nach 'REPowerEU' steht Europa erneut vor angespannten Energiemärkten, und der zuständige Kommissar weiß sich offensichtlich nicht anders zu helfen, als den Mitgliedsstaaten Energiesparen und das Abschalten der nächtlichen Beleuchtung nahezulegen
q.t: The last one turns out the lights – one could hardly summarize the energy policy of this European Commission more aptly. Four years after 'REPowerEU', Europe once again faces strained energy markets, and the responsible Commissioner apparently knows no other way to help than to recommend energy saving and switching off night-time lighting to member states

q.o: Wenn vier Jahre nach 'REPowerEU' bei der nächsten angespannten Versorgungslage wieder dieselben Rezepte aus der Energiekrise 2022 hervorgeholt werden, muss man die Frage stellen, was diese Strategie tatsächlich an Versorgungssicherheit gebracht hat. Wer eine zentrale Bezugsquelle politisch ausschließt, muss vorher sicherstellen, dass ausreichend leistbare und verlässliche Alternativen vorhanden sind. Alles andere ist energiepolitischer Blindflug
q.t: If four years after 'REPowerEU', the same recipes from the 2022 energy crisis are being pulled out again at the next strained supply situation, one must ask the question what this strategy has actually brought in terms of security of supply. Anyone who politically excludes a central source of supply must first ensure that sufficient affordable and reliable alternatives are available. Everything else is energy policy flying blind

q.o: Europa braucht keine neuen Durchhalteparolen und keine Empfehlungen zum Lichtabschalten. Europa braucht eine Energiepolitik, die Versorgungssicherheit, Leistbarkeit und wirtschaftliche Vernunft wieder an die erste Stelle setzt
q.t: Europe does not need new slogans of perseverance and no recommendations to turn off lights. Europe needs an energy policy that puts security of supply, affordability and economic reason back in first place

ti: Δ. Νατσιός: Σε πνευματική καθίζηση ο λαός μας – Υπερφίαλος, αλαζόνας και εκτός πραγματικότητας ο Μητσοτάκης
s: NIKI president Dimitris Natsios gave a radio interview criticizing the government's economic and energy policies, accusing Prime Minister Mitsotakis of being arrogant and out of touch with reality, and calling for a stronger stance on Greek-Turkish relations.

q.o: Δεν είναι ούτε πολιτικό το σύστημα, είναι παραπολιτικό, είναι μικροπολιτικό, είναι ένα γκανγκστερικό, θα έλεγα, σχέδιο… Έχουν καταστρέψει και πνευματικά την πατρίδα μας, εκτός από την οικονομική και κοινωνική καθίζηση. Αυτό είναι το χειρότερο
q.t: The system is not even political, it is para-political, it is micro-political, it is a gangster-like scheme, I would say... They have also destroyed our homeland spiritually, in addition to the economic and social collapse. This is the worst thing

q.o: Μην ψαλιδίζουμε την ελπίδα, να μην τη χάσουμε γιατί θα χαθεί και το γέλιο στο πρόσωπο των παιδιών, και αν χαθεί θα καταντήσουμε ένα απέραντο νεκροταφείο
q.t: Let's not cut off hope, let's not lose it because the laughter on children's faces will also be lost, and if it is lost we will become a vast cemetery

q.o: Όταν η Τουρκία απειλεί, εμείς τι λέμε; "Θα το πω στη μαμά μου"… Η διαχρονική απάντηση της Ελλάδος στις επιβουλές των Τούρκων έπρεπε να είναι δύο λέξεις, για να αναθαρρήσει ο λαός: "Μολών λαβέ"
q.t: When Turkey threatens, what do we say? 'I'll tell my mom'... Greece's timeless response to Turkish machinations should be two words, to encourage the people: 'Molon labe' [Come and take them]

q.o: Είναι εκτός τόπου και χρόνου
q.t: He is out of place and time

ti: Η ανάπτυξη μειώνει στροφές και κατεβάζει ταχύτητα – Η Ελλάδα υστερεί σε εξαγωγές και απασχόληση
s: NIKI's Economic Team criticized the Greek government's seven-year economic policy, stating that despite unprecedented European fund inflows, Greece's economy shows limited dynamism with GDP growth of 1.9% in Q2 2026, employment declining by 0.4%, and exports growing at half the EU rate.

q.o: Στη ΝΙΚΗ πιστεύουμε οτι μετά από 7 χρόνια αντιλαϊκής κυβερνητικής οικονομικής πολιτικής, η ελληνική οικονομία παραμένει εγκλωβισμένη στις ίδιες δομικές αδυναμίες.
q.t: At NIKI we believe that after 7 years of anti-popular governmental economic policy, the Greek economy remains trapped in the same structural weaknesses.

q.o: Οι αριθμοί της Eurostat καταγράφουν το αποτύπωμα και τις επιπτώσεις, αυτή η 7ετία μετριέται: σε παραγωγή που δεν έγινε, σε εξαγωγές που υστέρησαν, σε ευρωπαϊκούς πόρους που δεν μεταφράστηκαν στην αναγκαία οικονομική δυναμική σε ευκαιρίες που χάθηκαν.
q.t: Eurostat's numbers record the imprint and consequences, this seven-year period is measured: in production that did not happen, in exports that lagged, in European resources that were not translated into the necessary economic dynamism, in opportunities that were lost.

ti: Δ. Νατσιός στο Pontos TV: Οι εξαγγελίες Μητσοτάκη είναι κοροϊδία – Η ΝΙΚΗ μπήκε στην πολιτική με σημαία την αξιοπρέπεια
s: NIKI president Dimitris Natsios categorically ruled out any pre-election or post-election cooperation with New Democracy or other parties, criticized the government's policy announcements as inadequate, and reaffirmed the party's positions on traditional family values and opposition to same-sex marriage legislation.

q.o: Καταστατική αρχή της ΝΙΚΗΣ είναι να μην συνεργάζεται με ανθρώπους οι οποίοι υπέγραψαν τα εγκληματικά, για εμάς και για πολύ κόσμο, μνημόνια
q.t: It is a statutory principle of NIKI not to cooperate with people who signed the memoranda, which are criminal for us and for many people

q.o: Πώς μπορείς να συνεργαστείς σε μια κυβέρνηση, γιατί έχουμε και ταυτοτικές διαφορές, που ψήφισε τον ψευτο γάμο των ομοφυλοφίλων
q.t: How can you cooperate in a government, because we also have identity differences, that voted for the fake marriage of homosexuals

q.o: Εμείς μπήκαμε στην πολιτική με σημαία μας την αξιοπρέπεια
q.t: We entered politics with dignity as our flag

q.o: Εμείς φτιάχνουμε οικογένειες κανονικές, με παπά και με κουμπάρο, με άντρα και γυναίκα
q.t: We create normal families, with a priest and a best man, with a man and a woman

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: MeRA25 announced support for a demonstration and march on Monday 21 September at 18:30 at Gladstownos and gatherings across Greece marking eight years since the killing of Zak Kostopoulos, calling for justice and continued struggle against transphobia, homophobia, racism, patriarchy, and fascism.

q.o: 8 χρόνια μετά την άγρια δολοφονία του Ζακ στο κέντρο της Αθήνας ο αγώνας για δικαιοσύνη και ορατότητα συνεχίζεται.
q.t: 8 years after the brutal murder of Zak in the center of Athens the struggle for justice and visibility continues.

q.o: Χρέος μας είναι να συνεχίσουμε τον αγώνα ενάντια σε κάθε μορφή πατριαρχίας, σεξισμού, ομοφοβίας, τρανσφοβίας, ρατσισμού και φασισμού.
q.t: It is our duty to continue the struggle against every form of patriarchy, sexism, homophobia, transphobia, racism and fascism.

q.o: Ως ΛΟΑΤΚΙ+ άτομα και ως άτομα που στεκόμαστε στο πλευρό της ΛΟΑΤΚΙ+ κοινότητας, στηρίζουμε μαζί με άλλες συλλογικότητες τη συγκέντρωση και πορεία την Δευτέρα 21 Σεπτεμβρίου στις 18:30 στη Γλάδστωνος και τις συγκεντρώσεις σε όλη την Ελλάδα.
q.t: As LGBTQI+ people and as people who stand by the side of the LGBTQI+ community, we support together with other collectives the gathering and march on Monday 21 September at 18:30 at Gladstownos and the gatherings across Greece.

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: MeRA25 Secretary Yanis Varoufakis issued a statement commemorating Margarita Papandreou, praising her legacy for advancing Greek women's freedom and independence.

q.o: Το πέρασμα της από αυτό τον κόσμο άφησε τις Ελληνίδες πιο ελεύθερες, πιο ανεξάρτητες, πιο ικανές να ορίζουν τις τύχες τους. Στη Μαργαρίτα Παπανδρέου αξίζουν τιμές που κάποια στιγμή θα αποδοθούν. Θα μου λειψει η σκέψη της φυσικής της παρουσίας. Και θα την κρατώ στη σκέψη μου.
q.t: Her passing from this world left Greek women more free, more independent, more capable of determining their own fates. Margarita Papandreou deserves honors that will be bestowed at some point. I will miss the thought of her physical presence. And I will keep her in my thoughts.

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: MeRA25 met with the Committee of Organizations and Residents of Agia Paraskevi on 14 September 2026 and declared full support for their demands to protect Mount Hymettus from development, transfer Ministry of Agricultural Development land to the municipality as green space, and coordinate inter-municipal resistance against government plans.

q.o: Ως ΜέΡΑ25 Ενωτική Αριστερά δηλώσαμε ότι στηρίζουμε με όλες μας τις δυνάμεις τη διεκδίκηση-στόχο της Επιτροπής να αποδοθεί η μεγάλη έκταση του Υπουργείου Αγροτικής Ανάπτυξης (εξαιρουμένων των κτιριακών εγκαταστάσεων) στον Δήμο Αγίας Παρασκευής, ως πράσινος ελεύθερος χώρος αναψυχής
q.t: As MeRA25 United Left we declared that we support with all our forces the Committee's demand-goal that the large area of the Ministry of Agricultural Development (excluding building facilities) be transferred to the Municipality of Agia Paraskevi as a green open recreational space

q.o: Ως ΜέΡΑ25 Ενωτική Αριστερά θεωρούμε τα ζητήματα κλιματικής κρίσης, βιώσιμης πόλης, πρασίνου και προστασίας του περιβάλλοντος κορυφαία στο πρόγραμμά μας και από τις πιο σημαντικές μάχες της εποχής μας!
q.t: As MeRA25 United Left we consider the issues of climate crisis, sustainable city, green spaces and environmental protection as top priorities in our program and among the most important battles of our era!

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: MeRA25 calls for mass participation in a memorial march on 18 September 2026 marking 13 years since the murder of Pavlos Fyssas by Golden Dawn, framing the event as urgent antifascist vigilance coinciding with the release of convicted neo-Nazi Ilias Kasidiaris.

q.o: Ως ΜέΡΑ25 Ενωτική Αριστερά απευθύνουμε κάλεσμα μαζικής συμμετοχής στην πορεία μνήμης για τα 13 χρόνια από τη δολοφονία του Παύλου Φύσσα, στο Κερατσίνι από το τάγμα εφόδου της ΧΑ.
q.t: As MeRA25 United Left we issue a call for mass participation in the memorial march for 13 years since the murder of Pavlos Fyssas in Keratsini by the assault battalion of Golden Dawn.

q.o: Δεν θα επιτρέψουμε το σκοτάδι του νεοναζισμού και ο φόβος να επιστρέψει στους δρόμους και τις γειτονιές μας, ούτε θα δεχτούμε το ξέπλυμα των εγκλημάτων τους από ένα σύστημα που τους χρησιμοποιεί ως χρήσιμα εργαλεία.
q.t: We will not allow the darkness of neo-Nazism and fear to return to our streets and neighborhoods, nor will we accept the whitewashing of their crimes by a system that uses them as useful tools.

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: Yanis Varoufakis, Secretary of MeRA25, gave an interview on City FM 106.1 criticizing that much money passed through the Greek market without reaching small and medium-sized businesses.

q.o: Πέρασαν πολλά λεφτά από την ελληνική αγορά χωρίς να σταματήσουν στους μικρομεσαίους
q.t: Much money passed through the Greek market without stopping at small and medium-sized businesses

q.o: Μόνο με ισχυρό ΣΥΡΙΖΑ-ΠΣ μπορεί να υπάρξει αλλαγή
q.t: Only with a strong SYRIZA-PS can there be change

q.o: Το φασισμό βαθιά κατάλαβέ τον. Δε θα πεθάνει…
q.t: Understand fascism deeply. It will not die...

ti: Bezahlbares Leben statt Schuldenfalle
s: Die Linke party chair Luigi Pantisano responds to the Hamburg Institute for Financial Services' over-indebtedness report, calling for government intervention including strict regulation of digital buy-now-pay-later services, higher wages, affordable rents, and free debt counseling nationwide.

q.o: 5,67 Millionen überschuldete Menschen sind vorallem ein Armutszeugnis für diese Bundesregierung.
q.t: 5.67 million over-indebted people are above all a damning indictment of this federal government.

q.o: Digitale Bezahlangebote nach dem Prinzip 'heute kaufen, später zahlen' müssen so streng geregelt werden, dass junge Menschen nicht länger mit einem Klick in die Schuldenfalle gelockt werden.
q.t: Digital payment offers based on the principle 'buy now, pay later' must be strictly regulated so that young people are no longer lured into the debt trap with one click.

q.o: Wir brauchen gute Löhne, bezahlbare Mieten und bundesweit kostenlose Schuldnerberatungen ohne lange Wartezeiten.
q.t: We need good wages, affordable rents and nationwide free debt counseling without long waiting times.

ti: 3e RPIMa de Carcassonne : les discours politiques et d’extrême droite n’ont pas leur place dans nos armées
s: La France insoumise parliamentary group demands immediate dismissal of a military chaplain and investigation after Le Canard enchaîné revealed he made political statements against "leftists" and referenced "great replacement" theory during a Saint-Michel celebration at the 3rd Marine Infantry Parachute Regiment in Carcassonne, with the group also announcing they will file a judicial report under Article 40.

q.o: Les images révélées par Le Canard enchaîné sont extrêmement graves. Lors d'une célébration de la Saint-Michel devant des militaires du 3e régiment de parachutistes d'infanterie de marine, l'aumônier du régiment s'est livré à une diatribe ouvertement politique, s'en prenant aux « gauchistes » et développant un discours faisant écho à la pseudo théorie du « grand remplacement ».
q.t: The images revealed by Le Canard enchaîné are extremely serious. During a Saint-Michel celebration before soldiers of the 3rd Marine Infantry Parachute Regiment, the regiment's chaplain engaged in an openly political diatribe, attacking 'leftists' and developing a discourse echoing the pseudo-theory of 'great replacement'.

q.o: Le groupe la France insoumise exige la radiation immédiate de l'aumônier et une enquête immédiate de l'inspection pour établir les faits dans leur entièreté et comprendre notamment comment de tels faits ont pu se produire sans réaction du commandement.
q.t: The La France insoumise group demands the immediate dismissal of the chaplain and an immediate inspection investigation to establish the facts in their entirety and understand in particular how such facts could occur without reaction from the command.

q.o: L'armée française appartient à la Nation tout entière. Aucun courant politique, aucune idéologie et aucun militantisme partisan ne peuvent se l'approprier.
q.t: The French army belongs to the entire Nation. No political current, no ideology and no partisan activism can appropriate it.

ti: Non à la fermeture programmée du service des urgences de l’hôpital militaire de Metz
s: La France insoumise deputies on the national defense commission demand cancellation of the planned closure of the emergency service at Legouest military hospital in Metz, scheduled for early 2027, and call for coordination between public health actors to maintain emergency care access.

q.o: Les députés de La France insoumise exigent l'annulation de cette décision et le renoncement à cette fermeture programmée.
q.t: The deputies of La France insoumise demand the cancellation of this decision and the abandonment of this planned closure.

q.o: Ils demandent à la ministre des Armées de garantir les moyens nécessaires afin que le Service de santé des armées (SSA), qui opère dans cet hôpital, maintienne l'accès aux soins d'urgence pour les populations civiles et militaires de Metz et de sa région.
q.t: They ask the Minister of the Armed Forces to guarantee the necessary means so that the Armed Forces Health Service (SSA), which operates in this hospital, maintains access to emergency care for the civilian and military populations of Metz and its region.

ti: Fuites sur la garde à vue de Rima Hassan : les révélations de « Complément d’enquête » mettent en cause Laurent Nuñez
s: La France insoumise demands the resignation of Laurent Nuñez, former Interior Minister, after revelations that he exchanged information with journalists about Rima Hassan's police custody, including details covered by investigation secrecy.

q.o: Le ministre de l'Intérieur aurait-il lui-même transmis ou confirmé auprès de journalistes des informations couvertes par le secret de l'enquête ?
q.t: Did the Interior Minister himself transmit or confirm to journalists information covered by investigation secrecy?

q.o: Face à ces révélations, Laurent Nuñez doit tirer les conséquences de la gravité des faits mis en lumière. La France insoumise demande sa démission.
q.t: In light of these revelations, Laurent Nuñez must draw the consequences of the gravity of the facts brought to light. La France insoumise demands his resignation.

q.o: Cette nouvelle affaire met une fois de plus en lumière la gravité des pratiques employées par des membres du gouvernement à l'encontre d'une opposante politique.
q.t: This new affair once again highlights the gravity of practices employed by government members against a political opponent.

s: Marion Maréchal criticized Macronism's immigration record and its calls to vote for La France insoumise during an exchange with Gabriel Attal.

ti: Auch ÖVP-Länder greifen FPÖ-Forderung nach niedrigeren Sprit-Steuern auf
s: FPÖ General Secretary Michael Schnedlitz demands abolition of the CO2 tax and halving of the mineral oil tax to reduce fuel prices, criticizing the government for insufficient action and warning of an impending inflation spiral.

q.o: Die FPÖ fordert seit Monaten niedrigere Steuern auf Benzin und Diesel.
q.t: The FPÖ has been demanding lower taxes on petrol and diesel for months.

q.o: Beobachten macht keine Tankfüllung billiger. Die Fakten liegen am Tisch. Es fehlt keine weitere Erkenntnis, sondern die Entscheidung zur sofortigen Entlastung
q.t: Observing does not make filling up the tank cheaper. The facts are on the table. What is missing is not further insight, but the decision for immediate relief

q.o: CO2-Steuer abschaffen und Mineralölsteuer halbieren! Jeder weitere Monat des Zuwartens belastet Pendler, Familien und Betriebe und droht, höhere Kosten für das nächste Jahr festzuschreiben.
q.t: Abolish the CO2 tax and halve the mineral oil tax! Every additional month of waiting burdens commuters, families and businesses and threatens to lock in higher costs for next year.

ti: News
s: The FPÖ announced parliamentary inquiries to the Interior and Science Ministers regarding the Austrian Students' Union inviting a former Al-Qaeda member to an event at the University of Vienna, and criticized EU funding priorities for gender projects over AI research and for excluding domestic solar thermal producers while favoring nuclear power and Chinese imports.

q.o: ÖH lädt ehemaliges Al-Kaida-Mitglied zu Veranstaltung ein – FPÖ kündigt parlamentarische Anfragen an Innen- und Wissenschaftsminister an.
q.t: The Austrian Students' Union invites a former Al-Qaeda member to an event – FPÖ announces parliamentary inquiries to the Interior and Science Ministers.

q.o: Brüssel nutzt Wissenschaft als trojanisches Pferd für linke Umerziehung – FPÖ fordert Stopp der Steuergeldverschwendung und klares Bekenntnis zur…
q.t: Brussels uses science as a Trojan horse for left-wing re-education – FPÖ demands a stop to the waste of tax money and a clear commitment to…

q.o: Wichtige heimische Zukunftstechnologie von EU-Förderung ausgeschlossen – Atomkraft und China-Importe werden bevorzugt
q.t: Important domestic future technology excluded from EU funding – nuclear power and Chinese imports are preferred

ti: Harvard-Studie zeigt Erwärmung durch Windparks
s: FPÖ MEP Gerald Hauser announced a parliamentary question demanding the EU Commission investigate and disclose the effects of wind farm expansion on local temperatures and soil moisture, citing Harvard and Chinese studies showing warming effects.

q.o: Windkraftanlagen verursachen messbare lokale Klima-Effekte, und trotzdem wird dieses Problem von EU-Kommission, Einheitspartei und Mainstream-Medien konsequent ausgeblendet. Gerade angesichts des heißen Sommers und zunehmender Trockenperioden ist es höchste Zeit, die Auswirkungen des massiven Windkraft-Ausbaus auf Temperaturen, Böden und Dürren ehrlich zu untersuchen
q.t: Wind turbines cause measurable local climate effects, and yet this problem is consistently ignored by the EU Commission, the unity party and mainstream media. Especially in light of the hot summer and increasing drought periods, it is high time to honestly investigate the effects of massive wind power expansion on temperatures, soils and droughts

q.o: Die EU-Kommission muss endlich mit offenen Karten spielen. Wenn sie den weiteren massiven Ausbau der Windkraft vorantreibt, muss sie auch offenlegen, welche Auswirkungen dieser Ausbau auf unser lokales Klima, unsere Böden, die Landwirtschaft und zukünftige Dürreperioden haben kann
q.t: The EU Commission must finally play with open cards. If it is pushing ahead with the further massive expansion of wind power, it must also disclose what effects this expansion can have on our local climate, our soils, agriculture and future drought periods

ti: Treibstoffpreise: Italienische Regierung zeigt, wie es geht
s: FPÖ MEP Roman Haider praised the Italian government's suspension of vehicle taxes and fuel tax reductions, demanding Austria adopt similar measures including abolishing the Normverbrauchsabgabe (registration tax), reducing motor insurance tax, and lowering fuel taxation.

q.o: Die italienische Regierung unter Premierministerin Giorgia Meloni und Verkehrsminister Matteo Salvini zeigt, wie es geht
q.t: The Italian government under Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni and Transport Minister Matteo Salvini shows how it's done

q.o: Das zeigt, dass eine Entlastung der Bürger in Zeiten angespannter Budgets möglich ist. Das gilt ebenso für Österreich
q.t: This shows that relief for citizens is possible in times of tight budgets. This also applies to Austria

q.o: Um die Bürger zu entlasten, halte ich sowohl eine Senkung der motorbezogenen Versicherungssteuer und der Treibstoff-Besteuerung nach italienischem Vorbild wie auch die Abschaffung der Normverbrauchsabgabe für machbar und sinnvoll
q.t: To relieve citizens, I consider both a reduction in motor-related insurance tax and fuel taxation following the Italian model, as well as the abolition of the registration tax, to be feasible and sensible

ti: „Vollenden wir, was Jörg Haider begonnen hat!“
s: The FPÖ held a commemorative event in Innsbruck on September 13, 2026, marking the 40th anniversary of Jörg Haider's election as party leader in 1986, with Herbert Kickl calling to complete Haider's political project and presenting Haider's widow with a new party medal.

q.o: Vollenden wir gemeinsam mit der Bevölkerung, was Jörg Haider begonnen hat!
q.t: Let us complete together with the population what Jörg Haider began!

q.o: diesen historischen Parteitag 1986 als zweiten Geburtstag
q.t: this historic party congress of 1986 as a second birthday

q.o: Nicht Remigration ist das Problem. Das Problem ist die illegale Massenzuwanderung!
q.t: Remigration is not the problem. The problem is illegal mass immigration!

q.o: 1970 hatten wir in Österreich 20.000 Muslime, jetzt haben wir 800.000. Ich möchte nicht haben, dass meine Ururenkel dann Bürger eines muslimischen Landes sind
q.t: In 1970 we had 20,000 Muslims in Austria, now we have 800,000. I do not want my great-great-grandchildren to be citizens of a Muslim country

q.o: Kickl ist einer der wichtigsten Friedens- und Neutralitätspolitiker
q.t: Kickl is one of the most important peace and neutrality politicians

q.o: Wir werden die Altparteien vor uns hertreiben
q.t: We will drive the old parties before us

ti: Kindesmissbrauch: ORF verharmlost Skandal um sein Urgestein Günther Paal
s: FPÖ media spokesperson and general secretary Christian Hafenecker criticized the ORF for allegedly downplaying child abuse allegations against cabaret artist Günther Paal and demanded that ORF director-general Thurnher take immediate action and distance the broadcaster from Paal.

q.o: Vom ORF ist man schon einiges gewohnt. Wie jetzt aber versucht wird, den Kindesmissbrauchs-Skandal rund um den seit Jahrzehnten zum ORF-Inventar gehörenden Günther Paal herunterzuspielen und zu verharmlosen, ist ein ORF-Skandal ganz neuer, widerlicher Dimension und muss Konsequenzen haben. ORF-Generaldirektorin Thurnher ist jetzt dringend gefordert, hier sofort aufzuräumen!
q.t: We are used to quite a lot from the ORF. But how they are now trying to downplay and trivialize the child abuse scandal surrounding Günther Paal, who has been part of the ORF inventory for decades, is an ORF scandal of a completely new, disgusting dimension and must have consequences. ORF director-general Thurnher is now urgently required to clean this up immediately!

q.o: Finanzieren mussten diesen zutiefst abstoßenden Beitrag wieder die Österreicher mit der ORF-Zwangssteuer, die ersatzlos abgeschafft gehört.
q.t: Austrians had to finance this deeply repulsive contribution again with the ORF compulsory tax, which should be abolished without replacement.

q.o: Paal ist nach Florian Teichtmeister immerhin der zweite ORF-Star, der auch wegen des Besitzes von Kindesmissbrauchs-Darstellungen in die Schlagzeilen geraten ist.
q.t: After Florian Teichtmeister, Paal is the second ORF star to make headlines for possession of child abuse depictions.

ti: Karner feiert fünf Abschiebungen, während tausende Illegale ins Land strömen
s: FPÖ General Secretary Michael Schnedlitz criticized ÖVP Interior Minister Gerhard Karner for celebrating five deportations while thousands of illegal immigrants continue to enter Austria, demanding an immediate asylum stop and remigration policy under Herbert Kickl.

q.o: Der ÖVP-Totalversager im Innenministerium, Karner, feiert sich jetzt wieder für fünf Abschiebungen. Das ist übelste Bürgertäuschung!
q.t: The ÖVP total failure in the Interior Ministry, Karner, is now celebrating himself again for five deportations. This is the worst kind of deception of citizens!

q.o: Österreich braucht keinen ÖVP-Bürgertäuscher und Totalversager im Innenministerium, sondern eine Politik, die den Schutz der eigenen Bevölkerung an die erste Stelle setzt. Das bedeutet einen sofortigen und lückenlosen Asyl-Stopp mit der ‚Festung Österreich'.
q.t: Austria does not need an ÖVP deceiver of citizens and total failure in the Interior Ministry, but rather a policy that puts the protection of its own population first. This means an immediate and complete asylum stop with 'Fortress Austria'.

q.o: Nur die FPÖ mit einem Volkskanzler Herbert Kickl wird diese Wende für Österreich herbeiführen und die Sicherheit in unserem Land wiederherstellen!
q.t: Only the FPÖ with a People's Chancellor Herbert Kickl will bring about this turnaround for Austria and restore security in our country!

ti: Right-wing Austrian party apologizes for Holocaust, calls for moving embassy to Jerusalem - worldisraelnews.com
s: The Freiheitliche Partei Österreichs issued an apology for the Holocaust and called for relocating Austria's embassy to Jerusalem.

ti: JA21 boekt resultaten bij de Algemene Politieke Beschouwingen
s: JA21 secured passage of two motions during the 2026 General Political Debates requiring the government to present a plan to prevent broad judicial interpretation of the ECHR before the asylum budget debate and establishing a national ban on face-covering clothing at demonstrations, while also presenting a legislative initiative to prevent permanent closure of Groningen gas wells.

q.o: De inzet van JA21 was helder: dit kabinet moet kiezen. Er is een route naar een meerderheid over links en een route over rechts: de Juiste Route.
q.t: JA21's position was clear: this cabinet must choose. There is a route to a majority via the left and a route via the right: the Right Route.

q.o: JA21 biedt de enige serieuze, rechtse route naar: Lagere lasten; Minder immigratie; Veilige straten.

s: Paula Santos, President of the Parliamentary Group and member of the Political Committee of the Central Committee, criticized the PSD/CDS government for lacking effective solutions to address the rising cost of living and proposed measures including diplomatic intervention to stop war and sanctions, wage increases, a 50-euro pension increase effective from July 1, price controls on essential goods and services, and support for affected sectors.

q.o: O Primeiro-Ministro perdeu uma oportunidade para apresentar soluções efectivas para enfrentar o aumento do custo de vida, optando por mais uma acção de propaganda, com o anúncio de medidas que, em grande parte, já tinham sido apresentadas.
q.t: The Prime Minister missed an opportunity to present effective solutions to face the increase in the cost of living, opting for yet another propaganda action, with the announcement of measures that, for the most part, had already been presented.

q.o: Ficou claro que o Governo PSD/CDS, a par de IL, Chega e PS, se recusa a beliscar um euro dos lucros dos grandes grupos económicos, obtidos à custa dos sacrifícios impostos aos salários e às pensões.
q.t: It became clear that the PSD/CDS Government, alongside IL, Chega and PS, refuses to touch a euro of the profits of the large economic groups, obtained at the cost of sacrifices imposed on wages and pensions.

s: The Portuguese Communist Party announced it will present parliamentary initiatives to fix intermodal transport passes at 20 euros in metropolitan areas from January 1st, extend this pricing to all intermunicipal communities, introduce free transport for those over 65, and invest in expanding public transport capacity including railway maintenance.

q.o: O PCP defende a progressiva redução do preço dos transportes públicos a caminho da sua gratuitidade, num processo acompanhado pelo aumento da oferta e da intermodalidade.
q.t: The PCP defends the progressive reduction of public transport prices towards their gratuity, in a process accompanied by increased supply and intermodality.

q.t: In this sense, the PCP will present initiatives in the Assembly of the Republic that ensure financing from the Central Administration of the necessary means to: - fix the value of the intermodal pass in metropolitan areas at 20 euros starting from January 1st

q.o: promover a gratuitidade para os maiores de 65 anos a partir de 1 de Janeiro
q.t: promote free transport for those over 65 years old from January 1st

q.o: Ontem, o primeiro-ministro afirmava: 'Não trocamos este rumo por nenhum outro'. Pois o PCP aqui reafirma é que outro rumo para Portugal e para uma vida melhor é possível, rompendo com as injustiças!

s: People Before Profit criticizes the establishment of an Ave Maria University offshoot at Mount Melleray Abbey in Waterford, claiming it operates without educational accreditation or planning permission and calling for a 100% tax on Catholic Church commercial transactions to fund abuse survivor redress.

q.o: If any real morality or justice existed in Irish law, a 100% Retribution Tax would be slapped on every single commercial lease, land sale, or property transaction executed by the Catholic Church.
q.t: If any real morality or justice existed in Irish law, a 100% Retribution Tax would be slapped on every single commercial lease, land sale, or property transaction executed by the Catholic Church.

q.o: Every single cent generated by leasing Mount Melleray Abbey to Ave Maria University should be immediately seized by the state and ring-fenced directly for survivor support services and unpaid redress funds.

ti: Online Public Meeting: Make the Data Centres Pay
s: People Before Profit is holding a public meeting on September 21st, 2026 to mobilise support for a Dáil motion scheduled for September 23rd that would impose a charge on data centres to fund a €500 energy credit for every household, arguing that data centres currently receive half-price electricity compared to households.

q.o: The Data Centres operating in Ireland can easily pay for normal Irish energy prices, but THEY get it HALF PRICE. Their prices should go up, and ours should come down through our plan for a 500 euro energy credit.
Currently Data Centres get half-price electricity compare to households, the PBP motion would close that gap with a charge on data centres which would fund a €500 energy credit for every household.
The question of who pays for this expansion is also a question about what kind of economy we want, and who it is being run for.

ti: Budget Office: 95% of Households Are Better Off Under People Before Profit’s Proposals Than Any Others
s: People Before Profit released Budget 2026 proposals that the Parliamentary Budget Office analyzed as benefiting 95% of households with average income gains of 9.4%, funded by €46.4 billion in net revenue raising primarily through corporation and capital taxes.

q.o: The report from the Parliamentary Budget Office demonstrates just how progressive People Before Profit's 2026 budget proposals are. Under our proposals, 95% of households would be better off, while the wealthiest 5% and corporations would pay significantly higher taxes to begin the redistribution of income and wealth that is so urgently required.

By taxing multi-millionaires and big corporations, we demonstrated that we can increase average incomes for middle income households by 14.2%. According to the PBO this compares to 1.4% increase from the Social Democrats' proposals for middle income earners, 3.2% by Labour and 4.5% by Sinn Féin.

People Before Profit is serious about transforming our society through a just transition to an equal and sustainable ecosocialist society. Our budget proposals provide an insight on how we can finance such a transition

There is vast wealth in this State and a left government must have an ambitious plan for redistribution from the wealthiest 5% to the 95%, the people who create the wealth, if it is to fulfill the aspirations of our voters.

ti: MLAs Pocket Pay Rises While Workers Wait
s: People Before Profit MLA Gerry Carroll and Councillor Shaun Harkin condemned proposals for a further pay rise for MLAs months after a 27% increase, contrasting this with delayed pay awards for public sector workers including health workers and teachers.

q.o: This is a slap in the face to health workers, civil servants and every public sector worker still waiting on a pay award.
q.t: This is a slap in the face to health workers, civil servants and every public sector worker still waiting on a pay award.

q.o: Five months into the financial year, the Executive has no budget and workers are being told there's no money for fair pay or decent public services. Inexplicably, MLAs are now lined up for another rise on top of the £14,000 they pocketed in April.
q.t: Five months into the financial year, the Executive has no budget and workers are being told there's no money for fair pay or decent public services. Inexplicably, MLAs are now lined up for another rise on top of the £14,000 they pocketed in April.

q.o: Politicians should live on the same wage as the people they represent. Maybe then they'd find some urgency to deliver fair pay for workers.
q.t: Politicians should live on the same wage as the people they represent. Maybe then they'd find some urgency to deliver fair pay for workers.

q.o: Sinn Féin, DUP, Alliance, UUP and SDLP MLAs refused to back People Before Profit's motion in Stormont that would have blocked these outrageous pay hikes.
q.t: Sinn Féin, DUP, Alliance, UUP and SDLP MLAs refused to back People Before Profit's motion in Stormont that would have blocked these outrageous pay hikes.

q.o: People power is the only thing that can put manners on an out of touch Stormont Assembly and completely overhaul government priorities.
q.t: People power is the only thing that can put manners on an out of touch Stormont Assembly and completely overhaul government priorities.

ti: Harkin: Only Crime is Attempting To Stop Gaza Genocide
s: People Before Profit Councillor Shaun Harkin condemned a Derry court ruling against Palestine solidarity activists Goretti Horgan and Nina Pulis, calling for resistance to criminalisation of Palestine solidarity and announcing support for an October 10th global day of action for Palestine.

q.o: We are very disappointed at the judge's ruling in Derry Court House, but not disheartened. Goretti Horgan, Nina Pulis and Palestine solidarity campaigners trying to stop complicity with genocide don't belong in court. Their only crime is attempting to stop Israel's Gaza genocide.
q.t: We are very disappointed at the judge's ruling in Derry Court House, but not disheartened. Goretti Horgan, Nina Pulis and Palestine solidarity campaigners trying to stop complicity with genocide don't belong in court. Their only crime is attempting to stop Israel's Gaza genocide.

q.o: The criminalisation of Palestine solidarity will not be accepted and will be resisted in the courts and on the streets.
q.t: The criminalisation of Palestine solidarity will not be accepted and will be resisted in the courts and on the streets.

q.o: The October 10th global day of action for Palestine is an opportunity to ratchet-up the pressure on governments to end their complicity with Israel, to demand an end to the criminalisation of opposition to genocide and to stand in solidarity with the Palestinian people.
q.t: The October 10th global day of action for Palestine is an opportunity to ratchet-up the pressure on governments to end their complicity with Israel, to demand an end to the criminalisation of opposition to genocide and to stand in solidarity with the Palestinian people.
